refs.text_en: And to the messenger of the church in Philadelphia write: These things says the Holy One, the true One, the One who has the key of David, the One who opens and no one will shut, and shuts and no one opens:

refs.text_gb: 主神说，我是阿拉法，我是俄梅嘎，是今是昔是以后永是的全能者。
refs.text_big5: 主神說，我是阿拉法，我是俄梅嘎，是今是昔是以後永是的全能者。
refs.text_en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, He who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.

refs.text_gb: 约翰写信给在亚西亚的七个召会：愿恩典与平安，从那今是昔是以后永是的，从祂宝座前的七灵，
refs.text_big5: 約翰寫信給在亞西亞的七個召會：願恩典與平安，從那今是昔是以後永是的，從祂寶座前的七靈，
refs.text_en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from Him who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven Spirits who are before His throne,

verses.text_en: And when the four living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to Him who sits upon the throne, to Him who lives forever and ever,
verses.text_gb_plain: 每逢四活物将荣耀、尊贵、感谢，归与那坐在宝座上，活到永永远远者的时候，
verses.text_big5_plain: 每逢四活物將榮耀、尊貴、感謝，歸與那坐在寶座上，活到永永遠遠者的時候，

footnotes.zh: 本节四活物，和11节二十四位长老的赞美，都由三件事组成，含示他们是在赞美三一神。在两处的赞美中，前两项荣耀、尊贵是相同的，最后一项却不同。在四活物的赞美中，最后一项是感谢，因为他们是蒙救赎的，对神恩典的救赎心存感激；但在二十四位长老的赞美中，最后一项是能力，因他们不是蒙救赎的受造之物，乃是靠神的能力管理宇宙的，所以他们珍赏神的能力。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本節四活物，和11節二十四位長老的讚美，都由三件事組成，含示他們是在讚美三一神。在兩處的讚美中，前兩項榮耀、尊貴是相同的，最後一項卻不同。在四活物的讚美中，最後一項是感謝，因為他們是蒙救贖的，對神恩典的救贖心存感激；但在二十四位長老的讚美中，最後一項是能力，因他們不是蒙救贖的受造之物，乃是靠神的能力管理宇宙的，所以他們珍賞神的能力。
footnotes.en: 4:9 1 glory The praises of both the four living creatures in this verse and the twenty-four elders in v. 11 are composed of three items, implying that both the living creatures and the elders are praising the Triune God. The first two items, glory and honor, are the same in both places, but the last item is different: In the praises of the four living creatures the last item is thanks — they are redeemed and are grateful for the redemption of God's grace; whereas in the praises of the twenty-four elders the last item is power — as the rulers of the universe (they are not the redeemed creatures), they appreciate the power of God, by which they rule.

refs.text_en: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.

verses.text_en: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for You have created all things, and because of Your will they were, and were created.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们的主，我们的神，你是配得荣耀、尊贵、能力的，因为你创造了万有，并且万有是因你的旨意存在并被创造的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們的主，我們的神，你是配得榮耀、尊貴、能力的，因為你創造了萬有，並且萬有是因你的旨意存在並被創造的。

footnotes.zh: 见9注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見9註1。
footnotes.en: 4:11 1 glory See note Rev. 4:9 1 .

footnotes.zh: 神是一位有定旨的神，有祂自己喜悦的旨意。祂为着自己的旨意，创造了万有，好成就并完成祂的定旨。本书揭示神宇宙的行政，给我们看见神的定旨。因此，当二十四位长老为着神的创造而赞美时，说出祂的创造与祂的旨意有关。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神是一位有定旨的神，有祂自己喜悅的旨意。祂為著自己的旨意，創造了萬有，好成就並完成祂的定旨。本書揭示神宇宙的行政，給我們看見神的定旨。因此，當二十四位長老為著神的創造而讚美時，說出祂的創造與祂的旨意有關。
footnotes.en: 4:11 2 will God is a God of purpose, having a will of His own pleasure. He created all things for His will that He might accomplish and fulfill His purpose. This book, which unveils God's universal administration, shows us the purpose of God. Hence, in the twenty-four elders' praise to God concerning His creation, His creation is related to His will.

footnotes.en: 5:1 1 scroll This scroll must be the new covenant, the grand title deed in the universe, enacted with the blood of the Lamb for God's redemption of the church, Israel, the world, and the universe. This book is a record of God's thought concerning the church, Israel, the world, and the universe.

footnotes.zh: 用来封严这书卷的七印，实际上就是这书卷的内容，也是启示录的内容。启示录正是揭开并启示这七印的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 用來封嚴這書卷的七印，實際上就是這書卷的內容，也是啟示錄的內容。啟示錄正是揭開並啟示這七印的。
footnotes.en: 5:1 2 seven The seven seals with which the scroll is sealed up are actually the contents of the scroll and the contents of the book of Revelation. The book of Revelation is just the opening, the unveiling, of the seven seals.

footnotes.en: 5:4 1 no If actually no one in the whole universe was found worthy to open the scroll, we would surely need to weep, for the whole universe would be vanity, with none qualified to unveil its secret.

verses.text_gb: 长老中有一位对我说，不要哭；看哪，犹[Cra]大支派中的狮[Fn1][Crb]子，大[Fn2]卫的根[Crc]，祂已得[Fn3][Crd]胜，能以展开那书卷，揭开它的七印。
verses.text_big5: 長老中有一位對我說，不要哭；看哪，猶[Cra]大支派中的獅[Fn1][Crb]子，大[Fn2]衛的根[Crc]，祂已得[Fn3][Crd]勝，能以展開那書卷，揭開它的七印。
verses.text_en: And one of the elders said to me, Do not weep; behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome so that He may open the scroll and its seven seals.
verses.text_gb_plain: 长老中有一位对我说，不要哭；看哪，犹大支派中的狮子，大卫的根，祂已得胜，能以展开那书卷，揭开它的七印。
verses.text_big5_plain: 長老中有一位對我說，不要哭；看哪，猶大支派中的獅子，大衛的根，祂已得勝，能以展開那書卷，揭開它的七印。

footnotes.zh: 狮子表征基督，描绘出祂是抵挡仇敌的刚强战士，如创四九8～9所预言的。祂的得胜使祂够资格展开那书卷，揭开它的七印。
footnotes.zh_big5: 獅子表徵基督，描繪出祂是抵擋仇敵的剛強戰士，如創四九8～9所豫言的。祂的得勝使祂彀資格展開那書卷，揭開它的七印。
footnotes.en: 5:5 1 Lion The lion is a symbol of Christ, portraying Him as a strong fighter against the enemy, as prophesied in Gen. 49:8-9. Christ's overcoming qualifies Him to open the scroll and its seven seals.

footnotes.zh: 大卫的根(也称大卫之父耶西的根——赛十一1)，这名称表征基督是大卫的根源。因此，大卫虽是祂的先祖，也称祂为主(太二二42～45)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 大衛的根，（也稱大衛之父耶西的根─賽十一10，）這名稱表徵基督是大衛的根源。因此，大衛雖是祂的先祖，也稱祂為主。（太二二42～45。）
footnotes.en: 5:5 2 Root The title Root of David (He is also the Root of David's father, Jesse — Isa. 11:1) signifies that Christ is the source of David. Therefore, David, His forefather, called Him "Lord" (Matt. 22:42-45).

footnotes.zh: 基督是犹大支派中的狮子，击败了背叛神的仇敌撒但，并且祂是救赎的羔羊，除去了堕落之人的罪，借此祂去掉了成全神旨意的拦阻。所以祂配展开关于神经纶的书卷。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督是猶大支派中的獅子，擊敗了背叛神的仇敵撒但，並且祂是救贖的羔羊，除去了墮落之人的罪，藉此祂去掉了成全神旨意的攔阻。所以祂配展開關於神經綸的書卷。
footnotes.en: 5:5 3 overcome As the Lion of the tribe of Judah, Christ overcame and defeated the rebellious Satan, the enemy of God, and as the redeeming Lamb, He took away the sin of fallen man. By so doing, He removed the hindrances to the fulfillment of God's purpose. Therefore, He is worthy to open the scroll concerning God's economy.

refs.text_gb: 犹大啊，你弟兄们必赞美你；你手必掐住仇敌的颈项；你父亲的儿子们必向你下拜。
refs.text_big5: 猶大阿，你弟兄們必讚美你；你手必掐住仇敵的頸項；你父親的兒子們必向你下拜。
refs.text_en: Judah, your brothers will praise you; / Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; / Your father's sons will bow down before you.

refs.text_gb: 犹大从他玛氏生法勒斯和谢拉，法勒斯生希斯仑，希斯仑生亚兰，
refs.text_big5: 猶大從他瑪氏生法勒斯和謝拉，法勒斯生希斯崙，希斯崙生亞蘭，
refs.text_en: And Judah begot Pharez and Zarah of Tamar, and Pharez begot Hezron, and Hezron begot Aram,

refs.text_gb: 我们的主明显是从犹大支派出来的；论到这支派，摩西并没有讲到祭司的事。
refs.text_big5: 我們的主明顯是從猶大支派出來的；論到這支派，摩西並沒有講到祭司的事。
refs.text_en: For it is evident that our Lord has risen out of Judah, concerning which tribe Moses spoke nothing about priests.

refs.text_gb: 犹大是个小狮子；我儿啊，你抓了食便上山去。他蹲伏如公狮，又如母狮，谁敢惹他？
refs.text_big5: 猶大是個小獅子；我兒阿，你抓了食便上山去。他蹲伏如公獅，又如母獅，誰敢惹他？
refs.text_en: Judah is a young lion; / From the prey, my son, you have gone up. / He couches, he stretches out like a lion, / And like a lioness; who will rouse him up?

refs.text_gb: 权杖必不离犹大，王杖必不离他两脚之间，直到细罗来到，万民都必归顺。
refs.text_big5: 權杖必不離猶大，王杖必不離他兩腳之間，直到細羅來到，萬民都必歸順。
refs.text_en: The scepter will not depart from Judah, / Nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, / Until Shiloh comes, / And to Him shall be the obedience of the peoples.

refs.text_gb: 他蹲卧如公狮，又如母狮，谁敢惹他？凡给你祝福的，愿他蒙福；凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。
refs.text_big5: 他蹲臥如公獅，又如母獅，誰敢惹他？凡給你祝福的，願他蒙福；凡咒詛你的，願他受咒詛。
refs.text_en: He couches; he lies down like a lion / And like a lioness; who will rouse him up? / Blessed is everyone who blesses you, / And cursed is everyone who curses you.

refs.text_gb: 雅各余剩的人必在列国许多的民中，如狮子在树林间的百兽中，又如少壮狮子在羊群中；他若经过，就必践踏撕裂，无人搭救。
refs.text_big5: 雅各餘剩的人必在列國許多的民中，如獅子在樹林間的百獸中，又如少壯獅子在羊群中；他若經過，就必踐踏撕裂，無人搭救。
refs.text_en: And the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, / In the midst of many peoples, / Like a lion among the beasts of the forest, / Like a young lion among the flocks of sheep, / Who, if he should pass through, tramples under / And tears up, and there is none to deliver from him.

crossrefs.label: c
crossrefs.raw: 启二二16，参赛十一1，10，罗十五12

refs.text_gb: 我耶稣差遣我的使者，为众召会将这些事向你们作见证。我是大卫的根，又是他的后裔，我是明亮的晨星。
refs.text_big5: 我耶穌差遣我的使者，為眾召會將這些事向你們作見證。我是大衛的根，又是他的後裔，我是明亮的晨星。
refs.text_en: I Jesus have sent My angel to testify to you these things for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright morning star.

refs.text_gb: 从耶西的𣎴必发嫩条，从他根生的枝子必结果实。
refs.text_big5: 從耶西的𣎴必發嫩條，從他根生的枝子必結果實。
refs.text_en: Then a sprout will come forth from the stump of Jesse, / And a branch from his roots will bear fruit.

refs.text_gb: 到那日，耶西的根立作众民的旌旗；外邦人必寻求祂；祂安息之所必有荣耀。
refs.text_big5: 到那日，耶西的根立作眾民的旌旗；外邦人必尋求祂；祂安息之所必有榮耀。
refs.text_en: And in that day the root of Jesse, / Who stands as a banner to the peoples - / Him will the nations seek, / And His resting place will be the glory.

refs.text_gb: 又有以赛亚说，“将来有耶西的根，就是那兴起来要治理外邦的，外邦人都要寄望于祂。”
refs.text_big5: 又有以賽亞說，“將來有耶西的根，就是那興起來要治理外邦的，外邦人都要寄望於祂。”
refs.text_en: And again, Isaiah says, "There shall be the root of Jesse, even He who rises to rule the Gentiles; on Him will the Gentiles hope."

refs.text_gb: 我将这些事对你们说了，是要叫你们在我里面有平安。在世上你们有苦难，但你们可以放心，我已经胜了世界。
refs.text_big5: 我將這些事對你們說了，是要叫你們在我裏面有平安。在世上你們有苦難，但你們可以放心，我已經勝了世界。
refs.text_en: These things I have spoken to you that in Me you may have peace. In the world you have affliction, but take courage; I have overcome the world.

refs.text_gb: 他们要与羔羊争战，羔羊必胜过他们，因为羔羊是万主之主，万王之王。同着羔羊的，就是蒙召被选忠信的人，也必得胜。
refs.text_big5: 他們要與羔羊爭戰，羔羊必勝過他們，因為羔羊是萬主之主，萬王之王。同著羔羊的，就是蒙召被選忠信的人，也必得勝。
refs.text_en: These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and they who are with Him, the called and chosen and faithful, will also overcome them.

verses.text_gb: 我又看见宝座与四活物中间，并众长老中间，有羔[Fn1][Cra]羊站[Fn2]立，像是刚[Fn3]被杀[Crb]过的，有七[Fn4]角[Crc]和七[Fn5][Crd]眼[Cre]，就[Fn6]是神的七[Crf]灵，奉差遣往全[Crg]地去的。
verses.text_big5: 我又看見寶座與四活物中間，並眾長老中間，有羔[Fn1][Cra]羊站[Fn2]立，像是剛[Fn3]被殺[Crb]過的，有七[Fn4]角[Crc]和七[Fn5][Crd]眼[Cre]，就[Fn6]是神的七[Crf]靈，奉差遣往全[Crg]地去的。
verses.text_en: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders a Lamb standing as having just been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我又看见宝座与四活物中间，并众长老中间，有羔羊站立，像是刚被杀过的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往全地去的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我又看見寶座與四活物中間，並眾長老中間，有羔羊站立，像是剛被殺過的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往全地去的。

footnotes.zh: 在四章里，诸天之上的景象是以神的宝座为中心，神坐在其上，预备好执行祂宇宙的行政，以完成祂永远的定旨。在五章这里有基督升天后诸天之上同样的景象。长老中有一位向使徒约翰引荐基督是犹大的狮子，但祂向约翰却显为羔羊。是狮子，祂是抵挡仇敌的战士；是羔羊，祂是我们的救赎主。祂争战是为救赎我们，如今祂已胜过仇敌，并为我们成功了救赎。对仇敌，祂是狮子；对我们，祂是羔羊。所以祂是狮子羔羊。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在四章裏，諸天之上的景象是以神的寶座為中心，神坐在其上，豫備好執行祂宇宙的行政，以完成祂永遠的定旨。在五章這裏有基督升天後諸天之上同樣的景象。長老中有一位向使徒約翰引薦基督是猶大的獅子，但祂向約翰卻顯為羔羊。是獅子，祂是抵擋仇敵的戰士；是羔羊，祂是我們的救贖主。祂爭戰是為救贖我們，如今祂已勝過仇敵，並為我們成功了救贖。對仇敵，祂是獅子；對我們，祂是羔羊。所以祂是獅子羔羊。
footnotes.en: 5:6 1 Lamb In ch. 4 is the scene in the heavens, its center being the throne of God, on which God sits, ready to execute His universal administration for the fulfillment of His eternal purpose. Here in ch. 5 is the same scene in the heavens after Christ ascended there. He was recommended to the apostle John as the Lion of the tribe of Judah by one of the elders, but He appeared to John as a Lamb. As the Lion, He is the Fighter against the enemy; as the Lamb, He is the Redeemer for us. He fought to redeem us, and He won the battle over the enemy and accomplished redemption for us. To the enemy He is a Lion; to us He is a Lamb. Hence, He is the Lion-Lamb.

footnotes.zh: 关于救赎，基督升天后就坐在诸天之上神的右边(来一3，十12)；关于神行政的完成，祂在升天里仍然站着。
footnotes.zh_big5: 關於救贖，基督升天後就坐在諸天之上神的右邊；（來一3，十12；）關於神行政的完成，祂在升天裏仍然站著。
footnotes.en: 5:6 2 standing As far as redemption is concerned, Christ sat down at the right hand of God in the heavens after His ascension (Heb. 1:3; 10:12), whereas regarding the carrying out of God's administration, He is still standing in His ascension.

footnotes.zh: 刚被杀过的，指明羔羊刚刚被杀，也指明本章所描述诸天之上的景象，是紧接在基督升天之后。
footnotes.zh_big5: 剛被殺過的，指明羔羊剛剛被殺，也指明本章所描述諸天之上的景象，是緊接在基督升天之後。
footnotes.en: 5:6 3 having Having just been slain indicates that the Lamb had just been slain and also that the scene in the heavens that is depicted in this chapter took place immediately after Christ's ascension into the heavens.

footnotes.zh: 角象征争战的力量(申三三17)。基督虽是救赎的羔羊，却有争战的角。祂乃是争战的救赎主。祂的争战在神的行动中是完整(完全而完整)的，如七这数字所表明的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 角象徵爭戰的力量。（申三三17。）基督雖是救贖的羔羊，卻有爭戰的角。祂乃是爭戰的救贖主。祂的爭戰在神的行動中是完整（完全而完整）的，如七這數字所表明的。
footnotes.en: 5:6 4 seven Horns signify strength in fighting (Deut. 33:17). Christ is the redeeming Lamb, yet He has horns for fighting. He is the fighting Redeemer. His fighting is complete (perfect and complete) in God's move, as signified by the number seven.

footnotes.zh: 眼是为着鉴察并搜寻。基督是救赎的羔羊，有鉴察并搜寻的七眼，为着执行神对宇宙的审判，以成就神永远的定旨，这要完成于新耶路撒冷的建造。所以，亚三9预言祂是石头，就是带着七眼，为着神建造的顶石(亚四7，直译)。这七眼就是神的七灵，奉差遣往普天下去，遍察全地的(亚四10)。见一14注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 眼是為著鑒察並搜尋。基督是救贖的羔羊，有鑒察並搜尋的七眼，為著執行神對宇宙的審判，以成就神永遠的定旨，這要完成於新耶路撒冷的建造。所以，亞三9豫言祂是石頭，就是帶著七眼，為著神建造的頂石。（亞四7。）這七眼就是神的七靈，奉差遣往普天下去，遍察全地的。（亞四10。）見一14註3。
footnotes.en: 5:6 5 seven Eyes are for observing and searching. Christ as the redeeming Lamb has seven observing and searching eyes for executing God's judgment upon the universe to fulfill God's eternal purpose, which will consummate in the building up of the New Jerusalem. Therefore, in Zech. 3:9 He is prophesied as the stone, the topstone (Zech. 4:7, lit.) with seven eyes for God's building. These seven eyes are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth, and they run to and fro through the whole earth (Zech. 4:10). See note Rev. 1:14 3 .

footnotes.zh: 按希腊文文法，“就是”的前述辞是七眼，所以神的七灵，只指羔羊的七眼，不包含祂的七角。
footnotes.zh_big5: 按希臘文文法，“就是”的前述辭是七眼，所以神的七靈，只指羔羊的七眼，不包含祂的七角。
footnotes.en: 5:6 6 which According to Greek grammar, the antecedent of which is seven eyes. Hence, the seven Spirits of God refer only to the seven eyes of the Lamb, and not to His seven horns.

refs.text_gb: 当祂拿书卷的时候，四活物和二十四位长老，都俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴，和盛满了香的金炉，这香炉就是众圣徒的祷告。
refs.text_big5: 當祂拿書卷的時候，四活物和二十四位長老，都俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿著琴，和盛滿了香的金爐，這香爐就是眾聖徒的禱告。
refs.text_en: And when He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, each having a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which bowls are the prayers of the saints.

refs.text_gb: 大声说，曾被杀的羔羊，是配得能力、丰富、智慧、力量、尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的。
refs.text_big5: 大聲說，曾被殺的羔羊，是配得能力、豐富、智慧、力量、尊貴、榮耀、頌讚的。
refs.text_en: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.

refs.text_gb: 我又听见在天上、地上、地底下、沧海里的一切受造之物，以及天地间的万有都说，但愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、权能，都归与坐宝座的和羔羊，直到永永远远。
refs.text_big5: 我又聽見在天上、地上、地底下、滄海裏的一切受造之物，以及天地間的萬有都說，但願頌讚、尊貴、榮耀、權能，都歸與坐寶座的和羔羊，直到永永遠遠。
refs.text_en: And every creature which is in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and on the sea and all things in them, I heard saying, To Him who sits upon the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing and the honor and the glory and the might forever and ever.

refs.text_gb: 羔羊揭开七印中第一印的时候，我观看，就听见四活物中的一个，声音如雷，说，你来。
refs.text_big5: 羔羊揭開七印中第一印的時候，我觀看，就聽見四活物中的一個，聲音如雷，說，你來。
refs.text_en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying like the sound of thunder, Come.

refs.text_gb: 他们向山岭和岩石说，倒在我们身上吧，把我们藏起来，躲避坐宝座者的面、和羔羊的忿怒；
refs.text_big5: 他們向山嶺和巖石說，倒在我們身上罷，把我們藏起來，躲避坐寶座者的面、和羔羊的忿怒；
refs.text_en: And they say to the mountains and to the rocks, Fall on us and hide us from the face of Him who sits upon the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb;

refs.text_gb: 这些事以后，我观看，看哪，有大批的群众，没有人能数得过来，是从各邦国、各支派、各民族、各方言来的，站在宝座前和羔羊面前，身穿白袍，手拿棕树枝，
refs.text_big5: 這些事以後，我觀看，看哪，有大批的群眾，沒有人能數得過來，是從各邦國、各支派、各民族、各方言來的，站在寶座前和羔羊面前，身穿白袍，手拿棕樹枝，
refs.text_en: After these things I saw, and behold, there was a great multitude which no one could number, out of every nation and all tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes and palm branches in their hands.

refs.text_gb: 大声喊着说，愿救恩归与坐在宝座上我们的神，也归与羔羊。
refs.text_big5: 大聲喊著說，願救恩歸與坐在寶座上我們的神，也歸與羔羊。
refs.text_en: And they cry with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God who sits upon the throne and to the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 我对他说，我主，你晓得。他对我说，这些人是从大患难中出来的，曾用羔羊的血，洗净了他们的袍子，并且洗白了。
refs.text_big5: 我對他說，我主，你曉得。他對我說，這些人是從大患難中出來的，曾用羔羊的血，洗淨了他們的袍子，並且洗白了。
refs.text_en: And I said to him, My lord, you know. And he said to me, These are those who come out of the great tribulation, and they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 因为宝座中的羔羊必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉；神也必从他们眼中擦去一切的眼泪。
refs.text_big5: 因為寶座中的羔羊必牧養他們，領他們到生命水的泉；神也必從他們眼中擦去一切的眼淚。
refs.text_en: For the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and guide them to springs of waters of life; and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们胜过他，是因羔羊的血，并因自己所见证的话，他们虽至于死，也不爱自己的魂生命。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們勝過他，是因羔羊的血，並因自己所見證的話，他們雖至於死，也不愛自己的魂生命。
refs.text_en: And they overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb and because of the word of their testimony, and they loved not their soul-life even unto death.

refs.text_gb: 凡住在地上，名字没有记在从创世以来被杀之羔羊生命册上的人，都要拜它。
refs.text_big5: 凡住在地上，名字沒有記在從創世以來被殺之羔羊生命冊上的人，都要拜牠。
refs.text_en: And all those dwelling on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name is not written in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain from the foundation of the world.

refs.text_gb: 我又观看，看哪，羔羊站在锡安山上，同祂还有十四万四千人，额上都写着祂的名，和祂父的名。
refs.text_big5: 我又觀看，看哪，羔羊站在錫安山上，同祂還有十四萬四千人，額上都寫著祂的名，和祂父的名。
refs.text_en: And I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him a hundred and forty-four thousand, having His name and the name of His Father written on their foreheads.

refs.text_gb: 这些人未曾与妇女在一起受到玷污，他们原是童身。羔羊无论往哪里去，他们都跟随祂。他们是从人间买来的，作初熟的果子归与神和羔羊；
refs.text_big5: 這些人未曾與婦女在一起受到玷污，他們原是童身。羔羊無論往那裏去，他們都跟隨祂。他們是從人間買來的，作初熟的果子歸與神和羔羊；
refs.text_en: These are they who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are they who follow the Lamb wherever He may go. These were purchased from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 这人也必喝神烈怒的酒，此酒调在神忿怒的杯中，纯一不杂；他要在圣天使和羔羊面前，在火与硫磺中受痛苦。
refs.text_big5: 這人也必喝神烈怒的酒，此酒調在神忿怒的杯中，純一不雜；他要在聖天使和羔羊面前，在火與硫磺中受痛苦。
refs.text_en: He also shall drink of the wine of the fury of God, which is mixed undiluted in the cup of His wrath; and he shall be tormented in fire and brimstone before the holy angels and before the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 他们唱着神奴仆摩西的歌、和羔羊的歌，说，主神，全能者，你的作为大哉、奇哉！万国之王，你的道路义哉、诚哉！
refs.text_big5: 他們唱著神奴僕摩西的歌、和羔羊的歌，說，主神，全能者，你的作為大哉、奇哉！萬國之王，你的道路義哉、誠哉！
refs.text_en: And they sing the song of Moses, the slave of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and wonderful are Your works, Lord God the Almighty! Righteous and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!

refs.text_gb: 他们要与羔羊争战，羔羊必胜过他们，因为羔羊是万主之主，万王之王。同着羔羊的，就是蒙召被选忠信的人，也必得胜。
refs.text_big5: 他們要與羔羊爭戰，羔羊必勝過他們，因為羔羊是萬主之主，萬王之王。同著羔羊的，就是蒙召被選忠信的人，也必得勝。
refs.text_en: These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and they who are with Him, the called and chosen and faithful, will also overcome them.

refs.text_gb: 我们要喜乐欢腾，将荣耀归与祂；因为羔羊婚娶的时候到了，新妇也自己预备好了。
refs.text_big5: 我們要喜樂歡騰，將榮耀歸與祂；因為羔羊婚娶的時候到了，新婦也自己豫備好了。
refs.text_en: Let us rejoice and exult, and let us give the glory to Him, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His wife has made herself ready.

refs.text_gb: 天使对我说，你要写上，凡被请赴羔羊婚筵的有福了。又对我说，这是神真实的话。
refs.text_big5: 天使對我說，你要寫上，凡被請赴羔羊婚筵的有福了。又對我說，這是神真實的話。
refs.text_en: And he said to me, Write, Blessed are they who are called to the marriage dinner of the Lamb. And he said to me, These are the true words of God.

refs.text_gb: 拿着七个金碗，盛满末后七灾的七位天使中，有一位来对我说，你来，我要将新妇，就是羔羊的妻，指给你看。
refs.text_big5: 拿著七個金碗，盛滿末後七災的七位天使中，有一位來對我說，你來，我要將新婦，就是羔羊的妻，指給你看。
refs.text_en: And one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and spoke with me, saying, Come here; I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 城墙有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的十二个名字。
refs.text_big5: 城牆有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的十二個名字。
refs.text_en: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 我未见城内有殿，因主神全能者和羔羊为城的殿。
refs.text_big5: 我未見城內有殿，因主神全能者和羔羊為城的殿。
refs.text_en: And I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

refs.text_gb: 那城内不需要日月光照，因有神的荣耀光照，又有羔羊为城的灯。
refs.text_big5: 那城內不需要日月光照，因有神的榮耀光照，又有羔羊為城的燈。
refs.text_en: And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon that they should shine in it, for the glory of God illumined it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 凡俗污的，并那行可憎与虚谎之事的，绝不得进那城，只有记在羔羊生命册上的，才得进去。
refs.text_big5: 凡俗污的，並那行可憎與虛謊之事的，絕不得進那城，只有記在羔羊生命冊上的，纔得進去。
refs.text_en: And anything common and he who makes an abomination and a lie shall by no means enter into it, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.

refs.text_gb: 天使又指给我看在城内街道当中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，从神和羔羊的宝座流出来。
refs.text_big5: 天使又指給我看在城內街道當中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，從神和羔羊的寶座流出來。
refs.text_en: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb in the middle of its street.

refs.text_gb: 一切咒诅必不再有。在城里有神和羔羊的宝座；祂的奴仆都要事奉祂，
refs.text_big5: 一切咒詛必不再有。在城裏有神和羔羊的寶座；祂的奴僕都要事奉祂，
refs.text_en: And there will no longer be a curse. And the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His slaves will serve Him;

refs.text_gb: 次日，约翰看见耶稣向他走来，就说，看哪，神的羔羊，除去世人之罪的！
refs.text_big5: 次日，約翰看見耶穌向他走來，就說，看哪，神的羔羊，除去世人之罪的！
refs.text_en: The next day he saw Jesus coming to him and said, Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

refs.text_gb: 知道你们得赎，脱离你们祖宗所传流虚妄的生活，不是用能坏的金银等物，
refs.text_big5: 知道你們得贖，脫離你們祖宗所傳流虛妄的生活，不是用能壞的金銀等物，
refs.text_en: Knowing that it was not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, that you were redeemed from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers,

refs.text_gb: 乃是用基督的宝血，如同无瑕疵无玷污的羔羊之血。
refs.text_big5: 乃是用基督的寶血，如同無瑕疵無玷污的羔羊之血。
refs.text_en: But with precious blood, as of a Lamb without blemish and without spot, the blood of Christ;

refs.text_gb: 祂被欺压，受苦却不开口；祂像羊羔被牵去宰杀，又像羊在剪毛的人面前无声，祂也是这样不开口。
refs.text_big5: 祂被欺壓，受苦卻不開口；祂像羊羔被牽去宰殺，又像羊在剪毛的人面前無聲，祂也是這樣不開口。
refs.text_en: He was oppressed, and it was He who was afflicted, / Yet He did not open His mouth; / Like a lamb that is led to the slaughter / And like a sheep that is dumb before its shearers, / So He did not open His mouth.

refs.text_gb: 他们唱新歌，说，你配拿书卷，配揭开它的七印，因为你曾被杀，用自己的血从各支派、各方言、各民族、各邦国中，买了人来归与神，
refs.text_big5: 他們唱新歌，說，你配拿書卷，配揭開它的七印，因為你曾被殺，用自己的血從各支派、各方言、各民族、各邦國中，買了人來歸與神，
refs.text_en: And they sing a new song, saying: You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, for You were slain and have purchased for God by Your blood men out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation,

refs.text_gb: 大声说，曾被杀的羔羊，是配得能力、丰富、智慧、力量、尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的。
refs.text_big5: 大聲說，曾被殺的羔羊，是配得能力、豐富、智慧、力量、尊貴、榮耀、頌讚的。
refs.text_en: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.

refs.text_gb: 凡住在地上，名字没有记在从创世以来被杀之羔羊生命册上的人，都要拜它。
refs.text_big5: 凡住在地上，名字沒有記在從創世以來被殺之羔羊生命冊上的人，都要拜牠。
refs.text_en: And all those dwelling on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name is not written in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain from the foundation of the world.

refs.text_gb: 他像头生的公牛，有威严；他的角是野牛的角，用以抵触万民，直到地极。这角是以法莲的万万，玛拿西的千千。
refs.text_big5: 他像頭生的公牛，有威嚴；他的角是野牛的角，用以牴觸萬民，直到地極。這角是以法蓮的萬萬，瑪拿西的千千。
refs.text_en: Like his firstborn ox, he has majesty; / And his horns are the horns of the wild ox; / With them he shall drive peoples / To the ends of the earth together. / Those are the ten thousands of Ephraim; / And those the thousands of Manasseh.

refs.text_gb: 我要叫大卫的角在那里长出；我为我的受膏者预备明灯。
refs.text_big5: 我要叫大衛的角在那裏長出；我為我的受膏者豫備明燈。
refs.text_en: There I will cause a horn of David to shoot forth; / I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，我在约书亚面前所安置的石头，在一块石头上有七眼。万军之耶和华说，我要亲自雕刻这石头，并要在一日之间除掉那地的罪孽。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，我在約書亞面前所安置的石頭，在一塊石頭上有七眼。萬軍之耶和華說，我要親自雕刻這石頭，並要在一日之間除掉那地的罪孽。
refs.text_en: For here is the stone that I have set before Joshua-upon one stone are seven eyes. I will engrave its engraving, declares Jehovah of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

refs.text_gb: 谁藐视这日的事为小呢？这七眼乃是耶和华的眼睛，遍察全地，见所罗巴伯手拿线铊就欢喜。
refs.text_big5: 誰藐視這日的事為小呢？這七眼乃是耶和華的眼睛，遍察全地，見所羅巴伯手拿線鉈就歡喜。
refs.text_en: For who has despised the day of small things? For these seven rejoice when they see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel; they are the eyes of Jehovah running to and fro on the whole earth.

refs.text_gb: 祂的头与发皆白，如白羊毛、如雪，眼目如同火焰，
refs.text_big5: 祂的頭與髮皆白，如白羊毛、如雪，眼目如同火焰，
refs.text_en: And His head and hair were as white as white wool, as snow; and His eyes were like a flame of fire;

refs.text_gb: 约翰写信给在亚西亚的七个召会：愿恩典与平安，从那今是昔是以后永是的，从祂宝座前的七灵，
refs.text_big5: 約翰寫信給在亞西亞的七個召會：願恩典與平安，從那今是昔是以後永是的，從祂寶座前的七靈，
refs.text_en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from Him who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven Spirits who are before His throne,

refs.text_gb: 你要写信给在撒狄的召会的使者，说，那有神的七灵和七星的，这样说，我知道你的行为，按名你是活的，其实是死的。
refs.text_big5: 你要寫信給在撒狄的召會的使者，說，那有神的七靈和七星的，這樣說，我知道你的行為，按名你是活的，其實是死的。
refs.text_en: And to the messenger of the church in Sardis write: These things says He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I know your works, that you have a name that you are living, and yet you are dead.

refs.text_gb: 有闪电、声音、雷轰，从宝座中发出。又有七盏火灯在宝座前点着，这七灯就是神的七灵。
refs.text_big5: 有閃電、聲音、雷轟，從寶座中發出。又有七盞火燈在寶座前點著，這七燈就是神的七靈。
refs.text_en: And out of the throne come forth lightnings and voices and thunders. And there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God;

refs.text_gb: 谁藐视这日的事为小呢？这七眼乃是耶和华的眼睛，遍察全地，见所罗巴伯手拿线铊就欢喜。
refs.text_big5: 誰藐視這日的事為小呢？這七眼乃是耶和華的眼睛，遍察全地，見所羅巴伯手拿線鉈就歡喜。
refs.text_en: For who has despised the day of small things? For these seven rejoice when they see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel; they are the eyes of Jehovah running to and fro on the whole earth.

verses.text_gb: 这羔羊前来，从坐宝座的右手中拿了书卷。
verses.text_big5: 這羔羊前來，從坐寶座的右手中拿了書卷。
verses.text_en: And He came and took the scroll out of the right hand of Him who sits upon the throne.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这羔羊前来，从坐宝座的右手中拿了书卷。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這羔羊前來，從坐寶座的右手中拿了書卷。

verses.text_gb: 当祂拿书卷的时候，四[Cra]活物和二[Crb]十四位长老，都俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴[Crc]，和盛满了香[Fn1][Crd]的金[Cre]炉[Fn2]，这香炉就是众圣徒的祷[Crf]告。
verses.text_big5: 當祂拿書卷的時候，四[Cra]活物和二[Crb]十四位長老，都俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿著琴[Crc]，和盛滿了香[Fn1][Crd]的金[Cre]爐[Fn2]，這香爐就是眾聖徒的禱[Crf]告。
verses.text_en: And when He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, each having a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which bowls are the prayers of the saints.
verses.text_gb_plain: 当祂拿书卷的时候，四活物和二十四位长老，都俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴，和盛满了香的金炉，这香炉就是众圣徒的祷告。
verses.text_big5_plain: 當祂拿書卷的時候，四活物和二十四位長老，都俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿著琴，和盛滿了香的金爐，這香爐就是眾聖徒的禱告。

footnotes.zh: 原文，复数。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文，複數。
footnotes.en: 5:8 1 bowls The bowls are the saints' prayers brought to God by the angelic elders (cf. Rev. 8:3-4), whereas the incense is Christ added to the saints' prayers. See note Rev. 8:3 4 . That in their worship to God the twenty-four angelic elders are holding the golden bowls full of incense shows that they, as priests, are ministering to God by bringing the saints' prayers to Him.

footnotes.zh: 原文是碗(复数)，用作香炉。炉是众圣徒的祷告，由天使的长老带到神面前(参八3～4)；香是加在众圣徒祷告里的基督。见八3注4。这天使中的二十四位长老，在敬拜神的时候拿着盛满了香的金炉，乃说明他们是祭司事奉神，把圣徒的祷告带给神。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文是碗（複數），用作香爐。爐是眾聖徒的禱告，由天使的長老帶到神面前；（參八3～4；）香是加在眾聖徒禱告裏的基督。見八3註4。這天使中的二十四位長老，在敬拜神的時候拿著盛滿了香的金爐，乃說明他們是祭司事奉神，把聖徒的禱告帶給神。
footnotes.en: 5:8 2 incense Lit., incenses.

refs.text_gb: 宝座前好像一个玻璃海，如同水晶；宝座中、和宝座周围有四个活物，前后满了眼睛。
refs.text_big5: 寶座前好像一個玻璃海，如同水晶；寶座中、和寶座周圍有四個活物，前後滿了眼睛。
refs.text_en: And before the throne there was as it were a glassy sea like crystal; and in the midst of the throne and around the throne, there were four living creatures full of eyes in front and behind.

refs.text_gb: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个活物像牛犊，第三个活物脸面像人，第四个活物像飞鹰。
refs.text_big5: 第一個活物像獅子，第二個活物像牛犢，第三個活物臉面像人，第四個活物像飛鷹。
refs.text_en: And the first living creature was like a lion, and the second living creature like a calf, and the third living creature had a face like that of a man, and the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.

refs.text_gb: 四活物各个都有六个翅膀，周围和里面统满了眼睛；他们昼夜不歇息的说，圣哉，圣哉，圣哉，主神是昔是今是以后永是的全能者。
refs.text_big5: 四活物各個都有六個翅膀，周圍和裏面統滿了眼睛；他們晝夜不歇息的說，聖哉，聖哉，聖哉，主神是昔是今是以後永是的全能者。
refs.text_en: And the four living creatures, each one of them having six wings apiece, are full of eyes around and within; and they have no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God the Almighty, who was and who is and who is coming.

refs.text_gb: 每逢四活物将荣耀、尊贵、感谢，归与那坐在宝座上，活到永永远远者的时候，
refs.text_big5: 每逢四活物將榮耀、尊貴、感謝，歸與那坐在寶座上，活到永永遠遠者的時候，
refs.text_en: And when the four living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to Him who sits upon the throne, to Him who lives forever and ever,

refs.text_gb: 宝座的周围，又有二十四个宝座，其上坐着二十四位长老，身穿白衣，头戴金冠。
refs.text_big5: 寶座的周圍，又有二十四個寶座，其上坐著二十四位長老，身穿白衣，頭戴金冠。
refs.text_en: And around the throne there were twenty-four thrones, and upon the thrones twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white garments, and upon their heads golden crowns.

refs.text_gb: 那二十四位长老，就俯伏在坐宝座的面前，敬拜那活到永永远远的，又把他们的冠冕投在宝座前，说，
refs.text_big5: 那二十四位長老，就俯伏在坐寶座的面前，敬拜那活到永永遠遠的，又把他們的冠冕投在寶座前，說，
refs.text_en: The twenty-four elders will fall before Him who sits upon the throne and worship Him who lives forever and ever; and they will cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

refs.text_gb: 我们的主，我们的神，你是配得荣耀、尊贵、能力的，因为你创造了万有，并且万有是因你的旨意存在并被创造的。
refs.text_big5: 我們的主，我們的神，你是配得榮耀、尊貴、能力的，因為你創造了萬有，並且萬有是因你的旨意存在並被創造的。
refs.text_en: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for You have created all things, and because of Your will they were, and were created.

refs.text_gb: 我听见从天上有声音，像众水的声音，又像大雷的声音，并且我所听见的，好像弹琴的所弹的琴声。
refs.text_big5: 我聽見從天上有聲音，像眾水的聲音，又像大雷的聲音，並且我所聽見的，好像彈琴的所彈的琴聲。
refs.text_en: And I heard a voice out of heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of loud thunder; and the voice which I heard was like the sound of harp-singers playing on their harps.

refs.text_gb: 另一位天使拿着金香炉，来站在祭坛旁边，有许多香赐给祂，好同众圣徒的祷告献在宝座前的金坛上。
refs.text_big5: 另一位天使拿著金香爐，來站在祭壇旁邊，有許多香賜給祂，好同眾聖徒的禱告獻在寶座前的金壇上。
refs.text_en: And another Angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer, and much incense was given to Him to offer with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你要取馨香的香料，就是苏合香、香螺、白松香；这些馨香的香料和纯乳香，各样的分量要相等。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你要取馨香的香料，就是蘇合香、香螺、白松香；這些馨香的香料和純乳香，各樣的分量要相等。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take fragrant spices-stacte and onycha and galbanum-fragrant spices with pure frankincense; there shall be an equal part of each;

refs.text_gb: 你要用这些加上盐，按调制香品者之法作成香品，作成纯净圣别的香。
refs.text_big5: 你要用這些加上鹽，按調製香品者之法作成香品，作成純淨聖別的香。
refs.text_en: And you shall make of it incense, a fragrant compound according to the work of a compounder, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

refs.text_gb: 这香要取些捣得极细，放些在会幕内见证的柜前，我要在那里与你相会；你们要以这香为至圣。
refs.text_big5: 這香要取些搗得極細，放些在會幕內見證的櫃前，我要在那裏與你相會；你們要以這香為至聖。
refs.text_en: And you shall beat some of it very fine, and put some of it before the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you; it shall be to you most holy.

refs.text_gb: 你们为自己调制的香，不可按这些成分调制；要以这香为圣，归耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 你們為自己調製的香，不可按這些成分調製；要以這香為聖，歸耶和華。
refs.text_en: And the incense which you shall make, you shall not make for yourselves according to its composition; it shall be holy to you for Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 凡作香和这香一样，为要闻香味的，这人要从民中剪除。
refs.text_big5: 凡作香和這香一樣，為要聞香味的，這人要從民中剪除。
refs.text_en: Whoever shall make any like it, to smell it, shall be cut off from his people.

refs.text_gb: 另一位天使拿着金香炉，来站在祭坛旁边，有许多香赐给祂，好同众圣徒的祷告献在宝座前的金坛上。
refs.text_big5: 另一位天使拿著金香爐，來站在祭壇旁邊，有許多香賜給祂，好同眾聖徒的禱告獻在寶座前的金壇上。
refs.text_en: And another Angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer, and much incense was given to Him to offer with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

refs.text_gb: 那天使拿着香炉，盛满了坛上的火，丢在地上，于是有雷轰、声音、闪电、地震。
refs.text_big5: 那天使拿著香爐，盛滿了壇上的火，丟在地上，於是有雷轟、聲音、閃電、地震。
refs.text_en: And the Angel took the censer and filled it with the fire of the altar and cast it to the earth; and there were thunders and voices and lightnings and an earthquake.

refs.text_gb: 另一位天使拿着金香炉，来站在祭坛旁边，有许多香赐给祂，好同众圣徒的祷告献在宝座前的金坛上。
refs.text_big5: 另一位天使拿著金香爐，來站在祭壇旁邊，有許多香賜給祂，好同眾聖徒的禱告獻在寶座前的金壇上。
refs.text_en: And another Angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer, and much incense was given to Him to offer with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

refs.text_gb: 那香的烟同众圣徒的祷告，从那天使手中上升于神面前。
refs.text_big5: 那香的煙同眾聖徒的禱告，從那天使手中上升於神面前。
refs.text_en: And the smoke of the incense went up with the prayers of the saints out of the hand of the Angel before God.

refs.text_gb: 烧香的时候，全群的百姓在外面祷告。
refs.text_big5: 燒香的時候，全群的百姓在外面禱告。
refs.text_en: And all the multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of the burning of incense.

verses.text_gb: 他们唱新[Fn1][Cra]歌，说，你配[Fn2][Crb]拿书卷，配揭开它的七印，因为你曾被杀[Crc]，用[Fn3]自己的血[Crd]从各[Cre]支派、各方言、各民族、各邦国中，买[Crf]了人来归与神，

verses.text_big5_plain: 他們唱新歌，說，你配拿書卷，配揭開它的七印，因為你曾被殺，用自己的血從各支派、各方言、各民族、各邦國中，買了人來歸與神，

footnotes.zh: 这里的歌是新的，因为他们所赞美的羔羊，是刚被杀的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的歌是新的，因為他們所讚美的羔羊，是剛被殺的。
footnotes.en: 5:9 1 new The song here is new because the Lamb whom it praises had just been slain.

footnotes.zh: 在全宇宙中，除了那得胜的狮子，救赎的羔羊基督之外，没有一位配揭开神经纶的奥秘。祂是得胜的狮子，为神击败了撒但；又是救赎的羔羊，为我们除去了罪。惟有祂够资格揭开并完成神经纶的奥秘。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在全宇宙中，除了那得勝的獅子，救贖的羔羊基督之外，沒有一位配揭開神經綸的奧祕。祂是得勝的獅子，為神擊敗了撒但；又是救贖的羔羊，為我們除去了罪。惟有祂彀資格揭開並完成神經綸的奧祕。
footnotes.en: 5:9 2 worthy In the whole universe no one is worthy to open the mystery of God's economy but Christ, the overcoming Lion and the redeeming Lamb. As the overcoming Lion, He defeated Satan for God, and as the redeeming Lamb, He put sin away for us. He is the only One qualified to unveil and carry out the mystery of God's economy.

footnotes.zh: 直译，在自己的血里。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，在自己的血裏。
footnotes.en: 5:9 3 by Lit., in.

refs.text_gb: 他们在宝座前，并在四活物和众长老前唱新歌；除了从地上买来的那十四万四千人以外，没有人能学这歌。
refs.text_big5: 他們在寶座前，並在四活物和眾長老前唱新歌；除了從地上買來的那十四萬四千人以外，沒有人能學這歌。
refs.text_en: And they sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one could learn the song except the hundred and forty-four thousand, who have been purchased from the earth.

refs.text_gb: 祂赐新歌在我口中，就是对我们神的赞美。许多人必看见而惧怕，并要倚靠耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 祂賜新歌在我口中，就是對我們神的讚美。許多人必看見而懼怕，並要倚靠耶和華。
refs.text_en: Then He put a new song in my mouth, / A praise to our God. / Many see it and fear, / And they trust in Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见一位大力的天使，大声宣传说，有谁配展开那书卷，揭开它的七印？
refs.text_big5: 我又看見一位大力的天使，大聲宣傳說，有誰配展開那書卷，揭開它的七印？
refs.text_en: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the scroll and to break its seals?

refs.text_gb: 我们的主，我们的神，你是配得荣耀、尊贵、能力的，因为你创造了万有，并且万有是因你的旨意存在并被创造的。
refs.text_big5: 我們的主，我們的神，你是配得榮耀、尊貴、能力的，因為你創造了萬有，並且萬有是因你的旨意存在並被創造的。
refs.text_en: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for You have created all things, and because of Your will they were, and were created.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见宝座与四活物中间，并众长老中间，有羔羊站立，像是刚被杀过的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見寶座與四活物中間，並眾長老中間，有羔羊站立，像是剛被殺過的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_en: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders a Lamb standing as having just been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

refs.text_gb: 并从那忠信的见证人、死人中的首生者、为地上君王元首的耶稣基督，归与你们。祂爱我们，用自己的血，把我们从我们的罪中释放了；
refs.text_big5: 並從那忠信的見證人、死人中的首生者、為地上君王元首的耶穌基督，歸與你們。祂愛我們，用自己的血，把我們從我們的罪中釋放了；
refs.text_en: And from Jesus Christ, the faithful Witness, the Firstborn of the dead, and the Ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood

refs.text_gb: 这些事以后，我观看，看哪，有大批的群众，没有人能数得过来，是从各邦国、各支派、各民族、各方言来的，站在宝座前和羔羊面前，身穿白袍，手拿棕树枝，
refs.text_big5: 這些事以後，我觀看，看哪，有大批的群眾，沒有人能數得過來，是從各邦國、各支派、各民族、各方言來的，站在寶座前和羔羊面前，身穿白袍，手拿棕樹枝，
refs.text_en: After these things I saw, and behold, there was a great multitude which no one could number, out of every nation and all tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes and palm branches in their hands.

refs.text_gb: 他们在宝座前，并在四活物和众长老前唱新歌；除了从地上买来的那十四万四千人以外，没有人能学这歌。
refs.text_big5: 他們在寶座前，並在四活物和眾長老前唱新歌；除了從地上買來的那十四萬四千人以外，沒有人能學這歌。
refs.text_en: And they sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one could learn the song except the hundred and forty-four thousand, who have been purchased from the earth.

refs.text_gb: 因为你们是重价买来的。这样，就要在你们的身体上荣耀神。
refs.text_big5: 因為你們是重價買來的。這樣，就要在你們的身體上榮耀神。
refs.text_en: For you have been bought with a price. So then glorify God in your body.

refs.text_gb: 知道你们得赎，脱离你们祖宗所传流虚妄的生活，不是用能坏的金银等物，
refs.text_big5: 知道你們得贖，脫離你們祖宗所傳流虛妄的生活，不是用能壞的金銀等物，
refs.text_en: Knowing that it was not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, that you were redeemed from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers,

refs.text_gb: 乃是用基督的宝血，如同无瑕疵无玷污的羔羊之血。
refs.text_big5: 乃是用基督的寶血，如同無瑕疵無玷污的羔羊之血。
refs.text_en: But with precious blood, as of a Lamb without blemish and without spot, the blood of Christ;

verses.text_gb: 又叫他[Fn1]们成为国[Fn2][Cra]度，作祭司，归与我们的神；他们要在地上执[Crb]掌王权。
verses.text_big5: 又叫他[Fn1]們成為國[Fn2][Cra]度，作祭司，歸與我們的神；他們要在地上執[Crb]掌王權。
verses.text_en: And have made them a kingdom and priests to our God; and they will reign on the earth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又叫他们成为国度，作祭司，归与我们的神；他们要在地上执掌王权。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又叫他們成為國度，作祭司，歸與我們的神；他們要在地上執掌王權。

footnotes.zh: “他们”指蒙救赎的人(9)。二十四位长老的赞美称这些蒙救赎的人作“他们，”证明这些赞美的长老不是召会的长老，乃是天使的长老。

refs.text_gb: 又使我们成为国度，作祂神与父的祭司；愿荣耀权能归与祂，直到永永远远。阿们。

refs.text_en: And made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father, to Him be the glory and the might forever and ever. Amen.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见几个宝座和坐在上面的，有审判的权柄赐给他们。我又看见那些为耶稣的见证、并为神的话被斩者，以及那些没有拜过兽与兽像，额上和手上也没有受过它印记之人的魂，他们都活了，与基督一同作王一千年。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見幾個寶座和坐在上面的，有審判的權柄賜給他們。我又看見那些為耶穌的見證、並為神的話被斬者，以及那些沒有拜過獸與獸像，額上和手上也沒有受過牠印記之人的魂，他們都活了，與基督一同作王一千年。
refs.text_en: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and of those who had not worshipped the beast nor his image, and had not received the mark on their forehead and on their hand; and they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

refs.text_en: And he who overcomes and he who keeps My works until the end, to him I will give authority over the nations;

refs.text_big5: 他必用鐵杖轄管他們，將他們如同窯戶的瓦器打得粉碎，像我從我父領受的權柄一樣；
refs.text_en: And he will shepherd them with an iron rod, as vessels of pottery are broken in pieces, as I also have received from My Father;

refs.text_big5: 婦人生了一個男孩子，是將來要用鐵杖轄管萬國的；她的孩子被提到神和祂的寶座那裏去了。
refs.text_en: And she brought forth a son, a man-child, who is to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod; and her child was caught up to God and to His throne.

refs.text_gb: 我们如果忍耐，也必与祂一同作王；我们如果不认祂，祂也必不认我们；
refs.text_big5: 我們如果忍耐，也必與祂一同作王；我們如果不認祂，祂也必不認我們；
refs.text_en: If we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He also will deny us;

verses.text_gb: 我又看见，且听见，宝座与活物并长老的周围，有许[Fn1]多天使的声音；他们的数目有千[Cra]千万万，
verses.text_big5: 我又看見，且聽見，寶座與活物並長老的周圍，有許[Fn1]多天使的聲音；他們的數目有千[Cra]千萬萬，
verses.text_en: And I saw, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne and of the living creatures and of the elders, and their number was ten thousands of ten thousands and thousands of thousands,
verses.text_gb_plain: 我又看见，且听见，宝座与活物并长老的周围，有许多天使的声音；他们的数目有千千万万，
verses.text_big5_plain: 我又看見，且聽見，寶座與活物並長老的周圍，有許多天使的聲音；他們的數目有千千萬萬，

footnotes.zh: 二十四位长老所代表的许多天使，随着他们向羔羊献上天使的赞美。
footnotes.zh_big5: 二十四位長老所代表的許多天使，隨著他們向羔羊獻上天使的讚美。
footnotes.en: 5:11 1 many The many angels, represented by the twenty-four elders, follow the elders to render to the Lamb the angelic praise.

refs.text_gb: 从祂面前有火河流出。事奉祂的有千千，侍立在祂面前的有万万。审判者已经坐庭，案卷都展开了。
refs.text_big5: 從祂面前有火河流出。事奉祂的有千千，侍立在祂面前的有萬萬。審判者已經坐庭，案卷都展開了。
refs.text_en: A stream of fire issued forth / And came out from before Him. / Thousands of thousands ministered to Him, / And ten thousands of ten thousands stood before Him. / The court of judgment sat, / And the books were opened.

refs.text_gb: 但你们乃是来到锡安山，来到活神的城，属天的耶路撒冷，来到千万天使整体的聚集，
refs.text_big5: 但你們乃是來到錫安山，來到活神的城，屬天的耶路撒冷，來到千萬天使整體的聚集，
refs.text_en: But you have come forward to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem; and to myriads of angels, to the universal gathering;

verses.text_gb: 大声说，曾被杀[Cra]的羔[Crb]羊，是配[Crc]得能[Crd]力、丰[Cre]富、智慧、力量、尊贵、荣[Crf]耀、颂[Crg]赞的。
verses.text_big5: 大聲說，曾被殺[Cra]的羔[Crb]羊，是配[Crc]得能[Crd]力、豐[Cre]富、智慧、力量、尊貴、榮[Crf]耀、頌[Crg]讚的。
verses.text_en: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.
verses.text_gb_plain: 大声说，曾被杀的羔羊，是配得能力、丰富、智慧、力量、尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 大聲說，曾被殺的羔羊，是配得能力、豐富、智慧、力量、尊貴、榮耀、頌讚的。

refs.text_gb: 我又看见宝座与四活物中间，并众长老中间，有羔羊站立，像是刚被杀过的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見寶座與四活物中間，並眾長老中間，有羔羊站立，像是剛被殺過的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_en: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders a Lamb standing as having just been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见宝座与四活物中间，并众长老中间，有羔羊站立，像是刚被杀过的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見寶座與四活物中間，並眾長老中間，有羔羊站立，像是剛被殺過的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_en: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders a Lamb standing as having just been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

refs.text_gb: 我们的主，我们的神，你是配得荣耀、尊贵、能力的，因为你创造了万有，并且万有是因你的旨意存在并被创造的。
refs.text_big5: 我們的主，我們的神，你是配得榮耀、尊貴、能力的，因為你創造了萬有，並且萬有是因你的旨意存在並被創造的。
refs.text_en: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for You have created all things, and because of Your will they were, and were created.

refs.text_gb: 他们唱新歌，说，你配拿书卷，配揭开它的七印，因为你曾被杀，用自己的血从各支派、各方言、各民族、各邦国中，买了人来归与神，
refs.text_big5: 他們唱新歌，說，你配拿書卷，配揭開它的七印，因為你曾被殺，用自己的血從各支派、各方言、各民族、各邦國中，買了人來歸與神，
refs.text_en: And they sing a new song, saying: You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, for You were slain and have purchased for God by Your blood men out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation,

refs.text_gb: 我们的主，我们的神，你是配得荣耀、尊贵、能力的，因为你创造了万有，并且万有是因你的旨意存在并被创造的。
refs.text_big5: 我們的主，我們的神，你是配得榮耀、尊貴、能力的，因為你創造了萬有，並且萬有是因你的旨意存在並被創造的。
refs.text_en: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for You have created all things, and because of Your will they were, and were created.

refs.text_gb: 深哉，神的丰富、智慧和知识！祂的判断何其难测，祂的道路何其难寻！
refs.text_big5: 深哉，神的豐富、智慧和知識！祂的判斷何其難測，祂的道路何其難尋！
refs.text_en: Oh, the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments and untraceable His ways!

refs.text_gb: 又使我们成为国度，作祂神与父的祭司；愿荣耀权能归与祂，直到永永远远。阿们。
refs.text_big5: 又使我們成為國度，作祂神與父的祭司；願榮耀權能歸與祂，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
refs.text_en: And made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father, to Him be the glory and the might forever and ever. Amen.

refs.text_gb: 阿们。愿颂赞、荣耀、智慧、感谢、尊贵、能力、力量，都归与我们的神，直到永永远远。阿们。
refs.text_big5: 阿們。願頌讚、榮耀、智慧、感謝、尊貴、能力、力量，都歸與我們的神，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
refs.text_en: Saying, Amen. The blessing and the glory and the wisdom and the thanks and the honor and the power and the strength be to our God forever and ever. Amen.

verses.text_gb: 我又听见在[Cra]天上、地上、地底下、沧海里的一[Fn1]切受造之物，以及天地间的万有都说，但愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、权能，都归与坐宝座的和羔[Crb]羊，直到永永远远。
verses.text_big5: 我又聽見在[Cra]天上、地上、地底下、滄海裏的一[Fn1]切受造之物，以及天地間的萬有都說，但願頌讚、尊貴、榮耀、權能，都歸與坐寶座的和羔[Crb]羊，直到永永遠遠。
verses.text_en: And every creature which is in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and on the sea and all things in them, I heard saying, To Him who sits upon the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing and the honor and the glory and the might forever and ever.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我又听见在天上、地上、地底下、沧海里的一切受造之物，以及天地间的万有都说，但愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、权能，都归与坐宝座的和羔羊，直到永永远远。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我又聽見在天上、地上、地底下、滄海裏的一切受造之物，以及天地間的萬有都說，但願頌讚、尊貴、榮耀、權能，都歸與坐寶座的和羔羊，直到永永遠遠。

footnotes.zh: 四活物所代表的一切受造之物随着他们，向羔羊献上除天使之外所有受造之物宇宙的赞美。
footnotes.zh_big5: 四活物所代表的一切受造之物隨著他們，向羔羊獻上除天使之外所有受造之物宇宙的讚美。
footnotes.en: 5:13 1 every All the creatures, who are represented by the four living creatures, follow the living creatures to give the Lamb the universal praise of all creatures other than the angels.

refs.text_gb: 叫天上的、地上的和地底下的，在耶稣的名里，万膝都要跪拜，
refs.text_big5: 叫天上的、地上的和地底下的，在耶穌的名裏，萬膝都要跪拜，
refs.text_en: That in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those who are in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

refs.text_gb: 我又看见宝座与四活物中间，并众长老中间，有羔羊站立，像是刚被杀过的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見寶座與四活物中間，並眾長老中間，有羔羊站立，像是剛被殺過的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_en: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders a Lamb standing as having just been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

verses.text_gb: 四活物就说，阿[Cra]们。众长老也俯伏敬拜。
verses.text_big5: 四活物就說，阿[Cra]們。眾長老也俯伏敬拜。
verses.text_en: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.
verses.text_gb_plain: 四活物就说，阿们。众长老也俯伏敬拜。
verses.text_big5_plain: 四活物就說，阿們。眾長老也俯伏敬拜。

refs.text_gb: 阿们。愿颂赞、荣耀、智慧、感谢、尊贵、能力、力量，都归与我们的神，直到永永远远。阿们。
refs.text_big5: 阿們。願頌讚、榮耀、智慧、感謝、尊貴、能力、力量，都歸與我們的神，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
refs.text_en: Saying, Amen. The blessing and the glory and the wisdom and the thanks and the honor and the power and the strength be to our God forever and ever. Amen.

refs.text_gb: 那二十四位长老与四活物，就俯伏敬拜那坐宝座的神，说，阿们，阿利路亚！
refs.text_big5: 那二十四位長老與四活物，就俯伏敬拜那坐寶座的神，說，阿們，阿利路亞！
refs.text_en: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God, who sits upon the throne, saying, Amen, Hallelujah!

verses.text_gb: 羔[Cra]羊揭[Fn1]开七[Crb]印中第一印的时候，我观看，就听见四[Crc]活[Fn2]物中的一个，声[Crd]音如雷，说，你来[Cre]。
verses.text_big5: 羔[Cra]羊揭[Fn1]開七[Crb]印中第一印的時候，我觀看，就聽見四[Crc]活[Fn2]物中的一個，聲[Crd]音如雷，說，你來[Cre]。
verses.text_en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying like the sound of thunder, Come.
verses.text_gb_plain: 羔羊揭开七印中第一印的时候，我观看，就听见四活物中的一个，声音如雷，说，你来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 羔羊揭開七印中第一印的時候，我觀看，就聽見四活物中的一個，聲音如雷，說，你來。

footnotes.zh: 羔羊揭开七印，是紧接在基督升天之后。基督借着成为肉体、钉死十架并复活，就完全够资格在祂的升天里揭开七印所包含神经纶的奥秘。
footnotes.zh_big5: 羔羊揭開七印，是緊接在基督升天之後。基督藉著成為肉體、釘死十架並復活，就完全彀資格在祂的升天裏揭開七印所包含神經綸的奧祕。
footnotes.en: 6:1 1 opened The opening of the seven seals by the Lamb occurred immediately after Christ ascended to the heavens. Through His incarnation, crucifixion, and resurrection, Christ became fully qualified in His ascension to open the mystery of God's economy, which is contained in the seven seals.

footnotes.zh: 因为神对受造之物的经纶包含在七印中，所以四活物很有兴趣的分别宣布头四印的揭开。
footnotes.zh_big5: 因為神對受造之物的經綸包含在七印中，所以四活物很有興趣的分別宣佈頭四印的揭開。
footnotes.en: 6:1 2 living Because God's economy concerning the creatures is contained in the seven seals, the four living creatures are interested in announcing, respectively, the opening of the first four seals.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见宝座与四活物中间，并众长老中间，有羔羊站立，像是刚被杀过的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見寶座與四活物中間，並眾長老中間，有羔羊站立，像是剛被殺過的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_en: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders a Lamb standing as having just been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

refs.text_gb: 我看见坐宝座的右手中有书卷，里外都写着字，用七印封严了。
refs.text_big5: 我看見坐寶座的右手中有書卷，裏外都寫著字，用七印封嚴了。
refs.text_en: And I saw on the right hand of Him who sits upon the throne a scroll written within and on the back, sealed up with seven seals.

refs.text_gb: 宝座前好像一个玻璃海，如同水晶；宝座中、和宝座周围有四个活物，前后满了眼睛。
refs.text_big5: 寶座前好像一個玻璃海，如同水晶；寶座中、和寶座周圍有四個活物，前後滿了眼睛。
refs.text_en: And before the throne there was as it were a glassy sea like crystal; and in the midst of the throne and around the throne, there were four living creatures full of eyes in front and behind.

refs.text_gb: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个活物像牛犊，第三个活物脸面像人，第四个活物像飞鹰。
refs.text_big5: 第一個活物像獅子，第二個活物像牛犢，第三個活物臉面像人，第四個活物像飛鷹。
refs.text_en: And the first living creature was like a lion, and the second living creature like a calf, and the third living creature had a face like that of a man, and the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.

refs.text_gb: 四活物各个都有六个翅膀，周围和里面统满了眼睛；他们昼夜不歇息的说，圣哉，圣哉，圣哉，主神是昔是今是以后永是的全能者。
refs.text_big5: 四活物各個都有六個翅膀，周圍和裏面統滿了眼睛；他們晝夜不歇息的說，聖哉，聖哉，聖哉，主神是昔是今是以後永是的全能者。
refs.text_en: And the four living creatures, each one of them having six wings apiece, are full of eyes around and within; and they have no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God the Almighty, who was and who is and who is coming.

refs.text_gb: 每逢四活物将荣耀、尊贵、感谢，归与那坐在宝座上，活到永永远远者的时候，
refs.text_big5: 每逢四活物將榮耀、尊貴、感謝，歸與那坐在寶座上，活到永永遠遠者的時候，
refs.text_en: And when the four living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to Him who sits upon the throne, to Him who lives forever and ever,

refs.text_gb: 大声呼喊，好像狮子吼叫，呼喊完了，就有七雷发声说话。
refs.text_big5: 大聲呼喊，好像獅子吼叫，呼喊完了，就有七雷發聲說話。
refs.text_en: And He cried out with a loud voice just as a lion roars. And when He cried out, the seven thunders uttered their own voices.

refs.text_gb: 我听见从天上有声音，像众水的声音，又像大雷的声音，并且我所听见的，好像弹琴的所弹的琴声。
refs.text_big5: 我聽見從天上有聲音，像眾水的聲音，又像大雷的聲音，並且我所聽見的，好像彈琴的所彈的琴聲。
refs.text_en: And I heard a voice out of heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of loud thunder; and the voice which I heard was like the sound of harp-singers playing on their harps.

refs.text_gb: 我听见好像大批群众的声音，又像众水的声音，也像大雷的声音，说，阿利路亚！因为主我们的神，全能者，作王了。
refs.text_big5: 我聽見好像大批群眾的聲音，又像眾水的聲音，也像大雷的聲音，說，阿利路亞！因為主我們的神，全能者，作王了。
refs.text_en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude and like the sound of many waters and like the sound of mighty thunders, saying, Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.

refs.text_gb: 羔羊揭开第二印的时候，我听见第二个活物说，你来。
refs.text_big5: 羔羊揭開第二印的時候，我聽見第二個活物說，你來。
refs.text_en: And when He opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come.

refs.text_gb: 羔羊揭开第三印的时候，我听见第三个活物说，你来。我就观看，看哪，有一匹黑马，骑在马上的手里拿着天平。
refs.text_big5: 羔羊揭開第三印的時候，我聽見第三個活物說，你來。我就觀看，看哪，有一匹黑馬，騎在馬上的手裏拿著天平。
refs.text_en: And when He opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, Come. And I saw, and behold, a black horse; and he who sits on it had a balance in his hand.

refs.text_gb: 羔羊揭开第四印的时候，我听见第四个活物的声音说，你来。
refs.text_big5: 羔羊揭開第四印的時候，我聽見第四個活物的聲音說，你來。
refs.text_en: And when He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, Come.

verses.text_gb: 我就观看，看哪，有一匹白[Fn1][Cra]马，骑[Fn2]在马上的拿着弓[Fn3]，并有冠[Fn4][Crb]冕赐给他，他便出[Crc]去，胜[Fn5][Crd]了又要胜。
verses.text_big5: 我就觀看，看哪，有一匹白[Fn1][Cra]馬，騎[Fn2]在馬上的拿著弓[Fn3]，並有冠[Fn4][Crb]冕賜給他，他便出[Crc]去，勝[Fn5][Crd]了又要勝。
verses.text_en: And I saw, and behold, a white horse, and he who sits on it had a bow; and a crown was given to him, and he went forth conquering and to conquer.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我就观看，看哪，有一匹白马，骑在马上的拿着弓，并有冠冕赐给他，他便出去，胜了又要胜。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我就觀看，看哪，有一匹白馬，騎在馬上的拿著弓，並有冠冕賜給他，他便出去，勝了又要勝。

footnotes.zh: “白”表征清洁、纯一、公义并可蒙称许。白马象征福音的传扬，不论对人对神，都是清洁、纯一、公义并可蒙称许的。
footnotes.zh_big5: “白”表徵清潔、純一、公義並可蒙稱許。白馬象徵福音的傳揚，不論對人對神，都是清潔、純一、公義並可蒙稱許的。
footnotes.en: 6:2 1 white White signifies clean, pure, just, and approvable. The white horse is a symbol of the preaching of the gospel, which is clean, pure, just, and approvable in the eyes of both man and God.

footnotes.zh: 头四印包括四匹马以及骑在马上的，犹如一场四马竞赛。四个骑马的都不是真人，而是人位化的事物。显然骑第二匹马(红马)的，是战争(4)；骑第三匹马(黑马)的，是饥荒(5)；骑第四匹马(灰马)的，是死亡(8)。根据历史事实，骑第一匹马(白马)的，必定是福音，而非指有些人所解释的基督或敌基督。紧接基督升天之后，福音、战争、饥荒和死亡这四件事，便像四个骑马的骑在四匹马上，开始奔跑，一直持续到基督回来。从第一世纪开始，经过了这二十个世纪，福音不断地广传，同时战争也不断地在人类中间进行。战争常是造成饥荒，饥荒便带来死亡。这些都要持续到这世代的末了。
footnotes.zh_big5: 頭四印包括四匹馬以及騎在馬上的，猶如一場四馬競賽。四個騎馬的都不是真人，而是人位化的事物。顯然騎第二匹馬（紅馬）的，是戰爭；（4；）騎第三匹馬（黑馬）的，是饑荒；（5；）騎第四匹馬（灰馬）的，是死亡。（8。）根據歷史事實，騎第一匹馬（白馬）的，必定是福音，而非指有些人所解釋的基督或敵基督。緊接基督升天之後，福音、戰爭、饑荒和死亡這四件事，便像四個騎馬的騎在四匹馬上，開始奔跑，一直持續到基督回來。從第一世紀開始，經過了這二十個世紀，福音不斷的廣傳，同時戰爭也不斷的在人類中間進行。戰爭常是造成饑荒，饑荒便帶來死亡。這些都要持續到這世代的末了。
footnotes.en: 6:2 2 he The first four seals consist of four horses with their riders, as in a four-horse race. The four riders are not persons but personified things. It is evident that the rider of the second horse, the red horse, is war (v. 4), that the rider of the third horse, the black horse, is famine (v. 5), and that the rider of the fourth horse, the pale horse, is death (v. 8). According to historical facts, the rider of the first horse, the white horse, must be the gospel, not Christ or Antichrist as some interpret. Immediately after Christ's ascension, these four things — the gospel, war, famine, and death — began to run like riders on four horses, and they will continue until Christ comes back. Beginning from the first century the gospel has been spreading throughout all these twenty centuries. Simultaneously, war among the human race has been proceeding. War has always caused famine, and famine issues in death. All these will continue until the end of this age.

footnotes.zh: 弓带着箭是为着打仗的。但这里只有弓，没有箭，指明箭已经射出，除灭仇敌，并且已经得胜，使和平的福音得以构成。如今争战已经结束，和平的福音得以和平的宣扬出去。
footnotes.zh_big5: 弓帶著箭是為著打仗的。但這裏只有弓，沒有箭，指明箭已經射出，除滅仇敵，並且已經得勝，使和平的福音得以構成。如今爭戰已經結束，和平的福音得以和平的宣揚出去。
footnotes.en: 6:2 3 bow A bow with an arrow is for fighting. But here there is a bow without an arrow. This indicates that the arrow has already been shot to destroy the enemy and that the victory has been won for the constituting of the gospel of peace. Now the fighting is over, and the gospel of peace is being proclaimed in a peaceful way.

footnotes.zh: 冠冕是荣耀的标记。福音已经戴上“基督的荣耀”为冠冕(林后四4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 冠冕是榮耀的標記。福音已經戴上“基督的榮耀”為冠冕。（林後四4。）
footnotes.en: 6:2 4 crown A crown is a sign of glory. The gospel has been crowned with the glory of Christ (2 Cor. 4:4).

footnotes.zh: 或，征服了又要征服。历代以来，福音无论传到那里，都征服并胜过了各样的抵挡和攻击。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，征服了又要征服。歷代以來，福音無論傳到那裏，都征服並勝過了各樣的抵擋和攻擊。
footnotes.en: 6:2 5 conquering Or, overcoming and to overcome. Throughout all the centuries, wherever the gospel has been proclaimed, it has conquered and overcome all kinds of opposition and attack.

refs.text_gb: 饿死的不如被刀杀的，因为他们缺乏田间的出产，就受折磨，渐渐消瘦死亡。
refs.text_big5: 餓死的不如被刀殺的，因為他們缺乏田間的出產，就受折磨，漸漸消瘦死亡。
refs.text_en: Those who were slain by the sword are better / Than those slain by famine; / For these pine away stricken through, / Because of the lack of the produce of the field.

refs.text_gb: 因为旷野的刀剑，我们冒性命的危险，才得粮食。
refs.text_big5: 因為曠野的刀劍，我們冒性命的危險，纔得糧食。
refs.text_en: We get our bread at the risk of our lives / Because of the sword from the wilderness.

refs.text_gb: 因饥饿的燥热，我们的皮肤黝黑如炉。
refs.text_big5: 因飢餓的燥熱，我們的皮膚黝黑如爐。
refs.text_en: Our skin is black like an oven / Because of the burning heat of famine.

refs.text_gb: 第一辆车套着红马，第二辆车套着黑马，
refs.text_big5: 第一輛車套著紅馬，第二輛車套著黑馬，
refs.text_en: With the first chariot were red horses, and with the second chariot were black horses,

refs.text_gb: 套着黑马的车出来，往北方之地去，白马随后出来；有斑点的马出来，往南方之地去。
refs.text_big5: 套著黑馬的車出來，往北方之地去，白馬隨後出來；有斑點的馬出來，往南方之地去。
refs.text_en: With one of the winds the black horses went forth to the land of the north, and the white horses went forth after them, and the speckled horses went forth to the land of the south.

refs.text_gb: 我要断绝你们所倚靠的粮食；那时，必有十个女人在一个炉子给你们烤饼，再按分量称给你们；你们要吃，也吃不饱。
refs.text_big5: 我要斷絕你們所倚靠的糧食；那時，必有十個女人在一個爐子給你們烤餅，再按分量稱給你們；你們要喫，也喫不飽。
refs.text_en: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in one oven; and they will return your bread by weight, and you will eat and not be satisfied.

verses.text_gb: 我听见在四活物中，仿佛有声音说，一个银[Fn1]币买一[Fn2]升麦子，一个银币买三升大麦，油[Fn3][Cra]和酒不可糟蹋。
verses.text_big5: 我聽見在四活物中，彷彿有聲音說，一個銀[Fn1]幣買一[Fn2]升麥子，一個銀幣買三升大麥，油[Fn3][Cra]和酒不可蹧蹋。
verses.text_en: And I heard as it were a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying: A choenix of wheat for a denarius and three choenixes of barley for a denarius; and do not harm the oil and the wine.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我听见在四活物中，仿佛有声音说，一个银币买一升麦子，一个银币买三升大麦，油和酒不可糟蹋。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我聽見在四活物中，彷彿有聲音說，一個銀幣買一升麥子，一個銀幣買三升大麥，油和酒不可蹧蹋。

footnotes.zh: 罗马的主要银币，算是当时劳工一天很好的报酬(参太二十2)。
footnotes.en: 6:6 1 choenix A dry measure almost equal to a quart.

footnotes.zh: 约等于一公升的干量。
footnotes.zh_big5: 約等於一公升的乾量。
footnotes.en: 6:6 2 denarius A denarius (singular for denarii) was the chief silver coin of the Romans; it was considered good pay for a day's labor (cf. Matt. 20:2).

footnotes.zh: 油和酒是为令人喜悦(诗一○四15)。在饥荒时，油和酒总是缺乏而变得贵重。在饥荒期间，油和酒应当保存，不该蹧蹋。
footnotes.zh_big5: 油和酒是為令人喜悅。（詩一○四15。）在饑荒時，油和酒總是缺乏而變得貴重。在饑荒期間，油和酒應當保存，不該蹧蹋。
footnotes.en: 6:6 3 oil Oil and wine are for man's pleasure (Psa. 104:15). They are always in short supply and become precious in a famine. During the famine, oil and wine should be preserved and not harmed.

refs.text_gb: 至于我，我要住在米斯巴，伺候那到我们这里来的迦勒底人；只是你们当收积酒、夏天的果子和油，放在器皿里，住在你们所占的城邑中。
refs.text_big5: 至於我，我要住在米斯巴，伺候那到我們這裏來的迦勒底人；只是你們當收積酒、夏天的果子和油，放在器皿裏，住在你們所佔的城邑中。
refs.text_en: Now as for me, I will dwell in Mizpah to stand before the Chaldeans who come to us; but you, gather wine and summer fruit and oil and put them in your storage vessels, and dwell in your cities which you have taken.

verses.text_gb: 羔羊揭开第四印的时候，我听见第四个活物的声音说，你来。
verses.text_big5: 羔羊揭開第四印的時候，我聽見第四個活物的聲音說，你來。
verses.text_en: And when He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, Come.
verses.text_gb_plain: 羔羊揭开第四印的时候，我听见第四个活物的声音说，你来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 羔羊揭開第四印的時候，我聽見第四個活物的聲音說，你來。

verses.text_gb: 我就观看，看哪，有一匹灰[Fn1]马，骑在马上的，名字叫作死[Cra]，阴[Fn2][Crb]间也随着他。有权柄赐给他们管辖地的四[Fn3]分之一，用[Crc]刀剑、饥荒、瘟[Fn4]疫、地上的野[Fn5]兽去杀害人。
verses.text_big5: 我就觀看，看哪，有一匹灰[Fn1]馬，騎在馬上的，名字叫作死[Cra]，陰[Fn2][Crb]間也隨著他。有權柄賜給他們管轄地的四[Fn3]分之一，用[Crc]刀劍、饑荒、瘟[Fn4]疫、地上的野[Fn5]獸去殺害人。
verses.text_en: And I saw, and behold, a pale horse, and he who sits upon it, his name is Death; and Hades followed with him. And authority was given to them over the fourth part of the earth to kill with the sword and with famine and with death and by the beasts of the earth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我就观看，看哪，有一匹灰马，骑在马上的，名字叫作死，阴间也随着他。有权柄赐给他们管辖地的四分之一，用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫、地上的野兽去杀害人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我就觀看，看哪，有一匹灰馬，騎在馬上的，名字叫作死，陰間也隨著他。有權柄賜給他們管轄地的四分之一，用刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫、地上的野獸去殺害人。

footnotes.zh: 或，青灰。表明遭受灾害袭击之人的面色。灰马象征死亡的残杀，造成一片灰死的景象。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，青灰。表明遭受災害襲擊之人的面色。灰馬象徵死亡的殘殺，造成一片灰死的景象。
footnotes.en: 6:8 1 pale Or, pale green; signifying the facial color of those stricken with the plague. The pale horse is a symbol of the killing of death, which causes a pale appearance.

footnotes.zh: 阴间是在地底下的地方，不得救的死人，魂要留在那里，到复活后在白色大宝座前受审判(二十11～15)。审判以后，不得救的人要被扔在火湖里，直到永远。阴间好比暂时的拘留所，火湖好比永久的监狱。在这里阴间随着死，接收死所杀害的人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 陰間是在地底下的地方，不得救的死人，魂要留在那裏，到復活後在白色大寶座前受審判。（二十11～15。）審判以後，不得救的人要被扔在火湖裏，直到永遠。陰間好比暫時的拘留所，火湖好比永久的監獄。在這裏陰間隨著死，接收死所殺害的人。
footnotes.en: 6:8 2 Hades Hades is the place under the earth where the souls of the unsaved dead are kept before the dead are resurrected for the judgment of the great white throne (Rev. 20:11-15). After this judgment the unsaved will be cast into the lake of fire for eternity. Hades can be likened to a temporary jail, and the lake of fire to a permanent prison. Here Hades follows death to receive those whom death kills.

footnotes.zh: 直译，第四分之一。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，第四分之一。

footnotes.zh: 或，死亡。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，死亡。
footnotes.en: 6:8 4 beasts To be killed by beasts is God's judgment (2 Kings 2:24; 17:25; Num. 21:6).

footnotes.zh: 为野兽杀害乃是神的审判(王下二24，十七25，民二一6)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 為野獸殺害乃是神的審判。（王下二24，十七25，民二一6。）
footnotes.en: 6:8 3 death Or, pestilence.

refs.text_gb: 死亡和阴间也被扔在火湖里，这火湖就是第二次的死。
refs.text_big5: 死亡和陰間也被扔在火湖裏，這火湖就是第二次的死。
refs.text_en: And death and Hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

refs.text_gb: 神要从他们眼中擦去一切的眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛，因为先前的事都过去了。
refs.text_big5: 神要從他們眼中擦去一切的眼淚，不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭號、疼痛，因為先前的事都過去了。
refs.text_en: And He will wipe away every tear from their eyes; and death will be no more, nor will there be sorrow or crying or pain anymore; for the former things have passed away.

refs.text_gb: 儿女既同有血肉之体，祂也照样亲自有分于血肉之体，为要借着死，废除那掌死权的，就是魔鬼，
refs.text_big5: 兒女既同有血肉之體，祂也照樣親自有分於血肉之體，為要藉著死，廢除那掌死權的，就是魔鬼，
refs.text_en: Since therefore the children have shared in blood and flesh, He also Himself in like manner partook of the same, that through death He might destroy him who has the might of death, that is, the devil,

refs.text_gb: 又是那活着的；我曾死过，看哪，现在又活了，直活到永永远远，并且拿着死亡和阴间的钥匙。
refs.text_big5: 又是那活著的；我曾死過，看哪，現在又活了，直活到永永遠遠，並且拿著死亡和陰間的鑰匙。
refs.text_en: And the living One; and I became dead, and behold, I am living forever and ever; and I have the keys of death and of Hades.

refs.text_gb: 我还告诉你，你是彼得，我要把我的召会建造在这磐石上，阴间的门不能胜过她。
refs.text_big5: 我還告訴你，你是彼得，我要把我的召會建造在這磐石上，陰間的門不能勝過她。
refs.text_en: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.

refs.text_gb: 就预先看明这事，讲论基督的复活说，祂不被撇在阴间，祂的肉身也不见朽坏。
refs.text_big5: 就豫先看明這事，講論基督的復活說，祂不被撇在陰間，祂的肉身也不見朽壞。
refs.text_en: He, seeing this beforehand, spoke concerning the resurrection of the Christ, that neither was He abandoned to Hades, nor did His flesh see corruption.

refs.text_gb: 他们问你说，我们往哪里去呢？你便告诉他们，耶和华如此说，定为死亡的必至死亡，定为刀杀的必交刀杀，定为饥荒的必遭饥荒，定为掳掠的必被掳掠。
refs.text_big5: 他們問你說，我們往那裏去呢？你便告訴他們，耶和華如此說，定為死亡的必至死亡，定為刀殺的必交刀殺，定為饑荒的必遭饑荒，定為擄掠的必被擄掠。
refs.text_en: And when they say to you, Where shall we go? Then you shall say to them, Thus says Jehovah, Those who are for death to death, / And those who are for the sword to the sword, / And those who are for famine to famine, / And those who are for captivity to captivity.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华说，我要以四样刑罚向他们讨罪，就是刀剑杀戮，狗类撕裂，空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽吞吃毁灭。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華說，我要以四樣刑罰向他們討罪，就是刀劍殺戮，狗類撕裂，空中的飛鳥和地上的野獸吞喫毀滅。
refs.text_en: And I will visit them with four kinds of punishment, declares Jehovah: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the birds of heaven and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.

refs.text_gb: 我必使刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫临到他们，直到他们从我所赐给他们和他们列祖之地灭绝。
refs.text_big5: 我必使刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫臨到他們，直到他們從我所賜給他們和他們列祖之地滅絕。
refs.text_en: And I will send sword and famine and pestilence upon them until they are consumed from the land which I gave to them and to their fathers.

refs.text_gb: 万军之耶和华如此说，我必使刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫临到他们，使他们像极坏的无花果，坏得不可吃。
refs.text_big5: 萬軍之耶和華如此說，我必使刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫臨到他們，使他們像極壞的無花果，壞得不可喫。
refs.text_en: Thus says Jehovah of hosts, I am about to send upon them sword, famine, and pestilence, and I will make them like vile figs, which cannot be eaten because of rottenness.

refs.text_gb: 你的民三分之一必在你中间遭瘟疫而死，因饥荒消灭；三分之一必在你四围倒在刀下；我必将三分之一分散四方，并要拔刀追赶他们。
refs.text_big5: 你的民三分之一必在你中間遭瘟疫而死，因饑荒消滅；三分之一必在你四圍倒在刀下；我必將三分之一分散四方，並要拔刀追趕他們。
refs.text_en: One-third of you will die by pestilence, and they will be consumed by famine in the midst of you; and one-third will fall by the sword surrounding you; and one-third I will scatter toward all the winds, and I will draw a sword after them.

refs.text_gb: 我要打发饥荒和恶兽到你那里，叫你丧子；瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那里，我也要使刀剑临到你。这是我耶和华说的。
refs.text_big5: 我要打發饑荒和惡獸到你那裏，叫你喪子；瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那裏，我也要使刀劍臨到你。這是我耶和華說的。
refs.text_en: Thus I will send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they will make you childless; and pestilence and blood will pass through you, and I will bring a sword upon you. I, Jehovah, have spoken.

refs.text_gb: 主耶和华如此说，我使这四样严厉的刑罚，就是刀剑、饥荒、恶兽、瘟疫临到耶路撒冷，将人与牲畜从其中剪除，岂不更重么？
refs.text_big5: 主耶和華如此說，我使這四樣嚴厲的刑罰，就是刀劍、饑荒、惡獸、瘟疫臨到耶路撒冷，將人與牲畜從其中剪除，豈不更重麼？
refs.text_en: For thus says the Lord Jehovah, How much more then when I send My four severe judgments upon Jerusalem, sword and famine and wild beasts and pestilence, to cut off man and beast from it!

verses.text_gb: 羔羊揭开第[Fn1]五印的时候，我看见在[Fn2]祭[Cra]坛底下，有为神的话[Crb]，并为所持守的见[Crc]证被杀[Crd]之人的魂[Cre]。
verses.text_big5: 羔羊揭開第[Fn1]五印的時候，我看見在[Fn2]祭[Cra]壇底下，有為神的話[Crb]，並為所持守的見[Crc]證被殺[Crd]之人的魂[Cre]。
verses.text_en: And when He opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and because of the testimony which they had.
verses.text_gb_plain: 羔羊揭开第五印的时候，我看见在祭坛底下，有为神的话，并为所持守的见证被杀之人的魂。
verses.text_big5_plain: 羔羊揭開第五印的時候，我看見在祭壇底下，有為神的話，並為所持守的見證被殺之人的魂。

footnotes.zh: 七印先分为四和三，再分为六和一。四这数字表征受造之物，如四活物所表征的；六这数字表征创造，因为创造是在六天内完成的；三这数字表征三一神，一这数字表征独一的神。因此，四加三和六加一，都指明七印借着神的审判，把神的创造连同一切受造之物，都带给神。 第五印揭示，从第一世纪到将近这世代末了基督徒的殉道(可能也包括旧约圣徒的殉道——太二三34～36)。当福音广传，如第一印所指明的，总有忠信圣徒的殉道。
footnotes.zh_big5: 七印先分為四和三，再分為六和一。四這數字表徵受造之物，如四活物所表徵的；六這數字表徵創造，因為創造是在六天內完成的；三這數字表徵三一神，一這數字表徵獨一的神。因此，四加三和六加一，都指明七印藉著神的審判，把神的創造連同一切受造之物，都帶給神。ˍ第五印揭示，從第一世紀到將近這世代末了基督徒的殉道。（可能也包括舊約聖徒的殉道─太二三34～36。）當福音廣傳，如第一印所指明的，總有忠信聖徒的殉道。
footnotes.en: 6:9 1 fifth The seven seals are divided, first, into groups of four and three and, second, into groups of six and one. The number four signifies the creatures, symbolized by the four living creatures, and the number six signifies creation (creation was completed in six days). The number three signifies the Triune God, and the number one signifies the unique God. Hence, both four plus three and six plus one indicate that the seven seals, through God's judgment, bring God's creation, with all the creatures, to God. The fifth seal discloses Christian martyrdom from the first century to the time near the end of this age. (This may include the martyrdom of the Old Testament saints — Matt. 23:34-36.) While the preaching of the gospel, as indicated by the first seal, is progressing, the faithful saints are continually being martyred.

footnotes.zh: 就表号说，祭坛是在帐幕和圣殿的外院，外院象征地。因此，在祭坛底下，就是在地底下，殉道圣徒的魂所在之处。这是主耶稣死后所去的乐园(路二三43)，在地心里(太十二40)，乃是阴间的一部分(徒二27)，就是得安慰的部分，亚伯拉罕就在那里(路十六22～26)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 就表號說，祭壇是在帳幕和聖殿的外院，外院象徵地。因此，在祭壇底下，就是在地底下，殉道聖徒的魂所在之處。這是主耶穌死後所去的樂園，（路二三43，）在地心裏，（太十二40，）乃是陰間的一部分，（徒二27，）就是得安慰的部分，亞伯拉罕就在那裏。（路十六22～26。）
footnotes.en: 6:9 2 underneath In figure, the altar is in the outer court of the tabernacle and the temple, and the outer court signifies the earth. Hence, the area underneath the altar is the region underneath the earth, where the souls of the martyred saints are. It is the Paradise to which the Lord Jesus went after His death (Luke 23:43). It is in the heart of the earth (Matt. 12:40) and is a section of Hades (Acts 2:27), the comfortable section, where Abraham is (Luke 16:22-26).

crossrefs.raw: 启八3，5，十四18，十六7，出四十6，二十26，二九12

refs.text_gb: 另一位天使拿着金香炉，来站在祭坛旁边，有许多香赐给祂，好同众圣徒的祷告献在宝座前的金坛上。
refs.text_big5: 另一位天使拿著金香爐，來站在祭壇旁邊，有許多香賜給祂，好同眾聖徒的禱告獻在寶座前的金壇上。
refs.text_en: And another Angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer, and much incense was given to Him to offer with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

refs.text_gb: 那天使拿着香炉，盛满了坛上的火，丢在地上，于是有雷轰、声音、闪电、地震。
refs.text_big5: 那天使拿著香爐，盛滿了壇上的火，丟在地上，於是有雷轟、聲音、閃電、地震。
refs.text_en: And the Angel took the censer and filled it with the fire of the altar and cast it to the earth; and there were thunders and voices and lightnings and an earthquake.

refs.text_gb: 又有一位天使从祭坛中出来，是有权柄管火的，向拿快镰刀的大声喊着说，伸出你的快镰刀来，收取地上葡萄树累累的果子，因为葡萄熟透了。
refs.text_big5: 又有一位天使從祭壇中出來，是有權柄管火的，向拿快鐮刀的大聲喊著說，伸出你的快鐮刀來，收取地上葡萄樹纍纍的果子，因為葡萄熟透了。
refs.text_en: And another angel came out of the altar, he who has authority over fire, and he cried with a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, Send forth your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for her grapes are fully ripened.

refs.text_gb: 我又听见祭坛中有声音说，是的，主神，全能者，你的审判诚哉、义哉！
refs.text_big5: 我又聽見祭壇中有聲音說，是的，主神，全能者，你的審判誠哉、義哉！
refs.text_en: And I heard the altar saying, Yes, Lord God the Almighty, true and righteous are Your judgments.

refs.text_gb: 把燔祭坛放在会幕的帐幕门前。
refs.text_big5: 把燔祭壇放在會幕的帳幕門前。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the altar of burnt offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

refs.text_gb: 你上我的坛，不可用台阶，免得在上头露出你的下体。
refs.text_big5: 你上我的壇，不可用臺階，免得在上頭露出你的下體。
refs.text_en: Neither shall you go up by steps to My altar, so that your nakedness may not be uncovered on it.

refs.text_gb: 要取些公牛的血，用指头抹在祭坛的四角上，把其余的血都倒在坛的基部。
refs.text_big5: 要取些公牛的血，用指頭抹在祭壇的四角上，把其餘的血都倒在壇的基部。
refs.text_en: And you shall take some of the blood of the bull and put some of it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and all the rest of the blood you shall pour out at the base of the altar.

refs.text_gb: 约翰便将神的话，和耶稣基督的见证，凡自己所看见的，都见证出来。
refs.text_big5: 約翰便將神的話，和耶穌基督的見證，凡自己所看見的，都見證出來。
refs.text_en: Who testified the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ, even all that he saw.

refs.text_gb: 约翰便将神的话，和耶稣基督的见证，凡自己所看见的，都见证出来。
refs.text_big5: 約翰便將神的話，和耶穌基督的見證，凡自己所看見的，都見證出來。
refs.text_en: Who testified the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ, even all that he saw.

refs.text_gb: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之处。你持守着我的名，甚至当我忠信的见证人安提帕在你们中间，撒但所住之处被杀的那些日子，你也没有否认对我的信仰。
refs.text_big5: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之處。你持守著我的名，甚至當我忠信的見證人安提帕在你們中間，撒但所住之處被殺的那些日子，你也沒有否認對我的信仰。
refs.text_en: I know where you dwell, where Satan's throne is; and you hold fast My name and have not denied My faith, even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

refs.text_gb: 所以，我差遣申言者和智慧人并经学家到你们这里来，有的你们要杀害，要钉十字架，有的你们要在你们的会堂里鞭打，从这城追逼到那城；
refs.text_big5: 所以，我差遣申言者和智慧人並經學家到你們這裏來，有的你們要殺害，要釘十字架，有的你們要在你們的會堂裏鞭打，從這城追逼到那城；
refs.text_en: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets and wise men and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

refs.text_gb: 人要把你们赶出会堂；并且时候将到，凡杀你们的，就以为是事奉神。
refs.text_big5: 人要把你們趕出會堂；並且時候將到，凡殺你們的，就以為是事奉神。
refs.text_en: They will put you out of the synagogues; but an hour is coming for everyone who kills you to think that he is offering service to God.

refs.text_gb: 他们正用石头打的时候，司提反呼求说，主耶稣，求你接收我的灵！
refs.text_big5: 他們正用石頭打的時候，司提反呼求說，主耶穌，求你接收我的靈！
refs.text_en: And they stoned Stephen as he called upon the Lord and said, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!

refs.text_gb: 又跪下，大声喊着说，主啊，不要将这罪归与他们！说了这话，就睡了。扫罗也赞同他被杀。
refs.text_big5: 又跪下，大聲喊著說，主阿，不要將這罪歸與他們！說了這話，就睡了。掃羅也贊同他被殺。
refs.text_en: And kneeling down, he cried out with a loud voice, Lord, do not hold this sin against them. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

refs.text_gb: 用刀杀了约翰的哥哥雅各。
refs.text_big5: 用刀殺了約翰的哥哥雅各。
refs.text_en: And he did away with James, the brother of John, with the sword.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见几个宝座和坐在上面的，有审判的权柄赐给他们。我又看见那些为耶稣的见证、并为神的话被斩者，以及那些没有拜过兽与兽像，额上和手上也没有受过它印记之人的魂，他们都活了，与基督一同作王一千年。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見幾個寶座和坐在上面的，有審判的權柄賜給他們。我又看見那些為耶穌的見證、並為神的話被斬者，以及那些沒有拜過獸與獸像，額上和手上也沒有受過牠印記之人的魂，他們都活了，與基督一同作王一千年。
refs.text_en: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and of those who had not worshipped the beast nor his image, and had not received the mark on their forehead and on their hand; and they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

verses.text_gb: 他们大声喊[Fn1]着说，圣[Cra]别真实的主人，你不审[Crb]判住[Crc]在地上的人，给我们伸[Crd]流血的冤，要等到几时？
verses.text_big5: 他們大聲喊[Fn1]著說，聖[Cra]別真實的主人，你不審[Crb]判住[Crc]在地上的人，給我們伸[Crd]流血的冤，要等到幾時？
verses.text_en: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Master, holy and true, will You not judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们大声喊着说，圣别真实的主人，你不审判住在地上的人，给我们伸流血的冤，要等到几时？

footnotes.zh: 照着“还要安息片时，等……满足了数目”这话，殉道圣徒的呼喊，该是发生在将近这世代的末了。

footnotes.en: 6:10 1 cried According to the word "yet a little while, until also the number ... is completed" (v. 11), this cry of the martyred saints must occur near the end of this age.

refs.text_gb: 你要写信给在非拉铁非的召会的使者，说，那圣别的、真实的，拿着大卫的钥匙，开了就没有人能关，关了就没有人能开的，这样说，
refs.text_big5: 你要寫信給在非拉鐵非的召會的使者，說，那聖別的、真實的，拿著大衛的鑰匙，開了就沒有人能關，關了就沒有人能開的，這樣說，
refs.text_en: And to the messenger of the church in Philadelphia write: These things says the Holy One, the true One, the One who has the key of David, the One who opens and no one will shut, and shuts and no one opens:

refs.text_gb: 我听见掌管众水的天使说，今是昔是的圣者，你这样审判是公义的；
refs.text_big5: 我聽見掌管眾水的天使說，今是昔是的聖者，你這樣審判是公義的；
refs.text_en: And I heard the angel who had power over the waters saying, You are righteous, who is and who was, the Holy One, because You have judged these things;

refs.text_gb: 因为他们曾流圣徒与申言者的血，你也给了他们血喝，这是他们所该受的。
refs.text_big5: 因為他們曾流聖徒與申言者的血，你也給了他們血喝，這是他們所該受的。
refs.text_en: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink; they are worthy of it.

refs.text_gb: 我又听见祭坛中有声音说，是的，主神，全能者，你的审判诚哉、义哉！
refs.text_big5: 我又聽見祭壇中有聲音說，是的，主神，全能者，你的審判誠哉、義哉！
refs.text_en: And I heard the altar saying, Yes, Lord God the Almighty, true and righteous are Your judgments.

refs.text_gb: 祂的审判是真实、公义的，因祂审判了那用淫乱败坏全地的大妓女，并且向她为祂的奴仆伸了流血的冤。
refs.text_big5: 祂的審判是真實、公義的，因祂審判了那用淫亂敗壞全地的大妓女，並且向她為祂的奴僕伸了流血的冤。
refs.text_en: For true and righteous are His judgments; for He has judged the great harlot who corrupted the earth with her fornication, and He avenged the blood of His slaves at her hand.

refs.text_gb: 你既遵守我忍耐的话，我也必保守你免去那将要临到普天下，试炼一切住在地上之人试炼的时候。
refs.text_big5: 你既遵守我忍耐的話，我也必保守你免去那將要臨到普天下，試煉一切住在地上之人試煉的時候。
refs.text_en: Because you have kept the word of My endurance, I also will keep you out of the hour of trial, which is about to come on the whole inhabited earth, to try them who dwell on the earth.

refs.text_gb: 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢呼，因祂要伸祂仆人流血的冤，报复祂的敌人，为祂的地和祂的百姓遮罪。

refs.text_en: Shout joyously, you nations, with His people, / Because He will avenge the blood of His servants, / And He will repay His adversaries with vengeance / And will cover the guilt of His land and of His people.

refs.text_gb: 你要击杀你主人亚哈的家，我好在耶洗别身上伸她流我仆人众申言者和耶和华一切仆人之血的冤。

refs.text_en: And you shall strike the house of Ahab your master, and I will avenge the blood of My servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of Jehovah at the hand of Jezebel.

refs.text_en: Why should the nations say, / Where is their God? / May the avenging of the blood of Your servants, which has been poured out, / Be known among the nations in our sight.

refs.text_gb: 叫世上所流一切的义血，都归到你们身上，从义人亚伯的血起，直到你们在殿和坛中间，所杀巴拉加的儿子撒迦利亚的血为止。
refs.text_big5: 叫世上所流一切的義血，都歸到你們身上，從義人亞伯的血起，直到你們在殿和壇中間，所殺巴拉加的兒子撒迦利亞的血為止。
refs.text_en: So that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah, son of Barachiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.

refs.text_gb: 神的选民昼夜呼吁祂，祂纵然为他们忍耐着，岂不终久给他们伸冤么？
refs.text_big5: 神的選民晝夜呼籲祂，祂縱然為他們忍耐著，豈不終久給他們伸冤麼？
refs.text_en: And will not God by all means carry out the avenging of His chosen ones, who cry to Him day and night, though He is long-suffering over them?

verses.text_big5_plain: 羔羊揭開第六印的時候，我觀看，大地震就發生了；日頭變黑，像粗糙的黑毛布，滿月變紅像血；

footnotes.zh: 第六印乃是要来超自然灾难的开始，是神对第五印中殉道圣徒呼求的答应，也是对地上居住之人的警告。照珥二30～31看，第六印与头五号(九1～11)的时间相差不多。珥二30～31先有第一号、第二号的血，第一号、第二号、第三号的火(八7～10)，和第五号的烟(九1～3)，然后有第六印的日头和月亮。本书九4和七3比较，指明第五号与第六印非常接近。
footnotes.zh_big5: 第六印乃是要來超自然災難的開始，是神對第五印中殉道聖徒呼求的答應，也是對地上居住之人的警告。照珥二30～31看，第六印與頭五號（九1～11）的時間相差不多。珥二30～31先有第一號、第二號的血，第一號、第二號、第三號的火，（八7～10，）和第五號的煙，（九1～3，）然後有第六印的日頭和月亮。本書九4和七3比較，指明第五號與第六印非常接近。
footnotes.en: 6:12 1 sixth The sixth seal, which marks the beginning of supernatural calamities, is God's answer to the cry of the martyred saints in the fifth seal and is a warning to those who dwell on the earth. According to Joel 2:30-31, there will not be much difference in time between the sixth seal and the first five trumpets (Rev. 9:1-11). Joel 2:30-31 first mentions the blood of the first and second trumpets, the fire of the first, second, and third trumpets (Rev. 8:7-10), and the smoke of the fifth trumpet (Rev. 9:1-3), and then mentions the sun and moon of the sixth seal. A comparison of Rev. 9:4 and Rev. 7:3 indicates that the fifth trumpet occurs very close to the time of the sixth seal.

footnotes.zh: 地与天势的震动和改变的灾害要有两次。第一次要发生在大灾难的起头(珥二30～31)，第二次要发生在大灾难之后(珥三11～16，太二四29～30，路二一25～26)。第六印所包括的，乃是第一次的灾害，不只可看为警告，也是要来之大灾难的起头。
footnotes.zh_big5: 地與天勢的震動和改變的災害要有兩次。第一次要發生在大災難的起頭，（珥二30～31，）第二次要發生在大災難之後。（珥三11～16，太二四29～30，路二一25～26。）第六印所包括的，乃是第一次的災害，不只可看為警告，也是要來之大災難的起頭。
footnotes.en: 6:12 2 earthquake There will be two calamities of the shaking and changing of the earth and the hosts in heaven. The first will occur at the beginning of the great tribulation (Joel 2:30-31), and the second will occur after the great tribulation (Joel 3:11-16; Matt. 24:29-30; Luke 21:25-26). What is covered in the sixth seal is the first calamity. It can be considered not only a warning but also an initiation of the coming great tribulation.
