refs.text_big5: 基督是我們的生命，祂顯現的時候，你們也要與祂一同顯現在榮耀裏。
refs.text_en: When Christ our life is manifested, then you also will be manifested with Him in glory.

refs.text_gb: 我们讲的，乃是从前所隐藏，神奥秘中的智慧，就是神在万世以前，为使我们得荣耀所预定的；
refs.text_big5: 我們講的，乃是從前所隱藏，神奧祕中的智慧，就是神在萬世以前，為使我們得榮耀所豫定的；
refs.text_en: But we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom which has been hidden, which God predestined before the ages for our glory,

refs.text_gb: 原来万有因祂而有，借祂而造的那位，为着要领许多的儿子进荣耀里去，就借着苦难成全他们救恩的创始者，这对祂本是合宜的。
refs.text_big5: 原來萬有因祂而有，藉祂而造的那位，為著要領許多的兒子進榮耀裏去，就藉著苦難成全他們救恩的創始者，這對祂本是合宜的。
refs.text_en: For it was fitting for Him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in leading many sons into glory, to make the Author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

refs.text_gb: 不再有黑夜，他们也不需要灯光日光，因为主神要光照他们；他们要作王，直到永永远远。
refs.text_big5: 不再有黑夜，他們也不需要燈光日光，因為主神要光照他們；他們要作王，直到永永遠遠。
refs.text_en: And night will be no more; and they have no need of the light of a lamp and of the light of the sun, for the Lord God will shine upon them; and they will reign forever and ever.

refs.text_gb: 你们是世上的光。城立在山上，是不能隐藏的。
refs.text_big5: 你們是世上的光。城立在山上，是不能隱藏的。
refs.text_en: You are the light of the world. It is impossible for a city situated upon a mountain to be hidden.

refs.text_gb: 人点灯，也不放在斗底下，乃是放在灯台上，就照亮所有在家里的人。
refs.text_big5: 人點燈，也不放在斗底下，乃是放在燈臺上，就照亮所有在家裏的人。
refs.text_en: Nor do men light a lamp and place it under the bushel, but on the lampstand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

refs.text_gb: 你们的光也当这样照在人前，叫他们看见你们的好行为，就荣耀你们在诸天之上的父。
refs.text_big5: 你們的光也當這樣照在人前，叫他們看見你們的好行為，就榮耀你們在諸天之上的父。
refs.text_en: In the same way, let your light shine before men, so that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 你们从前是黑暗，但如今在主里面乃是光，行事为人就要像光的儿女，
refs.text_big5: 你們從前是黑暗，但如今在主裏面乃是光，行事為人就要像光的兒女，
refs.text_en: For you were once darkness but are now light in the Lord; walk as children of light

refs.text_gb: 使你们无可指摘、纯洁无杂，在弯曲悖谬的世代中，作神无瑕疵的儿女；你们在其中好像发光之体显在世界里，
refs.text_big5: 使你們無可指摘、純潔無雜，在彎曲悖謬的世代中，作神無瑕疵的兒女；你們在其中好像發光之體顯在世界裏，
refs.text_en: That you may be blameless and guileless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverted generation, among whom you shine as luminaries in the world,

refs.text_gb: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石装饰的。第一根基是碧玉，第二是蓝宝石，第三是玛瑙，第四是绿宝石，
refs.text_big5: 城牆的根基是用各樣寶石裝飾的。第一根基是碧玉，第二是藍寶石，第三是瑪瑙，第四是綠寶石，
refs.text_en: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

refs.text_gb: 墙是用碧玉造的，城是纯金的，如同明净的玻璃。
refs.text_big5: 牆是用碧玉造的，城是純金的，如同明淨的玻璃。
refs.text_en: And the building work of its wall was jasper; and the city was pure gold, like clear glass.

refs.text_gb: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石装饰的。第一根基是碧玉，第二是蓝宝石，第三是玛瑙，第四是绿宝石，
refs.text_big5: 城牆的根基是用各樣寶石裝飾的。第一根基是碧玉，第二是藍寶石，第三是瑪瑙，第四是綠寶石，
refs.text_en: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

refs.text_gb: 那位坐着的，显出来的样子好像碧玉和红宝石，又有虹围着宝座，显出来的样子好像绿宝石。
refs.text_big5: 那位坐著的，顯出來的樣子好像碧玉和紅寶石，又有虹圍著寶座，顯出來的樣子好像綠寶石。
refs.text_en: And He who was sitting was like a jasper stone and a sardius in appearance, and there was a rainbow around the throne like an emerald in appearance.

refs.text_gb: 天使又指给我看在城内街道当中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，从神和羔羊的宝座流出来。
refs.text_big5: 天使又指給我看在城內街道當中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，從神和羔羊的寶座流出來。
refs.text_en: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb in the middle of its street.

refs.text_gb: 宝座前好像一个玻璃海，如同水晶；宝座中、和宝座周围有四个活物，前后满了眼睛。
refs.text_big5: 寶座前好像一個玻璃海，如同水晶；寶座中、和寶座周圍有四個活物，前後滿了眼睛。
refs.text_en: And before the throne there was as it were a glassy sea like crystal; and in the midst of the throne and around the throne, there were four living creatures full of eyes in front and behind.

refs.text_gb: 活物的头以上有穹苍的样式，看着像可畏的水晶，铺张在活物的头以上。
refs.text_big5: 活物的頭以上有穹蒼的樣式，看著像可畏的水晶，鋪張在活物的頭以上。
refs.text_en: And over the heads of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like the sight of awesome crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

verses.text_gb: 有高[Fn1]大的墙[Cra]；有十[Fn2][Crb]二个门[Crc]，门上有十二位天[Fn3]使；门上又写着以[Fn4]色列十二个支派的名字；
verses.text_big5: 有高[Fn1]大的牆[Cra]；有十[Fn2][Crb]二個門[Crc]，門上有十二位天[Fn3]使；門上又寫著以[Fn4]色列十二個支派的名字；
verses.text_en: It had a great and high wall and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names inscribed, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel:
verses.text_gb_plain: 有高大的墙；有十二个门，门上有十二位天使；门上又写着以色列十二个支派的名字；
verses.text_big5_plain: 有高大的牆；有十二個門，門上有十二位天使；門上又寫著以色列十二個支派的名字；

footnotes.zh: 墙是为着分别和保护。新耶路撒冷要绝对分别归神，也要完全保护神的权益。这墙是高大的，今天所有的信徒都需要这样高大的墙，来分别并保护他们。
footnotes.zh_big5: 牆是為著分別和保護。新耶路撒冷要絕對分別歸神，也要完全保護神的權益。這牆是高大的，今天所有的信徒都需要這樣高大的牆，來分別並保護他們。
footnotes.en: 21:12 1 great The wall is for separation and protection. New Jerusalem will be absolutely separated unto God and will fully protect the interests of God. Its wall will be great and high. Today all believers need such a great and high wall for their separation and protection.

footnotes.zh: 门是为着交通、进出的。十二是神行政中绝对完全并永远完整的数字。因此，十二个门指明为着神的行政，新耶路撒冷的交通是绝对完全且永远完整的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 門是為著交通、進出的。十二是神行政中絕對完全並永遠完整的數字。因此，十二個門指明為著神的行政，新耶路撒冷的交通是絕對完全且永遠完整的。
footnotes.en: 21:12 2 twelve The gates are for communication, for coming in and going out. Twelve is the number of absolute perfection and eternal completion in God's administration. Hence, twelve gates indicates that the communication in the New Jerusalem is absolutely perfect and eternally complete for God's administration.

footnotes.zh: 在神永远的经纶里，天使是服役的灵(来一14)，为那些承受救恩，并有分于新耶路撒冷(新天新地的中心)永远之福的人效力。这些天使要为我们的产业看门，我们却要享受神永远经纶里丰富的产业。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在神永遠的經綸裏，天使是服役的靈，（來一14，）為那些承受救恩，並有分於新耶路撒冷（新天新地的中心）永遠之福的人效力。這些天使要為我們的產業看門，我們卻要享受神永遠經綸裏豐富的產業。
footnotes.en: 21:12 3 angels In God's eternal economy, angels are ministering spirits (Heb. 1:14). They serve those who inherit salvation and who participate in the eternal blessing of the New Jerusalem, the center of the new heaven and new earth. They will be the gatekeepers of our possession, while we will be the enjoyers of the rich inheritance in God's eternal economy.

footnotes.zh: 以色列，直译，以色列的众子。在这里，以色列代表旧约的律法，指明新耶路撒冷的门上有律法的代表。律法在看守并观看，以保证圣城一切的交通、进出都合乎律法的要求。十二门上有这以色列十二支派的名字，也表征以色列十二支派是圣城的入门，借着福音的传扬，引人进入三一神的丰富，享受其中的供应。 这里的以色列也指明新耶路撒冷的组成，包括旧约所有蒙救赎的圣徒。
footnotes.zh_big5: 以色列，直譯，以色列的眾子。在這裏，以色列代表舊約的律法，指明新耶路撒冷的門上有律法的代表。律法在看守並觀看，以保證聖城一切的交通、進出都合乎律法的要求。十二門上有這以色列十二支派的名字，也表徵以色列十二支派是聖城的入門，藉著福音的傳揚，引人進入三一神的豐富，享受其中的供應。ˍ這裏的以色列也指明新耶路撒冷的組成，包括舊約所有蒙救贖的聖徒。
footnotes.en: 21:12 4 Israel Israel here represents the law of the Old Testament, indicating that the law is represented at the gates of the New Jerusalem. The law watches and observes to insure that all the communications, the comings in and goings out, of the holy city meet the law's requirements. That the names of the twelve tribes of Israel are inscribed on the twelve gates signifies that the twelve tribes of Israel are the entrance into the holy city; as such, they lead people, through the preaching of the gospel, into the riches of the Triune God to enjoy the supply in the city. The mentioning of Israel here also indicates that the New Jerusalem includes all the redeemed saints of the Old Testament.

footnotes.zh: 城是四方的(16)，每边各有三门。东边在前，向着日出的荣耀，列为第一；北边在上，列为第二；南边在下，列为第三；西边在后，列为第四。四边的门向着地的四方，表征圣城的入口对地上所有的人都是便利的(比较创二10～14河流分为四道)。每边的三门，表征三一神——父、子、灵——一同作工，将人带进圣城。这是路十五的三个比喻所指明的，也是主在太二八19的话所含示的。浸入父、子、灵，就是真正进到圣城里。四边各有三门，构成十二这数字，这也含示三一神与受造之人的调和(四这数字表征受造之物——四6)。
footnotes.en: 21:13 1 east; north; west The city lies square (v. 16), with three gates on each of the four sides. The east side, at the front, toward the glory of the sunrise, ranks first; the north side, at the top, ranks second; the south side, at the bottom, ranks third; and the west side, at the rear, ranks fourth. The gates on the four sides face the four directions of the earth, signifying that the entrance into the holy city is available to all the peoples on earth. (Cf. the four heads of the river in Gen. 2:10-14.) That there are three gates on each side signifies that the three of the Trinity — the Father, the Son, and the Spirit — work together to bring people into the holy city. This is indicated in the three parables in Luke 15 and implied in the Lord's word in Matt. 28:19. To be baptized into the Father, the Son, and the Spirit is the real entrance into the holy city. That there are three gates on each of the four sides, three times four being twelve, also implies that the Triune God is mingled with man, the creature. (The number four signifies the creatures — Rev. 4:6.)

verses.text_big5_plain: 城牆有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的十二個名字。

footnotes.zh: 这里的根基不是林前三10～11所说的根基——基督，乃是羔羊的十二使徒。今天召会是建造在使徒和申言者的根基上(弗二20)；在永世里，不再需要申言者，所以只有使徒为圣城的根基。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的根基不是林前三10～11所說的根基─基督，乃是羔羊的十二使徒。今天召會是建造在使徒和申言者的根基上；（弗二20；）在永世裏，不再需要申言者，所以只有使徒為聖城的根基。
footnotes.en: 21:14 1 foundations The foundations here are not the foundation that is Christ, mentioned in 1 Cor. 3:10-11. Rather, they are the twelve apostles of the Lamb. Today the church is built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets (Eph. 2:20). Since in eternity there will be no more need for the prophets, the foundations of the holy city will consist only of the apostles.

footnotes.zh: 这里的使徒代表新约的恩典，表征新耶路撒冷是建造在神的恩典上。进入圣城乃是照着神的律法，城却是建造在神的恩典上。这里的“使徒”也含示新耶路撒冷的组成，不仅包括以色列所代表的旧约圣徒，也包括使徒所代表的新约圣徒。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的使徒代表新約的恩典，表徵新耶路撒冷是建造在神的恩典上。進入聖城乃是照著神的律法，城卻是建造在神的恩典上。這裏的“使徒”也含示新耶路撒冷的組成，不僅包括以色列所代表的舊約聖徒，也包括使徒所代表的新約聖徒。
footnotes.en: 21:14 2 apostles The apostles here represent the grace of the New Testament, signifying that the New Jerusalem is built upon the grace of God. While entrance into the holy city is according to the law of God, the city is built upon the grace of God. Apostles here implies that the New Jerusalem is composed not only of the Old Testament saints, represented by Israel, but also of the New Testament saints, represented by the apostles.

refs.text_gb: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石装饰的。第一根基是碧玉，第二是蓝宝石，第三是玛瑙，第四是绿宝石，
refs.text_big5: 城牆的根基是用各樣寶石裝飾的。第一根基是碧玉，第二是藍寶石，第三是瑪瑙，第四是綠寶石，
refs.text_en: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

refs.text_gb: 因为他等候那座有根基的城，其设计者并建筑者乃是神。
refs.text_big5: 因為他等候那座有根基的城，其設計者並建築者乃是神。
refs.text_en: For he eagerly waited for the city which has the foundations, whose Architect and Builder is God.

refs.text_gb: 被建造在使徒和申言者的根基上，有基督耶稣自己作房角石；
refs.text_big5: 被建造在使徒和申言者的根基上，有基督耶穌自己作房角石；
refs.text_en: Being built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus Himself being the cornerstone;

refs.text_gb: 这十二使徒的名字是：头一个，称呼彼得的西门，还有他的兄弟安得烈；西庇太的儿子雅各，和他的兄弟约翰；
refs.text_big5: 這十二使徒的名字是：頭一個，稱呼彼得的西門，還有他的兄弟安得烈；西庇太的兒子雅各，和他的兄弟約翰；
refs.text_en: And the names of the twelve apostles are these: first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; and James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

refs.text_gb: 腓力和巴多罗买；多马和税吏马太；亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太；
refs.text_big5: 腓力和巴多羅買；多馬和稅吏馬太；亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太；
refs.text_en: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

refs.text_gb: 热烈派的西门，和出卖耶稣的加略人犹大。
refs.text_big5: 熱烈派的西門，和出賣耶穌的加略人猶大。
refs.text_en: Simon the Cananaean, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.

refs.text_gb: 于是众人为他们摇签，摇出马提亚来，他就和十一位使徒同列。
refs.text_big5: 於是眾人為他們搖籤，搖出馬提亞來，他就和十一位使徒同列。
refs.text_en: And they cast lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

verses.text_gb: 同我说话的拿着金[Fn1]苇子当尺，要量[Cra]那城、和城门城墙。
verses.text_big5: 同我說話的拿著金[Fn1]葦子當尺，要量[Cra]那城、和城門城牆。
verses.text_en: And he who spoke with me had a golden reed as a measure that he might measure the city and its gates and its wall.
verses.text_gb_plain: 同我说话的拿着金苇子当尺，要量那城、和城门城墙。
verses.text_big5_plain: 同我說話的拿著金葦子當尺，要量那城、和城門城牆。

footnotes.zh: 苇子是为着量度，量度是为着据有(结四十5，亚二1～2，启十一1)。金既是表征神圣的性情，用金苇子量度，就表征测量城、城门、城墙，乃是照着神圣的性情；凡不合乎神圣性情的，都不属于新耶路撒冷。这整座城，连城门和城墙在内，都能通过神圣性情的量度与试验；因此，这座城适合为神所有。
footnotes.zh_big5: 葦子是為著量度，量度是為著據有。（結四十5，亞二1～2，啟十一1。）金既是表徵神聖的性情，用金葦子量度，就表徵測量城、城門、城牆，乃是照著神聖的性情；凡不合乎神聖性情的，都不屬於新耶路撒冷。這整座城，連城門和城牆在內，都能通過神聖性情的量度與試驗；因此，這座城適合為神所有。
footnotes.en: 21:15 1 golden A reed is for measuring, and measuring is for taking possession (Ezek. 40:5; Zech. 2:1-2; Rev. 11:1). Since gold signifies the divine nature of God, golden here indicates that the city, its gates, and its wall are measured according to God's divine nature. Anything that does not match the divine nature of God does not belong to the New Jerusalem. The entire city, with its gates and wall, can pass the measuring and testing of the divine nature of God; hence, it is fit to be God's possession.

refs.text_gb: 有一根像量度之杖的苇子赐给我，又有话说，起来，将神的殿和坛、并殿中敬拜的人，都量一量。
refs.text_big5: 有一根像量度之杖的葦子賜給我，又有話說，起來，將神的殿和壇、並殿中敬拜的人，都量一量。
refs.text_en: And there was given to me a reed like a rod, and someone said, Rise and measure the temple of God and the altar and those who worship in it.

refs.text_gb: 祂带我到那里，见有一个人，样子像铜，手拿麻绳和量度的苇子，站在门口。
refs.text_big5: 祂帶我到那裏，見有一個人，樣子像銅，手拿麻繩和量度的葦子，站在門口。
refs.text_en: And He brought me there, and there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax and a measuring reed in His hand, standing in the gate.

refs.text_gb: 我又举目观看，见有一人，手拿准绳。
refs.text_big5: 我又舉目觀看，見有一人，手拿準繩。
refs.text_en: Then I lifted up my eyes and I looked, and there was a man, and in His hand was a measuring line.

refs.text_gb: 我说，你往哪里去？祂对我说，我要去量耶路撒冷，看有多宽，多长。
refs.text_big5: 我說，你往那裏去？祂對我說，我要去量耶路撒冷，看有多寬，多長。
refs.text_en: And I said, Where are You going? And He said to me, To measure Jerusalem; to see how great its breadth is and how great its length is.

verses.text_gb: 城是四[Fn1][Cra]方的，长宽一样；天使用苇子量那城，共有一[Fn2]万二千斯[Fn3]泰底亚，长[Fn4]宽高都相[Crb]等。
verses.text_big5: 城是四[Fn1][Cra]方的，長寬一樣；天使用葦子量那城，共有一[Fn2]萬二千斯[Fn3]泰底亞，長[Fn4]寬高都相[Crb]等。
verses.text_en: And the city lies square, and its length is as great as the breadth. And he measured the city with the reed to a length of twelve thousand stadia; the length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
verses.text_gb_plain: 城是四方的，长宽一样；天使用苇子量那城，共有一万二千斯泰底亚，长宽高都相等。
verses.text_big5_plain: 城是四方的，長寬一樣；天使用葦子量那城，共有一萬二千斯泰底亞，長寬高都相等。

footnotes.zh: 这里的四方，表征新耶路撒冷在各面都是完全、完整、绝对平直、毫不歪斜的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的四方，表徵新耶路撒冷在各面都是完全、完整、絕對平直、毫不歪斜的。
footnotes.en: 21:16 1 square Square here indicates that the New Jerusalem is perfect and complete in every way, absolutely straight, and not in the least oblique.

footnotes.zh: 一万二千是十二的一千倍。十二既表征神行政中的绝对完全和永远完整，一万二千就表征一千倍这样的完全与完整。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一萬二千是十二的一千倍。十二既表徵神行政中的絕對完全和永遠完整，一萬二千就表徵一千倍這樣的完全與完整。
footnotes.en: 21:16 2 twelve Twelve thousand is one thousand times twelve. Since twelve signifies absolute perfection and eternal completion in God's administration, twelve thousand signifies a thousand times this.

footnotes.zh: 一斯泰底昂约一八五公尺。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一斯泰底昂約一八五公尺。
footnotes.en: 21:16 3 stadia A stadion equals about 600 feet.

footnotes.zh: 无论在帐幕或圣殿里，至圣所的尺度，长宽高都相等(出二六2～8，王上六20)。因此，新耶路撒冷的长宽高都相等，表征整个新耶路撒冷就是至圣所，神所有的赎民都可在其中敬拜、事奉神，看见、摸着神的同在，并生活、安居在神的同在中，直到永远。
footnotes.zh_big5: 無論在帳幕或聖殿裏，至聖所的尺度，長寬高都相等。（出二六2～8，王上六20。）因此，新耶路撒冷的長寬高都相等，表徵整個新耶路撒冷就是至聖所，神所有的贖民都可在其中敬拜、事奉神，看見、摸著神的同在，並生活、安居在神的同在中，直到永遠。
footnotes.en: 21:16 4 length The dimensions of the Holy of Holies, in both the tabernacle and the temple, were equal in length, breadth, and height (Exo. 26:2-8; 1 Kings 6:20). Hence, that the length and the breadth and the height of New Jerusalem are equal signifies that the entire New Jerusalem will be the Holy of Holies. In it, all God's redeemed ones will serve and worship God, will see and touch God's presence, and will live and dwell in God's presence for eternity.

refs.text_gb: 祂用量度的苇子量四围，量东面五百苇，
refs.text_big5: 祂用量度的葦子量四圍，量東面五百葦，
refs.text_en: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

refs.text_gb: 用量度的苇子量四围，量北面五百苇，
refs.text_big5: 用量度的葦子量四圍，量北面五百葦，
refs.text_en: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

refs.text_gb: 用量度的苇子量南面五百苇，
refs.text_big5: 用量度的葦子量南面五百葦，
refs.text_en: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

refs.text_gb: 又转到西面，用量度的苇子量五百苇。
refs.text_big5: 又轉到西面，用量度的葦子量五百葦。
refs.text_en: He turned to the west side and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

refs.text_gb: 祂量四面，四围有墙，长五百苇，宽五百苇，为要分别圣地与俗地。
refs.text_big5: 祂量四面，四圍有牆，長五百葦，寬五百葦，為要分別聖地與俗地。
refs.text_en: He measured it on four sides. It had a wall all around, the length five hundred reeds and the width five hundred reeds, to make a separation between what was holy and what was common.

refs.text_gb: 他在殿里预备了内殿，好将耶和华的约柜安放在那里。
refs.text_big5: 他在殿裏豫備了內殿，好將耶和華的約櫃安放在那裏。
refs.text_en: And he prepared an innermost sanctuary in the midst of the house within, in order to put the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah there.

refs.text_gb: 内殿里面长二十肘，宽二十肘，高二十肘，都贴上纯金；又将香柏木作的坛包上纯金。
refs.text_big5: 內殿裏面長二十肘，寬二十肘，高二十肘，都貼上純金；又將香柏木作的壇包上純金。
refs.text_en: And the interior of the innermost sanctuary was twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide and twenty cubits high; and he overlaid it with pure gold, and he overlaid the cedar altar.

verses.text_gb: 又量了城墙，按着人[Fn1]的尺寸，就是天[Cra]使的尺寸，共有一[Fn2]百四十四肘。
verses.text_big5: 又量了城牆，按著人[Fn1]的尺寸，就是天[Cra]使的尺寸，共有一[Fn2]百四十四肘。
verses.text_en: And he measured its wall, a hundred and forty-four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又量了城墙，按着人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又量了城牆，按著人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。

footnotes.zh: 在复活里，人要像天使一样(太二二30)，因此，“按着人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸”表征城墙不是天然的，乃是在复活里的。
footnotes.en: 21:17 1 hundred A hundred and forty-four is twelve times twelve. Twelve times twelve signifies the absolute perfection and eternal completion of absolute perfections and eternal completions. How perfect and complete is the wall of the holy city in God's eternal administration! The city proper is like a mountain with a height of twelve thousand stadia, whereas the wall itself, from the foundation to the top, has a height of a hundred and forty-four cubits.

footnotes.zh: 一百四十四是十二乘十二，表征在神行政中，绝对完全与永远完整中的绝对完全与永远完整。圣城的墙在神永远的行政中，是何等的完全与完整！ 城本身像一座一万二千斯泰底亚的高山，而城墙本身从根基到顶端是一百四十四肘。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一百四十四是十二乘十二，表徵在神行政中，絕對完全與永遠完整中的絕對完全與永遠完整。聖城的牆在神永遠的行政中，是何等的完全與完整！ˍ城本身像一座一萬二千斯泰底亞的高山，而城牆本身從根基到頂端是一百四十四肘。
footnotes.en: 21:17 2 angel; man It is in resurrection that man will be like the angels (Matt. 22:30). Hence, the measure of a man, that is, of an angel indicates that the wall of the city is not natural but is in resurrection.

refs.text_gb: 在复活的时候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一样。
refs.text_big5: 在復活的時候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
refs.text_en: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

verses.text_gb: 墙是用碧[Fn1][Cra]玉造的，城是纯[Fn2]金[Fn3][Crb]的，如同明净的玻璃。
verses.text_big5: 牆是用碧[Fn1][Cra]玉造的，城是純[Fn2]金[Fn3][Crb]的，如同明淨的玻璃。
verses.text_en: And the building work of its wall was jasper; and the city was pure gold, like clear glass.
verses.text_gb_plain: 墙是用碧玉造的，城是纯金的，如同明净的玻璃。
verses.text_big5_plain: 牆是用碧玉造的，城是純金的，如同明淨的玻璃。

footnotes.zh: 碧玉是一种变化的宝石(林前三12)，表征神显出来的样子(四3与注1)。碧玉墙表征那作神在永世里团体彰显的整座城，有神显出来的样子。
footnotes.zh_big5: 碧玉是一種變化的寶石，（林前三12，）表徵神顯出來的樣子。（四3與註1。）碧玉牆表徵那作神在永世裏團體彰顯的整座城，有神顯出來的樣子。
footnotes.en: 21:18 1 jasper Jasper is a transformed precious stone (1 Cor. 3:12). God's appearance is like jasper (Rev. 4:3 and note 1 there). The jasper wall signifies that the whole city, as the corporate expression of God in eternity, bears the appearance of God.

footnotes.zh: 或，纯净。
footnotes.en: 21:18 2 pure Or, clear, clean.

footnotes.zh: 金既然表征神的神圣性情，城是纯金的，就表征新耶路撒冷完全是出于神的神圣性情，以神的神圣性情为元素。纯金如同明净的玻璃，表征整座城是透明的，毫无不透明之处。
footnotes.zh_big5: 金既然表徵神的神聖性情，城是純金的，就表徵新耶路撒冷完全是出於神的神聖性情，以神的神聖性情為元素。純金如同明淨的玻璃，表徵整座城是透明的，毫無不透明之處。
footnotes.en: 21:18 3 gold Since gold signifies the divine nature of God, the city's being of pure gold signifies that New Jerusalem is altogether of God's divine nature and takes God's divine nature as its element. Pure gold, like clear glass indicates that the whole city is transparent and is not in the least opaque.

refs.text_gb: 城中有神的荣耀；城的光辉如同极贵的宝石，好像碧玉，明如水晶；
refs.text_big5: 城中有神的榮耀；城的光輝如同極貴的寶石，好像碧玉，明如水晶；
refs.text_en: Having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, as clear as crystal.

refs.text_gb: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石装饰的。第一根基是碧玉，第二是蓝宝石，第三是玛瑙，第四是绿宝石，
refs.text_big5: 城牆的根基是用各樣寶石裝飾的。第一根基是碧玉，第二是藍寶石，第三是瑪瑙，第四是綠寶石，
refs.text_en: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

refs.text_gb: 那位坐着的，显出来的样子好像碧玉和红宝石，又有虹围着宝座，显出来的样子好像绿宝石。
refs.text_big5: 那位坐著的，顯出來的樣子好像碧玉和紅寶石，又有虹圍著寶座，顯出來的樣子好像綠寶石。
refs.text_en: And He who was sitting was like a jasper stone and a sardius in appearance, and there was a rainbow around the throne like an emerald in appearance.

refs.text_gb: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠，每一个门各自是一颗珍珠造的，城内的街道是纯金，好像透明的玻璃。
refs.text_big5: 十二個門是十二顆珍珠，每一個門各自是一顆珍珠造的，城內的街道是純金，好像透明的玻璃。
refs.text_en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was, respectively, of one pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

refs.text_gb: 我转过身来，要看是谁发声与我说话；既转过来，就看见七个金灯台；
refs.text_big5: 我轉過身來，要看是誰發聲與我說話；既轉過來，就看見七個金燈臺；
refs.text_en: And I turned to see the voice that spoke with me; and when I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,

refs.text_gb: 然而，若有人用金、银、宝石，木、草、禾秸，在这根基上建造，
refs.text_big5: 然而，若有人用金、銀、寶石，木、草、禾秸，在這根基上建造，
refs.text_en: But if anyone builds upon the foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, grass, stubble,

footnotes.zh: 新耶路撒冷是一座有根基的城(来十一10)，这些根基就是羔羊的十二使徒(14)，每位使徒由一样宝石所表征。十二使徒的头一位，彼得，原名西门；当他被带到主面前时，主将他改名为彼得，意思就是石头(约一42)。后来，主说到召会的建造时，就以这名称呼他(太十六18)。宝石不是创造的，乃是从受造之物变化成的。所有的使徒都是受造的泥土，但他们蒙了重生，并且变化成了为着神永远建造的宝石。每一位信徒都需要经过这样的重生和变化，才能成为新耶路撒冷的一部分。 表征十二使徒的十二样根基宝石，其颜色如下：第一是绿色，第二和第三是蓝色，第四是绿色，第五和第六是红色，第七是黄色，第八是蓝绿色，第九是黄色，第十是苹果绿色，第十一和第十二是紫色。以上十二层根基的颜色，显出一道彩虹的样子，表征城是建造在神守约的信实上，并借着神这信实得以稳固(创九8～17)，城的根基也是可信可靠的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 新耶路撒冷是一座有根基的城，（來十一10，）這些根基就是羔羊的十二使徒，（14，）每位使徒由一樣寶石所表徵。十二使徒的頭一位，彼得，原名西門；當他被帶到主面前時，主將他改名為彼得，意思就是石頭。（約一42。）後來，主說到召會的建造時，就以這名稱呼他。（太十六18。）寶石不是創造的，乃是從受造之物變化成的。所有的使徒都是受造的泥土，但他們蒙了重生，並且變化成了為著神永遠建造的寶石。每一位信徒都需要經過這樣的重生和變化，纔能成為新耶路撒冷的一部分。ˍ表徵十二使徒的十二樣根基寶石，其顏色如下：第一是綠色，第二和第三是藍色，第四是綠色，第五和第六是紅色，第七是黃色，第八是藍綠色，第九是黃色，第十是蘋果綠色，第十一和第十二是紫色。以上十二層根基的顏色，顯出一道彩虹的樣子，表徵城是建造在神守約的信實上，並藉著神這信實得以穩固，（創九8～17，）城的根基也是可信可靠的。
footnotes.en: 21:19 1 foundations The New Jerusalem is a city of foundations (Heb. 11:10). These are the twelve apostles of the Lamb (v. 14), each of whom is signified by a precious stone. Peter, the first of the twelve apostles, was originally named Simon. When Simon was brought to the Lord, the Lord changed his name to Peter, meaning a stone (John 1:42). Later, the Lord called him by that name when He spoke concerning the building of His church (Matt. 16:18). Precious stones are not created but are produced by the transforming of things created. All the apostles were created as clay, but they were regenerated and were transformed into precious stones for God's eternal building. Every believer needs to be thus regenerated and transformed that he may be a part of the New Jerusalem. The colors of the foundation's twelve precious stones, which signify the twelve apostles, are as follows: the first stone is green, the second and third are blue, the fourth is green, the fifth and sixth are red, the seventh is yellow, the eighth is bluish green, the ninth is yellow, the tenth is apple-green, the eleventh and twelfth are purple. The twelve layers of the foundation in the above colors have the appearance of a rainbow, signifying that the city is built upon and secured by God's faithfulness in keeping His covenant (Gen. 9:8-17) and that the foundation of the city is trustworthy and reliable.

footnotes.zh: 城墙的第一层根基和新耶路撒冷的整个城墙一样，都是用碧玉造的(18)；这指明在圣城的建造里，主要的材料是碧玉。既然碧玉表征神彰显在祂可传输的荣耀里(四3)，圣城主要的功用也就是带着神的荣耀彰显神(11)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 城牆的第一層根基和新耶路撒冷的整個城牆一樣，都是用碧玉造的；（18；）這指明在聖城的建造裏，主要的材料是碧玉。既然碧玉表徵神彰顯在祂可傳輸的榮耀裏，（四3，）聖城主要的功用也就是帶著神的榮耀彰顯神。（11。）
footnotes.en: 21:19 2 jasper The first layer of the wall's foundation, as well as the entire wall of New Jerusalem, is built with jasper (v. 18). This indicates that the main material in the building of the holy city is jasper. Since jasper signifies God expressed in His transmittable glory (Rev. 4:3), the main function of the holy city is to express God in bearing His glory (v. 11).

footnotes.zh: 珍珠产自死水中的蚌。当蚌被砂粒所伤，就分泌生命的汁液包裹砂粒，使其成为宝贵的珍珠。这描述基督这位永活者进到死水中，为我们所伤，就分泌祂的生命包裹我们，使我们成为宝贵的珍珠，好被建造成为神永远的彰显。圣城的十二个门是十二颗珍珠，表征借着那胜过死亡，并分泌生命的基督而得的重生，乃是城的入口。这符合那由以色列所代表，并由看守的天使所观看(12)之律法的要求。 新耶路撒冷是由三种宝贵的材料建造成的，表征她是用三一神所建造的。首先，城的本身同城内的街道是纯金的(18，21)。金是神圣别性情的表号，表征父是源头，产生使城实际存在的元素。第二，城的十二个门是珍珠，表征子得胜的死并分赐生命的复活，借此开了城的入口。第三，城墙及其根基是用宝石造的，表征那灵变化的工作，将蒙救赎、得重生的圣徒变化为宝石，为着建造神永远的居所，使他们在神那渗透一切的荣耀中，团体的彰显神。在伊甸园，这三种宝物仅仅是材料(创二11～12)，到了新耶路撒冷城，这些宝贵的材料成了被建造起来的城，为着成就神永远的定旨，就是得着一个团体的彰显。
footnotes.zh_big5: 珍珠產自死水中的蚌。當蚌被砂粒所傷，就分泌生命的汁液包裹砂粒，使其成為寶貴的珍珠。這描述基督這位永活者進到死水中，為我們所傷，就分泌祂的生命包裹我們，使我們成為寶貴的珍珠，好被建造成為神永遠的彰顯。聖城的十二個門是十二顆珍珠，表徵藉著那勝過死亡，並分泌生命的基督而得的重生，乃是城的入口。這符合那由以色列所代表，並由看守的天使所觀看（12）之律法的要求。ˍ新耶路撒冷是由三種寶貴的材料建造成的，表徵她是用三一神所建造的。首先，城的本身同城內的街道是純金的。（18，21。）金是神聖別性情的表號，表徵父是源頭，產生使城實際存在的元素。第二，城的十二個門是珍珠，表徵子得勝的死並分賜生命的復活，藉此開了城的入口。第三，城牆及其根基是用寶石造的，表徵那靈變化的工作，將蒙救贖、得重生的聖徒變化為寶石，為著建造神永遠的居所，使他們在神那滲透一切的榮耀中，團體的彰顯神。在伊甸園，這三種寶物僅僅是材料，（創二11～12，）到了新耶路撒冷城，這些寶貴的材料成了被建造起來的城，為著成就神永遠的定旨，就是得著一個團體的彰顯。
footnotes.en: 21:21 1 pearls Pearls are produced by oysters in the waters of death. When an oyster is wounded by a grain of sand, it secretes its life-juice around the grain of sand and makes it into a precious pearl. This depicts Christ as the living One coming into the death waters, being wounded by us, and secreting His life over us to make us into precious pearls for the building of God's eternal expression. That the twelve gates of the holy city are twelve pearls signifies that regeneration through the death-overcoming and life-secreting Christ is the entrance into the city. This meets the requirement of the law, which is represented by Israel and is under the observing of the guarding angels (v. 12). The New Jerusalem is built of three kinds of precious materials, signifying that she is built with the Triune God. First, the city proper, with its street, is of pure gold (vv. 18, 21). Gold, the symbol of the divine nature of God, signifies the Father as the source, from whom the element for the substantial existence of the city is produced. Second, the twelve gates of the city are pearls, which signify the Son's overcoming death and life-imparting resurrection, through which entrance to the city is gained. Third, the wall of the city and its foundation are built of precious stones, signifying the Spirit's work of transforming the redeemed and regenerated saints into precious stones for the building of God's eternal habitation that they may express God corporately in His all-permeating glory. In the garden of Eden these three kinds of treasures merely existed as materials (Gen. 2:11-12), whereas in the city of New Jerusalem these precious materials become a builded city for the fulfillment of God's eternal purpose, which is to have a corporate expression.

footnotes.zh: 圣城的每一个门都是一颗珍珠，这表征城的进入是惟一而一次永远的；就是，惟有凭着基督得胜的死和分赐生命的复活，借着一次永远的重生，才能进城。
footnotes.zh_big5: 聖城的每一個門都是一顆珍珠，這表徵城的進入是惟一而一次永遠的；就是，惟有憑著基督得勝的死和分賜生命的復活，藉著一次永遠的重生，纔能進城。
footnotes.en: 21:21 2 one Each gate of the holy city is one pearl, signifying that the entrance to the city is unique and is once for all; that is, we can enter the city only through the once-for-all regeneration accomplished by Christ's overcoming death and life-imparting resurrection.

footnotes.zh: 门是为着进城，街道是为着日常的生活行动。进城是借着基督的死与复活；在城中日常的生活行动乃是照着由纯金街道所表征之神的神圣性情。接着重生的进入，圣徒日常的生活行动必须是在神的神圣性情的道路中。神的神圣性情乃是他们的道路。
footnotes.zh_big5: 門是為著進城，街道是為著日常的生活行動。進城是藉著基督的死與復活；在城中日常的生活行動乃是照著由純金街道所表徵之神的神聖性情。接著重生的進入，聖徒日常的生活行動必須是在神的神聖性情的道路中。神的神聖性情乃是他們的道路。
footnotes.en: 21:21 3 street The gates are for the entrance into the city, whereas the street is for the daily walk, the daily living, in the city. The entrance into the city is through Christ's death and resurrection, whereas the daily walk, the daily living, in the city is according to the divine nature of God, signified by the street being of pure gold. After the saints enter through regeneration, they must daily live and walk in God's divine nature as the way. The divine nature of God is their pathway.

footnotes.zh: 象征新耶路撒冷城本身及其街道的纯金，如同明净的玻璃(18)，这表征全城是透明的。虽然珍珠也许不透明，但每颗珍珠都是敞开的大门，昼夜总不关闭(25)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 象徵新耶路撒冷城本身及其街道的純金，如同明淨的玻璃，（18，）這表徵全城是透明的。雖然珍珠也許不透明，但每顆珍珠都是敞開的大門，晝夜總不關閉。（25。）
footnotes.en: 21:21 4 transparent The pure gold, which symbolizes the street and the city proper of the New Jerusalem, is like clear glass (v. 18), signifying that the whole city is transparent. Although the pearls may be opaque, every one of them is a great open gate, which will not be shut by day or by night (v. 25).

footnotes.zh_big5: 在舊約裏，神的帳幕是神殿的前身。新耶路撒冷乃是神的帳幕，（3，）作神的殿。這指明在新天新地裏，神的殿要擴大成為一座城。城的尺寸，長寬高都相等，（16，）指明全城就是至聖所，也就是內殿；所以城內沒有殿。
footnotes.en: 21:22 1 no In the Old Testament the tabernacle of God was a precursor of the temple of God. New Jerusalem as the tabernacle of God (v. 3) will be the temple of God. This indicates that in the new heaven and new earth the temple of God will be enlarged into a city. That the three dimensions of the city are equal (v. 16) indicates that the city as a whole will be the Holy of Holies, the inner temple. Hence, there will be no temple in it.

footnotes.zh: 原文意内殿。主神全能者和羔羊就是内殿；这表征神和羔羊自己是我们事奉神并居住的地方。圣城是神的帐幕，是为给神居住；神和羔羊是殿，是为给蒙救赎的圣徒居住。在新天新地里，新耶路撒冷乃是神与人相互的居所，直到永远。
footnotes.en: 21:22 2 temple The Greek word denotes the inner temple. This inner temple is the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb, signifying that God and the Lamb Themselves will be the place in which we serve God. The holy city as the tabernacle of God is for God to dwell in, and God and the Lamb as the temple are for the redeemed saints to dwell in. In the new heaven and new earth, the New Jerusalem will be a mutual dwelling place for God and man for eternity.

refs.text_gb: 得胜的，我要叫他在我神殿中作柱子，他也绝不再从那里出去；我又要将我神的名，和我神城的名，（这城就是由天上从我神那里降下来的新耶路撒冷，）并我的新名，都写在他上面。
refs.text_big5: 得勝的，我要叫他在我神殿中作柱子，他也絕不再從那裏出去；我又要將我神的名，和我神城的名，（這城就是由天上從我神那裏降下來的新耶路撒冷，）並我的新名，都寫在他上面。
refs.text_en: He who overcomes, him I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he shall by no means go out anymore, and I will write upon him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God, the New Jerusalem, which descends out of heaven from My God, and My new name.

refs.text_gb: 所以他们在神宝座前，昼夜在祂殿中事奉祂；坐宝座的要用帐幕覆庇他们。
refs.text_big5: 所以他們在神寶座前，晝夜在祂殿中事奉祂；坐寶座的要用帳幕覆庇他們。
refs.text_en: Because of this they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and He who sits upon the throne will tabernacle over them.

refs.text_gb: 有一根像量度之杖的苇子赐给我，又有话说，起来，将神的殿和坛、并殿中敬拜的人，都量一量。
refs.text_big5: 有一根像量度之杖的葦子賜給我，又有話說，起來，將神的殿和壇、並殿中敬拜的人，都量一量。
refs.text_en: And there was given to me a reed like a rod, and someone said, Rise and measure the temple of God and the altar and those who worship in it.

refs.text_gb: 于是，神天上的殿开了，在祂殿中现出祂的约柜，随后有闪电、声音、雷轰、地震、和大雹。
refs.text_big5: 於是，神天上的殿開了，在祂殿中現出祂的約櫃，隨後有閃電、聲音、雷轟、地震、和大雹。
refs.text_en: And the temple of God which is in heaven was opened, and the Ark of His Covenant was seen in His temple; and there were lightnings and voices and thunders and an earthquake and great hail.

refs.text_gb: 由于神的荣耀，并由于祂的能力，殿中充满了烟，于是没有人能进殿，直等到那七位天使所降的七灾完毕了。
refs.text_big5: 由於神的榮耀，並由於祂的能力，殿中充滿了煙，於是沒有人能進殿，直等到那七位天使所降的七災完畢了。
refs.text_en: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power, and no one could enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.

refs.text_gb: 主神说，我是阿拉法，我是俄梅嘎，是今是昔是以后永是的全能者。
refs.text_big5: 主神說，我是阿拉法，我是俄梅嘎，是今是昔是以後永是的全能者。
refs.text_en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, He who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见宝座与四活物中间，并众长老中间，有羔羊站立，像是刚被杀过的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見寶座與四活物中間，並眾長老中間，有羔羊站立，像是剛被殺過的，有七角和七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往全地去的。
refs.text_en: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders a Lamb standing as having just been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

refs.text_gb: 因为宝座中的羔羊必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉；神也必从他们眼中擦去一切的眼泪。
refs.text_big5: 因為寶座中的羔羊必牧養他們，領他們到生命水的泉；神也必從他們眼中擦去一切的眼淚。
refs.text_en: For the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and guide them to springs of waters of life; and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

refs.text_gb: 主啊，你世世代代作我们的居所。
refs.text_big5: 主阿，你世世代代作我們的居所。
refs.text_en: O Lord, You have been our dwelling place / In all generations.

refs.text_gb: 祂必作为圣所，却向以色列两家作绊脚的石头，并跌人的磐石，向耶路撒冷的居民作为圈套和网罗。
refs.text_big5: 祂必作為聖所，卻向以色列兩家作絆腳的石頭，並跌人的磐石，向耶路撒冷的居民作為圈套和網羅。
refs.text_en: Then He will become a sanctuary, yet a stone to strike against / And a rock of stumbling / To both houses of Israel, / A trap and a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

refs.text_gb: 所以你当说，主耶和华如此说，我虽将他们远远迁移到列国中，将他们分散在各地，我还要在他们所到的各地，暂作他们的圣所。
refs.text_big5: 所以你當說，主耶和華如此說，我雖將他們遠遠遷移到列國中，將他們分散在各地，我還要在他們所到的各地，暫作他們的聖所。
refs.text_en: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord Jehovah, Though I have sent them far away among the nations and though I have scattered them among the countries, I have been a sanctuary to them for a little while in the countries where they went.

refs.text_gb: 所以他们在神宝座前，昼夜在祂殿中事奉祂；坐宝座的要用帐幕覆庇他们。
refs.text_big5: 所以他們在神寶座前，晝夜在祂殿中事奉祂；坐寶座的要用帳幕覆庇他們。
refs.text_en: Because of this they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and He who sits upon the throne will tabernacle over them.

verses.text_gb: 那城内不[Fn1][Cra]需要日月光照，因有神的荣[Crb]耀光照，又有羔[Fn2]羊为城的灯[Crc]。
verses.text_big5: 那城內不[Fn1][Cra]需要日月光照，因有神的榮[Crb]耀光照，又有羔[Fn2]羊為城的燈[Crc]。
verses.text_en: And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon that they should shine in it, for the glory of God illumined it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那城内不需要日月光照，因有神的荣耀光照，又有羔羊为城的灯。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那城內不需要日月光照，因有神的榮耀光照，又有羔羊為城的燈。

footnotes.zh: 在千年国里，日光、月光都要加强(赛三十26)；但在新天新地的新耶路撒冷里，却不需要日月光照。在新天新地里有日月，但在新耶路撒冷不需要日月光照，因为神作神圣的光，要照耀得更为明亮。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在千年國裏，日光、月光都要加強；（賽三十26；）但在新天新地的新耶路撒冷裏，卻不需要日月光照。在新天新地裏有日月，但在新耶路撒冷不需要日月光照，因為神作神聖的光，要照耀得更為明亮。
footnotes.en: 21:23 1 no In the millennium the light of the sun and the moon will be intensified (Isa. 30:26). But in the New Jerusalem in the new heaven and new earth there will be no need of the shining of the sun or of the moon. The sun and moon will be present in the new heaven and new earth, but their shining will not be needed in the New Jerusalem, for God, the divine light, will shine much more brightly there.

footnotes.zh: 那是灯的羔羊凭着是光的神照耀，用神的荣耀，就是神圣之光的彰显，照亮这城。圣城既有这种神圣的光照亮，就无需天然的光，或人造的光(二二5)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 那是燈的羔羊憑著是光的神照耀，用神的榮耀，就是神聖之光的彰顯，照亮這城。聖城既有這種神聖的光照亮，就無需天然的光，或人造的光。（二二5。）
footnotes.en: 21:23 2 lamp The Lamb as the lamp will shine with God as the light to illumine the city with the glory of God, the expression of the divine light. Since the holy city will be illumined by such a divine light, it will need no other light, whether created by God or made by man (Rev. 22:5).

refs.text_gb: 不再有黑夜，他们也不需要灯光日光，因为主神要光照他们；他们要作王，直到永永远远。
refs.text_big5: 不再有黑夜，他們也不需要燈光日光，因為主神要光照他們；他們要作王，直到永永遠遠。
refs.text_en: And night will be no more; and they have no need of the light of a lamp and of the light of the sun, for the Lord God will shine upon them; and they will reign forever and ever.

refs.text_gb: 日头不再作你白昼的光，月亮也不再发光照耀你；耶和华却要作你永远的光，你的神要作你的荣美。
refs.text_big5: 日頭不再作你白晝的光，月亮也不再發光照耀你；耶和華卻要作你永遠的光，你的神要作你的榮美。
refs.text_en: You will no longer have the sun for your light by day, / Nor for brightness will the moon give you light; / But Jehovah will be an eternal light to you, / And your God your beauty.

refs.text_gb: 那时月亮要蒙羞，日头要惭愧；因为万军之耶和华必在锡安山、在耶路撒冷作王，在祂的长老面前必有荣耀。
refs.text_big5: 那時月亮要蒙羞，日頭要慚愧；因為萬軍之耶和華必在錫安山、在耶路撒冷作王，在祂的長老面前必有榮耀。
refs.text_en: Then the moon will be abashed, and the sun will be ashamed; / For Jehovah of hosts will reign / In Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, / And His glory will be before His elders.

refs.text_gb: 城中有神的荣耀；城的光辉如同极贵的宝石，好像碧玉，明如水晶；
refs.text_big5: 城中有神的榮耀；城的光輝如同極貴的寶石，好像碧玉，明如水晶；
refs.text_en: Having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, as clear as crystal.

refs.text_gb: 有闪电、声音、雷轰，从宝座中发出。又有七盏火灯在宝座前点着，这七灯就是神的七灵。
refs.text_big5: 有閃電、聲音、雷轟，從寶座中發出。又有七盞火燈在寶座前點著，這七燈就是神的七靈。
refs.text_en: And out of the throne come forth lightnings and voices and thunders. And there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God;

verses.text_gb: 列[Fn1][Cra]国要借着城的光[Fn2]行走，地[Fn3]上的君[Crb]王必将自己的荣[Fn4]耀带进那城。
verses.text_big5: 列[Fn1][Cra]國要藉著城的光[Fn2]行走，地[Fn3]上的君[Crb]王必將自己的榮[Fn4]耀帶進那城。
verses.text_en: And the nations will walk by its light; and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 列国要借着城的光行走，地上的君王必将自己的荣耀带进那城。
verses.text_big5_plain: 列國要藉著城的光行走，地上的君王必將自己的榮耀帶進那城。

footnotes.zh: 在今世末了，吹第六号和第七号时，地上大部分的居民都要被杀，其余的要在基督回到地上时，在祂荣耀的宝座前受审判。被定罪的山羊要受咒诅，在火湖里灭亡；被称义的绵羊却要蒙福，承受那从创世以来为他们所预备的国(太二五31～46)。他们不会得救、重生，像新约的信徒一样；他们只不过要被复兴到人起初被造的情形。他们是千年国里列国的人民，在其中得胜的信徒是君王(二十4，6)，得救的以色列遗民是祭司(亚八20～23)。千年国之后，列国中有一部分受了魔鬼迷惑而背叛主，就被天上降下的火烧灭(二十7～9)。其余的要迁到新地作列国，住在新耶路撒冷周围，并借着城的光行走；他们就是3～4节所说神的百姓。他们是受造却未重生的人，要因生命树叶子的医治而得维持(二二2)，永远活在受造时的情形中。即使对他们，也不再有死亡(4)；他们在新耶路撒冷神圣荣耀的照耀下，就也不在黑暗里。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在今世末了，吹第六號和第七號時，地上大部分的居民都要被殺，其餘的要在基督回到地上時，在祂榮耀的寶座前受審判。被定罪的山羊要受咒詛，在火湖裏滅亡；被稱義的綿羊卻要蒙福，承受那從創世以來為他們所豫備的國。（太二五31～46。）他們不會得救、重生，像新約的信徒一樣；他們只不過要被復興到人起初被造的情形。他們是千年國裏列國的人民，在其中得勝的信徒是君王，（二十4，6，）得救的以色列遺民是祭司。（亞八20～23。）千年國之後，列國中有一部分受了魔鬼迷惑而背叛主，就被天上降下的火燒滅。（二十7～9。）其餘的要遷到新地作列國，住在新耶路撒冷周圍，並藉著城的光行走；他們就是3～4節所說神的百姓。他們是受造卻未重生的人，要因生命樹葉子的醫治而得維持，（二二2，）永遠活在受造時的情形中。即使對他們，也不再有死亡；（4；）他們在新耶路撒冷神聖榮耀的照耀下，就也不在黑暗裏。
footnotes.en: 21:24 1 nations At the end of this age a great part of the inhabitants of the earth will be killed as a result of the sixth and seventh trumpets. The rest will be judged by Christ at the throne of His glory when He comes back to earth. The condemned ones, the "goats," will be cursed and will perish in the lake of fire, while the justified ones, the "sheep," will be blessed and will inherit the kingdom prepared for them from the foundation of the world (Matt. 25:31-46). Unlike the New Testament believers, the "sheep" will not be saved and regenerated they will only be restored to the original state of man as he was created by God. They will be the nations as citizens of the millennial kingdom, in which the overcoming believers will be the kings (Rev. 20:4, 6) and the saved remnant of Israel will be the priests (Zech. 8:20-23). After the millennial kingdom, a part of these nations, deceived by the devil, will rebel against the Lord and will be consumed by fire from heaven (Rev. 20:7-9). The rest will be transferred to the new earth to be the nations, which will live around the New Jerusalem and walk by its light. They will be the peoples mentioned in vv. 3-4. They, as created but unregenerated men, will be maintained to live forever in their created state through the healing of the leaves of the tree of life (Rev. 22:2). Even for them there will be no more death (v. 4). Under the shining of the New Jerusalem with the divine glory, neither will they be in darkness.

refs.text_gb: 在河这边与那边有生命树，生产十二样果子，每月都结出果子，树上的叶子乃为医治万民。
refs.text_big5: 在河這邊與那邊有生命樹，生產十二樣果子，每月都結出果子，樹上的葉子乃為醫治萬民。
refs.text_en: And on this side and on that side of the river was the tree of life, producing twelve fruits, yielding its fruit each month; and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

refs.text_gb: 列国要来就你的光，君王要来就你升起的光辉。
refs.text_big5: 列國要來就你的光，君王要來就你升起的光輝。
refs.text_en: And nations will come to your light, / And kings to the brightness of your rising.

refs.text_gb: 万民都要聚集在祂面前，祂要把他们彼此分开，好像牧人把绵羊从山羊分开一样；
refs.text_big5: 萬民都要聚集在祂面前，祂要把他們彼此分開，好像牧人把綿羊從山羊分開一樣；
refs.text_en: And all the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate them from one another, just as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

refs.text_gb: 绵羊安置在祂右边，山羊在左边。

refs.text_en: And He will set the sheep on His right hand and the goats on the left.

refs.text_gb: 于是王要对那在祂右边的说，你们这蒙我父赐福的，来承受那创世以来为你们所预备的国。
refs.text_big5: 於是王要對那在祂右邊的說，你們這蒙我父賜福的，來承受那創世以來為你們所豫備的國。
refs.text_en: Then the King will say to those on His right hand, Come, you who are blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

refs.text_gb: 他施和海岛并沿海一带的王要进贡；示巴和西巴的王要献礼物。
refs.text_big5: 他施和海島並沿海一帶的王要進貢；示巴和西巴的王要獻禮物。
refs.text_en: The kings of Tarshish and of the coastlands / Will pay tribute; / The kings of Sheba and Seba / Will present gifts.

refs.text_big5: 諸王都要叩拜祂；萬國都要事奉祂。
refs.text_en: And all the kings will bow down before Him; / All the nations will serve Him.

refs.text_big5: 你的城門必時常開放，晝夜不關，使人把列國的財富帶來歸你，並將他們的君王列隊牽引而來。
refs.text_en: And your gates will be open continually; / They will not be closed day or night, / So that they may bring to you the wealth of the nations / And their kings being led in procession.

refs.text_gb: 你也必吸食列国的奶，又吸食君王的奶；你便知道我耶和华是你的救主，是你的救赎主，雅各的大能者。
refs.text_big5: 你也必吸食列國的奶，又吸食君王的奶；你便知道我耶和華是你的救主，是你的救贖主，雅各的大能者。
refs.text_en: And you will suck the milk of nations / And suck the breast of kings; / Thus you will know that I, Jehovah, am your Savior / And your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

verses.text_gb: 城门白昼总[Fn1]不[Cra]关闭，在那里原没有黑[Fn2][Crb]夜。
verses.text_big5: 城門白晝總[Fn1]不[Cra]關閉，在那裏原沒有黑[Fn2][Crb]夜。
verses.text_en: And its gates shall by no means be shut by day, for there will be no night there.
verses.text_gb_plain: 城门白昼总不关闭，在那里原没有黑夜。
verses.text_big5_plain: 城門白晝總不關閉，在那裏原沒有黑夜。

footnotes.zh: 城墙将城从列国中分别出来，但城门向着列国乃是一直敞开的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 城牆將城從列國中分別出來，但城門向著列國乃是一直敞開的。
footnotes.en: 21:25 1 no The wall of the city will separate the city from the nations, but the gates will keep the city continually open to them.

footnotes.zh: 在新天新地里仍有昼夜之分，但在新耶路撒冷里就没有这样的区分，因为其中有神自己作更强烈的光，不分昼夜，一直照耀。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在新天新地裏仍有晝夜之分，但在新耶路撒冷裏就沒有這樣的區分，因為其中有神自己作更強烈的光，不分晝夜，一直照耀。
footnotes.en: 21:25 2 night In the new heaven and new earth there will still be the distinction between day and night, but in the New Jerusalem there will be no such distinction, for there, God Himself as the brighter light will shine continuously day and night.

refs.text_gb: 你的城门必时常开放，昼夜不关，使人把列国的财富带来归你，并将他们的君王列队牵引而来。
refs.text_big5: 你的城門必時常開放，晝夜不關，使人把列國的財富帶來歸你，並將他們的君王列隊牽引而來。
refs.text_en: And your gates will be open continually; / They will not be closed day or night, / So that they may bring to you the wealth of the nations / And their kings being led in procession.

refs.text_gb: 不再有黑夜，他们也不需要灯光日光，因为主神要光照他们；他们要作王，直到永永远远。
refs.text_big5: 不再有黑夜，他們也不需要燈光日光，因為主神要光照他們；他們要作王，直到永永遠遠。
refs.text_en: And night will be no more; and they have no need of the light of a lamp and of the light of the sun, for the Lord God will shine upon them; and they will reign forever and ever.

refs.text_gb: 神就是光，在祂里面毫无黑暗；这是我们从祂所听见，现在又报给你们的信息。
refs.text_big5: 神就是光，在祂裏面毫無黑暗；這是我們從祂所聽見，現在又報給你們的信息。
refs.text_en: And this is the message which we have heard from Him and announce to you, that God is light and in Him is no darkness at all.

verses.text_gb: 人必将列国的荣[Fn1][Cra]耀尊[Fn2]贵带进那城。
verses.text_big5: 人必將列國的榮[Fn1][Cra]耀尊[Fn2]貴帶進那城。
verses.text_en: And they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 人必将列国的荣耀尊贵带进那城。
verses.text_big5_plain: 人必將列國的榮耀尊貴帶進那城。

footnotes.en: 21:26 1 glory See note Rev. 21:24 4 .

footnotes.zh: 尊贵是指身分上的宝贵和地位上的尊严(参斯一4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 尊貴是指身分上的寶貴和地位上的尊嚴。（參斯一4。）
footnotes.en: 21:26 2 honor Honor refers to preciousness in status and dignity in position (cf. Esth. 1:4).

refs.text_gb: 那时你看见就有光荣，你的心又惊怕，又宽畅，因为大海的丰富必转来归你，列国的财富必来归你。
refs.text_big5: 那時你看見就有光榮，你的心又驚怕，又寬暢，因為大海的豐富必轉來歸你，列國的財富必來歸你。
refs.text_en: Then you will see and you will beam, / And your heart will be in awe and will swell with joy, / For the abundance of the sea will be turned to you, / The wealth of the nations will come to you.

verses.text_gb: 凡俗[Cra]污的，并那行可[Crb]憎与虚[Crc]谎之事的，绝不得进[Crd]那城，只有记[Fn1][Cre]在羔羊生命册[Fn2]上的，才得进去。
verses.text_big5: 凡俗[Cra]污的，並那行可[Crb]憎與虛[Crc]謊之事的，絕不得進[Crd]那城，只有記[Fn1][Cre]在羔羊生命冊[Fn2]上的，纔得進去。
verses.text_en: And anything common and he who makes an abomination and a lie shall by no means enter into it, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡俗污的，并那行可憎与虚谎之事的，绝不得进那城，只有记在羔羊生命册上的，才得进去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡俗污的，並那行可憎與虛謊之事的，絕不得進那城，只有記在羔羊生命冊上的，纔得進去。

footnotes.zh: 住在新耶路撒冷外新地上的列国，既然要将他们的荣耀、尊贵带进那城，那些记在羔羊生命册上的，就必定包括他们在内。
footnotes.zh_big5: 住在新耶路撒冷外新地上的列國，既然要將他們的榮耀、尊貴帶進那城，那些記在羔羊生命冊上的，就必定包括他們在內。
footnotes.en: 21:27 1 those Since the nations living on the new earth outside the New Jerusalem will bring their glory and honor into the city, they surely are included among those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.

footnotes.zh: 直译，书卷。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，書卷。
footnotes.en: 21:27 2 book Lit., scroll.

refs.text_gb: 锡安哪，醒起，醒起！穿上你的能力；圣城耶路撒冷啊，穿上你华美的衣服；因为未受割礼的和不洁净的，必不再进入你中间。
refs.text_big5: 錫安哪，醒起，醒起！穿上你的能力；聖城耶路撒冷阿，穿上你華美的衣服；因為未受割禮的和不潔淨的，必不再進入你中間。
refs.text_en: Awake! Awake! Put on / Your strength, O Zion; / Put on your beautiful garments, / O Jerusalem, O holy city; / For the uncircumcised and the unclean / Will no longer come into you.

refs.text_gb: 在那里必有一条大道，一条路，称为圣别之路；污秽人不得经过，乃为赎民行走；人虽愚昧，也不至失迷。
refs.text_big5: 在那裏必有一條大道，一條路，稱為聖別之路；污穢人不得經過，乃為贖民行走；人雖愚昧，也不至失迷。
refs.text_en: And a highway will be there, and a way, / And it will be called, The Way of Holiness. / The unclean will not pass on it, / But it will be for him who walks on the way; / No fools will err in it.

refs.text_gb: 唯有胆怯的、不信的、可憎的、杀人的、淫乱的、行邪术的、拜偶像的、和一切虚谎的，他们的分就在烧着硫磺的火湖里；这是第二次的死。
refs.text_big5: 惟有膽怯的、不信的、可憎的、殺人的、淫亂的、行邪術的、拜偶像的、和一切虛謊的，他們的分就在燒著硫磺的火湖裏；這是第二次的死。
refs.text_en: But the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and fornicators and sorcerers and idolaters and all the false, their part will be in the lake which burns with fire and brimstone, which is the second death.

refs.text_gb: 城外有那些犬类、行邪术的、淫乱的、杀人的、拜偶像的、和一切喜好并编造谎言的。
refs.text_big5: 城外有那些犬類、行邪術的、淫亂的、殺人的、拜偶像的、和一切喜好並編造謊言的。
refs.text_en: Outside are the dogs and the sorcerers and the fornicators and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone who loves and makes a lie.

refs.text_gb: 那些洗净自己袍子的有福了，可得权柄到生命树那里，也能从门进城。
refs.text_big5: 那些洗淨自己袍子的有福了，可得權柄到生命樹那裏，也能從門進城。
refs.text_en: Blessed are those who wash their robes that they may have right to the tree of life and may enter by the gates into the city.

refs.text_gb: 凡住在地上，名字没有记在从创世以来被杀之羔羊生命册上的人，都要拜它。
refs.text_big5: 凡住在地上，名字沒有記在從創世以來被殺之羔羊生命冊上的人，都要拜牠。
refs.text_en: And all those dwelling on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name is not written in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain from the foundation of the world.

verses.text_gb: 天使又指[Cra]给我看在城内街[Fn1][Crb]道当中一道生[Fn2][Crc]命水的河[Fn3][Crd]，明亮如水[Fn4][Cre]晶，从神[Fn5]和羔羊的宝[Crf]座流[Crg]出来。
verses.text_big5: 天使又指[Cra]給我看在城內街[Fn1][Crb]道當中一道生[Fn2][Crc]命水的河[Fn3][Crd]，明亮如水[Fn4][Cre]晶，從神[Fn5]和羔羊的寶[Crf]座流[Crg]出來。
verses.text_en: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb in the middle of its street.
verses.text_gb_plain: 天使又指给我看在城内街道当中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，从神和羔羊的宝座流出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 天使又指給我看在城內街道當中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，從神和羔羊的寶座流出來。

footnotes.zh: 圣城的街道是纯金(二一21)，金象征神圣的性情。生命水的河在街道当中流着，表征神圣的生命在神圣的性情里涌流，作神赎民日常生活的惟一道路。那里有神圣生命的涌流，那里就有神圣的性情作圣别的道路，给神的百姓凭以行事；那里有神圣性情的圣别道路，那里就有神圣生命的涌流。神圣的生命和作圣别道路之神圣的性情，总是同行的。所以神生命水的河，是顺着神圣的道路便于应用的。我们是借着行在这生命的道路中，享受这生命水的河。
footnotes.zh_big5: 聖城的街道是純金，（二一21，）金象徵神聖的性情。生命水的河在街道當中流著，表徵神聖的生命在神聖的性情裏湧流，作神贖民日常生活的惟一道路。那裏有神聖生命的湧流，那裏就有神聖的性情作聖別的道路，給神的百姓憑以行事；那裏有神聖性情的聖別道路，那裏就有神聖生命的湧流。神聖的生命和作聖別道路之神聖的性情，總是同行的。所以神生命水的河，是順著神聖的道路便於應用的。我們是藉著行在這生命的道路中，享受這生命水的河。
footnotes.en: 22:1 1 he He refers to the angel in Rev. 21:9.

footnotes.zh: 生命水象征神在基督里成为那灵，将自己流进祂所救赎的人里面，作他们的生命和生命的供应。这是从裂开磐石流出的水(出十七6，民二十11)所预表的，也是从主耶稣被扎的肋旁流出的水(约十九34)所象征的。这里的生命水成了一道河，从神和羔羊的宝座流出来，供应并浸透整个新耶路撒冷，所以这城充满神圣的生命，在神生命的荣耀中彰显祂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 生命水象徵神在基督裏成為那靈，將自己流進祂所救贖的人裏面，作他們的生命和生命的供應。這是從裂開磐石流出的水（出十七6，民二十11）所豫表的，也是從主耶穌被扎的肋旁流出的水（約十九34）所象徵的。這裏的生命水成了一道河，從神和羔羊的寶座流出來，供應並浸透整個新耶路撒冷，所以這城充滿神聖的生命，在神生命的榮耀中彰顯祂。
footnotes.en: 22:1 2 river The river here, typified by the rivers in Gen. 2:10-14, Psa. 46:4, and Ezek. 47:5-9, signifies the abundance of life in its flow. It is one river, flowing to the four corners of the holy city, like the one river in Gen. 2:10-14, which parts into four heads. As indicated in John 7:38, this one river with its riches becomes many rivers in our experience of the different aspects of the riches of God's Spirit of life (Rom. 8:2; 15:30; 1 Thes. 1:6; 2 Thes. 2:13; Gal. 5:22-23).

footnotes.zh: 这河就如创二10～14，诗四六4，结四七5～9的河所预表的，是表征在其流中生命的丰盛。这是一道河，流遍圣城的四方，就像创二10～14的一条河分为四道。这一道河连同它的丰富，在我们对神生命之灵各面的丰富(罗八2，十五30，帖前一6，帖后二13，加五22～23)所有不同的经历中，成了许多道河，如约七38所指明的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這河就如創二10～14，詩四六4，結四七5～9的河所豫表的，是表徵在其流中生命的豐盛。這是一道河，流遍聖城的四方，就像創二10～14的一條河分為四道。這一道河連同它的豐富，在我們對神生命之靈各面的豐富（羅八2，十五30，帖前一6，帖後二13，加五22～23）所有不同的經歷中，成了許多道河，如約七38所指明的。
footnotes.en: 22:1 3 water The water of life is a symbol of God in Christ as the Spirit flowing Himself into His redeemed people to be their life and life supply. It is typified by the water that came out of the riven rock (Exo. 17:6; Num. 20:11) and symbolized by the water that flowed out of the pierced side of the Lord Jesus (John 19:34). Here, the water of life becomes a river, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb to supply and saturate the entire New Jerusalem. Thus this city is filled with the divine life that it may express God in His glory of life.

footnotes.zh: 生命水明亮如水晶，毫无模糊、不透明之处。这生命水在我们里面涌流时，就纯净我们，使我们透明如同水晶。
footnotes.zh_big5: 生命水明亮如水晶，毫無糢糊、不透明之處。這生命水在我們裏面湧流時，就純淨我們，使我們透明如同水晶。
footnotes.en: 22:1 4 crystal The water of life is bright as crystal, having no dimness or opaqueness. When this water of life flows in us, it purifies us and makes us as transparent as crystal.

footnotes.zh: “神和羔羊的宝座，”一个宝座既为着神，也为着羔羊，表征神和羔羊乃是一——祂是羔羊神，是救赎的神，是神那救赎者。在永世里，坐宝座的神乃是我们救赎的神，从祂的宝座有生命水的河流出来，作我们的供应和满足。这描述三一神——神、羔羊和生命水所象征的那灵——如何在祂元首权柄(宝座的权柄所含示的)之下，将自己分赐给祂所救赎的人，直到永远。
footnotes.zh_big5: “神和羔羊的寶座，”一個寶座既為著神，也為著羔羊，表徵神和羔羊乃是一─祂是羔羊神，是救贖的神，是神那救贖者。在永世裏，坐寶座的神乃是我們救贖的神，從祂的寶座有生命水的河流出來，作我們的供應和滿足。這描述三一神─神、羔羊和生命水所象徵的那靈─如何在祂元首權柄（寶座的權柄所含示的）之下，將自己分賜給祂所救贖的人，直到永遠。
footnotes.en: 22:1 5 throne The throne of God and of the Lamb, showing that there is one throne for both God and the Lamb, indicates that God and the Lamb are one — the Lamb-God, the redeeming God, God the Redeemer. In eternity the very God who sits on the throne is our redeeming God, from whose throne proceeds the river of water of life for our supply and satisfaction. This depicts how the Triune God — God, the Lamb, and the Spirit, who is symbolized by the water of life — dispenses Himself to His redeemed under His headship (implied in the authority of the throne) for eternity.

refs.text_gb: 拿着七个金碗，盛满末后七灾的七位天使中，有一位来对我说，你来，我要将新妇，就是羔羊的妻，指给你看。
refs.text_big5: 拿著七個金碗，盛滿末後七災的七位天使中，有一位來對我說，你來，我要將新婦，就是羔羊的妻，指給你看。
refs.text_en: And one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and spoke with me, saying, Come here; I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠，每一个门各自是一颗珍珠造的，城内的街道是纯金，好像透明的玻璃。
refs.text_big5: 十二個門是十二顆珍珠，每一個門各自是一顆珍珠造的，城內的街道是純金，好像透明的玻璃。
refs.text_en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was, respectively, of one pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

refs.text_gb: 那灵和新妇说，来！听见的人也该说，来！口渴的人也当来；愿意的都可以白白取生命的水喝。
refs.text_big5: 那靈和新婦說，來！聽見的人也該說，來！口渴的人也當來；願意的都可以白白取生命的水喝。
refs.text_en: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come! And let him who hears say, Come! And let him who is thirsty come; let him who wills take the water of life freely.

refs.text_gb: 祂又对我说，都成了。我是阿拉法，我是俄梅嘎；我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水白白赐给那口渴的人喝。
refs.text_big5: 祂又對我說，都成了。我是阿拉法，我是俄梅嘎；我是初，我是終。我要將生命泉的水白白賜給那口渴的人喝。
refs.text_en: And He said to me, They have come to pass. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give to him who thirsts from the spring of the water of life freely.

refs.text_gb: 因为宝座中的羔羊必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉；神也必从他们眼中擦去一切的眼泪。
refs.text_big5: 因為寶座中的羔羊必牧養他們，領他們到生命水的泉；神也必從他們眼中擦去一切的眼淚。
refs.text_en: For the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and guide them to springs of waters of life; and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

refs.text_gb: 人若喝我所赐的水，就永远不渴；我所赐的水，要在他里面成为泉源，直涌入永远的生命。
refs.text_big5: 人若喝我所賜的水，就永遠不渴；我所賜的水，要在他裏面成為泉源，直湧入永遠的生命。
refs.text_en: But whoever drinks of the water that I will give him shall by no means thirst forever; but the water that I will give him will become in him a fountain of water springing up into eternal life.

refs.text_gb: 有一道河从伊甸流出来滋润那园子，从那里分为四道。
refs.text_big5: 有一道河從伊甸流出來滋潤那園子，從那裏分為四道。
refs.text_en: And a river went forth from Eden to water the garden, and from there it divided and became four branches.

refs.text_gb: 他们必因你殿里的肥甘得以饱足，你也必叫他们喝你乐河的水。
refs.text_big5: 他們必因你殿裏的肥甘得以飽足，你也必叫他們喝你樂河的水。
refs.text_en: They are saturated with the fatness of Your house, / And You cause them to drink of the river of Your pleasures.

refs.text_big5: 有一道河，這河的支流，使神的城快樂；這城就是至高者支搭帳幕的聖處。

refs.text_big5: 你眷顧並澆灌地，使地大得肥美：神的河滿了水；你這樣豫備了地，好為人豫備五穀。
refs.text_en: You visit the earth and water it; / You enrich it greatly: / The river of God is full of water. / You provide men grain, for so You have prepared the earth.

refs.text_gb: 祂又量了一千肘，水便成了河，使我不能蹚过；因为水势涨起，成为可洑的水，不可蹚的河。

refs.text_en: Then He measured a thousand cubits, and it was a river that I could not pass through; for the water had risen, enough water to swim in, a river that could not be crossed.

refs.text_gb: 这河所到之处，凡滋生有生命的动物都必生活，并且这水到了那里，就有极多的鱼。海水得了医治，并且这河所到之处，百物都必生活。

refs.text_en: And every living creature which swarms in every place where the river goes shall live, and there will be very many fish when this water comes there. And the water of the sea shall be healed, and everything shall live wherever the river comes.

refs.text_gb: 信入我的人，就如经上所说，从他腹中要流出活水的江河来。

refs.text_en: He who believes into Me, as the Scripture said, out of his innermost being shall flow rivers of living water.

refs.text_en: A stream of fire issued forth / And came out from before Him. / Thousands of thousands ministered to Him, / And ten thousands of ten thousands stood before Him. / The court of judgment sat, / And the books were opened.

footnotes.zh: 一棵生命树长在河的两岸，表征生命树是一种藤蔓，沿着生命水的流伸展、蔓延，给神的子民接受并享受。这树实现了神原初的心意(创二9)，直到永远。因着人的堕落，生命树向人封闭了(创三22～24)；但借着基督的救赎，又向信徒开启了(来十19～20)。今天，享受基督作生命树是信徒共同的分(约六35，57)；在千年国，得胜的信徒要享受基督这生命树作他们时代的赏赐(二7)；最终，在新天新地里，所有蒙神救赎的人都要享受基督这生命树作永远的分(14，19)。基督这生命树，乃是沿着生命水，就是那灵的流，作为便利取用的生命供应。那里有那灵的流，那里就可找着基督生命的供应。这全在于神圣的性情，并以神圣的性情作我们圣别的道路，如街道所象征的。这是圣城的供应，也是圣城得供应的路。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一棵生命樹長在河的兩岸，表徵生命樹是一種藤蔓，沿著生命水的流伸展、蔓延，給神的子民接受並享受。這樹實現了神原初的心意，（創二9，）直到永遠。因著人的墮落，生命樹向人封閉了；（創三22～24；）但藉著基督的救贖，又向信徒開啟了。（來十19～20。）今天，享受基督作生命樹是信徒共同的分；（約六35，57；）在千年國，得勝的信徒要享受基督這生命樹作他們時代的賞賜；（二7；）最終，在新天新地裏，所有蒙神救贖的人都要享受基督這生命樹作永遠的分。（14，19。）基督這生命樹，乃是沿著生命水，就是那靈的流，作為便利取用的生命供應。那裏有那靈的流，那裏就可找著基督生命的供應。這全在於神聖的性情，並以神聖的性情作我們聖別的道路，如街道所象徵的。這是聖城的供應，也是聖城得供應的路。
footnotes.en: 22:2 1 tree That the one tree of life grows on the two sides of the river signifies that the tree of life is a vine that spreads and proceeds along the flow of the water of life for God's people to receive and enjoy. This tree fulfills for eternity what God intended from the beginning (Gen. 2:9). The tree of life was closed to man because of his fall (Gen. 3:22-24), but it was opened to the believers through the redemption of Christ (Heb. 10:19-20). Today the enjoyment of Christ as the tree of life is the believers' common portion (John 6:35, 57). In the millennial kingdom the enjoyment of Christ as the tree of life will be a dispensational reward to the overcoming believers (Rev. 2:7). Eventually, in the new heaven and new earth for eternity, the enjoyment of Christ as the tree of life will be the eternal portion of all God's redeemed (vv. 14, 19). Christ as the tree of life is the life supply available along the flow of the Spirit as the water of life. Where the Spirit flows, there the life supply of Christ is found. This is all in and with the divine nature as our holy way, signified by the street. This is the supply of the holy city, and this is the way the city is supplied.

footnotes.zh: 生命树的果子要作神赎民的食物，直到永远；这些果子始终是新鲜的，每月都结，每年结十二样果子。生命树结十二样果子，是说生命树的果子是丰富的，够完成神永远的行政用的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 生命樹的果子要作神贖民的食物，直到永遠；這些果子始終是新鮮的，每月都結，每年結十二樣果子。生命樹結十二樣果子，是說生命樹的果子是豐富的，彀完成神永遠的行政用的。
footnotes.en: 22:2 2 fruits The fruits of the tree of life will be the food of God's redeemed for eternity. They will be continually fresh, being produced every month, twelve fruits yearly. That the tree of life bears twelve fruits means that the fruit of the tree of life is rich and is sufficient for the carrying out of God's eternal administration.

footnotes.zh: 直译，按着每一个月。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，按著每一個月。
footnotes.en: 22:2 3 each Lit., according to each month.

footnotes.zh: “月”指明将来在新天新地里仍有月亮，划分十二个月；也仍然有太阳，将昼夜分开，各十二小时。七是代表召会的数字，表征神在祂现今的经纶里，与祂所造的人相加；十二是新耶路撒冷的数字，表征神在祂永远的行政里，与祂所造的人相调。新耶路撒冷有十二根基，上面有十二使徒的名字；还有十二个门，就是十二颗珍珠，门上有十二支派的名字；此外还有生命树的十二样果子。就空间说，城的长宽高各为一万二千斯泰底亚，是一千乘十二；城墙高一百四十四肘，是十二乘十二。就时间说，新天新地每年有十二个月，白天有十二小时，夜晚也有十二小时。
footnotes.zh_big5: “月”指明將來在新天新地裏仍有月亮，劃分十二個月；也仍然有太陽，將晝夜分開，各十二小時。七是代表召會的數字，表徵神在祂現今的經綸裏，與祂所造的人相加；十二是新耶路撒冷的數字，表徵神在祂永遠的行政裏，與祂所造的人相調。新耶路撒冷有十二根基，上面有十二使徒的名字；還有十二個門，就是十二顆珍珠，門上有十二支派的名字；此外還有生命樹的十二樣果子。就空間說，城的長寬高各為一萬二千斯泰底亞，是一千乘十二；城牆高一百四十四肘，是十二乘十二。就時間說，新天新地每年有十二個月，白天有十二小時，夜晚也有十二小時。
footnotes.en: 22:2 4 month Month indicates that in the new heaven and new earth the moon still will be there to divide the twelve months. The sun also will be there to separate day and night into periods of twelve hours each. While the number that represents the church is seven, signifying that God in His present dispensation is added to His creature, man, the number that represents the New Jerusalem is twelve, signifying that God in His eternal administration is mingled with His creature, man. In the New Jerusalem are the twelve foundations, inscribed with the names of the twelve apostles; the twelve gates, which are twelve pearls, inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes; and the twelve fruits of the tree of life. With regard to space, the city proper is twelve thousand stadia, one thousand times twelve, in each of its three dimensions, and its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, twelve times twelve, in height. With regard to time, in the new heaven and new earth there are twelve months yearly, twelve hours daily, and twelve hours nightly.

footnotes.zh: 生命树的叶子乃为医治万民。在圣经里，叶子象征人的行为(创三7)。生命树的叶子象征基督的行为。重生的信徒吃生命树的果子，接受基督作内里的生命和生命的供应，使他们得享神圣的生命，直到永远；复兴的万民是靠生命树的叶子得医治，以基督的行为作外在的引导和规律，使他们过人的生活，直到永远。
footnotes.zh_big5: 生命樹的葉子乃為醫治萬民。在聖經裏，葉子象徵人的行為。（創三7。）生命樹的葉子象徵基督的行為。重生的信徒喫生命樹的果子，接受基督作內裏的生命和生命的供應，使他們得享神聖的生命，直到永遠；復興的萬民是靠生命樹的葉子得醫治，以基督的行為作外在的引導和規律，使他們過人的生活，直到永遠。
footnotes.en: 22:2 5 leaves The leaves of the tree of life are for the healing of the nations. In the Bible, leaves are a symbol of man's deeds (Gen. 3:7). The leaves of the tree of life symbolize the deeds of Christ. The regenerated believers eat the fruit of the tree of life, receiving Christ as their inward life and life supply, that they may enjoy the divine life for eternity, whereas the restored nations are healed by the leaves of the tree of life, taking the deeds of Christ as their outward guide and regulation, that they may live the human life forever.

verses.text_gb: 一切咒[Fn1][Cra]诅必不再有。在城里有神[Fn2]和羔羊的宝座；祂的奴[Crb]仆都要事[Fn3][Crc]奉祂[Fn4]，
verses.text_big5: 一切咒[Fn1][Cra]詛必不再有。在城裏有神[Fn2]和羔羊的寶座；祂的奴[Crb]僕都要事[Fn3][Crc]奉祂[Fn4]，
verses.text_en: And there will no longer be a curse. And the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His slaves will serve Him;
verses.text_gb_plain: 一切咒诅必不再有。在城里有神和羔羊的宝座；祂的奴仆都要事奉祂，
verses.text_big5_plain: 一切咒詛必不再有。在城裏有神和羔羊的寶座；祂的奴僕都要事奉祂，

footnotes.zh: 或，受咒诅的事。咒诅是因亚当的堕落进来的(创三17)，却被基督的救赎对付了(加三13)。在新天新地里既不再有堕落，就再没有咒诅。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，受咒詛的事。咒詛是因亞當的墮落進來的，（創三17，）卻被基督的救贖對付了。（加三13。）在新天新地裏既不再有墮落，就再沒有咒詛。
footnotes.en: 22:3 1 a Or, anything accursed.

footnotes.zh: 神和羔羊的宝座，是神所救赎的人在永世里所要享受的福分之一。他们不再受任何咒诅，神和羔羊的宝座要作他们永远的分。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神和羔羊的寶座，是神所救贖的人在永世裏所要享受的福分之一。他們不再受任何咒詛，神和羔羊的寶座要作他們永遠的分。
footnotes.en: 22:3 2 curse The curse came in through Adam's fall (Gen. 3:17) and was dealt with by Christ's redemption (Gal. 3:13). Since in the new heaven and new earth the fall will be no more, there will no longer be a curse.

footnotes.zh: 原文指作祭司事奉。这样事奉神和羔羊，也是神所救赎的人在永世里所得的福分。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文指作祭司事奉。這樣事奉神和羔羊，也是神所救贖的人在永世裏所得的福分。
footnotes.en: 22:3 3 throne The throne of God and of the Lamb is one of the blessings that God's redeemed will enjoy in eternity. They will no longer suffer any curse; the throne of God and of the Lamb will be their eternal portion.

footnotes.zh: 本节与4节的祂，都是指神和羔羊。在永世里，神和羔羊乃是一。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本節與4節的祂，都是指神和羔羊。在永世裏，神和羔羊乃是一。
footnotes.en: 22:3 4 serve The Greek word denotes serving as priests. To serve God and the Lamb also will be a blessing to God's redeemed in eternity.

refs.text_gb: 又对亚当说，你既听妻子的话，吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子，地必因你的缘故受咒诅；你必终身劳苦，才能从地里得吃的。
refs.text_big5: 又對亞當說，你既聽妻子的話，喫了我所吩咐你不可喫的那樹上的果子，地必因你的緣故受咒詛；你必終身勞苦，纔能從地裏得喫的。
refs.text_en: And to Adam He said, Because you listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten of the tree concerning which I commanded you, saying, You shall not eat of it; Cursed is the ground because of you; / In toil will you eat of it / All the days of your life.

refs.text_gb: 基督既为我们成了咒诅，就赎出我们脱离律法的咒诅，因为经上记着：“凡挂在木头上的，都是被咒诅的，”
refs.text_big5: 基督既為我們成了咒詛，就贖出我們脫離律法的咒詛，因為經上記著：“凡掛在木頭上的，都是被咒詛的，”
refs.text_en: Christ has redeemed us out of the curse of the law, having become a curse on our behalf; because it is written, "Cursed is everyone hanging on a tree";

refs.text_gb: 人必住在其中，不再有咒诅；耶路撒冷人必安然居住。
refs.text_big5: 人必住在其中，不再有咒詛；耶路撒冷人必安然居住。
refs.text_en: And people will dwell in her, and there will be no more curse, for Jerusalem will dwell securely.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣基督的启示，就是神赐给祂，叫祂将必要快发生的事指示祂的众奴仆；祂就借着祂的使者传达，用表号指示祂的奴仆约翰。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌基督的啟示，就是神賜給祂，叫祂將必要快發生的事指示祂的眾奴僕；祂就藉著祂的使者傳達，用表號指示祂的奴僕約翰。
refs.text_en: The revelation of Jesus Christ which God gave to Him to show to His slaves the things that must quickly take place; and He made it known by signs, sending it by His angel to His slave John,

refs.text_gb: 所以他们在神宝座前，昼夜在祂殿中事奉祂；坐宝座的要用帐幕覆庇他们。
refs.text_big5: 所以他們在神寶座前，晝夜在祂殿中事奉祂；坐寶座的要用帳幕覆庇他們。
refs.text_en: Because of this they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and He who sits upon the throne will tabernacle over them.

refs.text_gb: 又使我们成为国度，作祂神与父的祭司；愿荣耀权能归与祂，直到永永远远。阿们。
refs.text_big5: 又使我們成為國度，作祂神與父的祭司；願榮耀權能歸與祂，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
refs.text_en: And made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father, to Him be the glory and the might forever and ever. Amen.

refs.text_gb: 又叫他们成为国度，作祭司，归与我们的神；他们要在地上执掌王权。
refs.text_big5: 又叫他們成為國度，作祭司，歸與我們的神；他們要在地上執掌王權。
refs.text_en: And have made them a kingdom and priests to our God; and they will reign on the earth.

verses.text_gb: 也要见[Fn1][Cra]祂的面[Crb]；祂的名[Crc]字必在他们的额上。
verses.text_big5: 也要見[Fn1][Cra]祂的面[Crb]；祂的名[Crc]字必在他們的額上。
verses.text_en: And they will see His face, and His name will be on their forehead.
verses.text_gb_plain: 也要见祂的面；祂的名字必在他们的额上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 也要見祂的面；祂的名字必在他們的額上。

footnotes.zh: 见神和羔羊的面，并有祂的名字在他们额上，也是神所救赎的人在永世所得享受三一神的福分。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見神和羔羊的面，並有祂的名字在他們額上，也是神所救贖的人在永世所得享受三一神的福分。
footnotes.en: 22:4 1 see To see the face of God and of the Lamb and to have His name on their foreheads also will be blessings of the Triune God enjoyed by God's redeemed in eternity.

refs.text_gb: 清心的人有福了，因为他们必看见神。
refs.text_big5: 清心的人有福了，因為他們必看見神。
refs.text_en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

refs.text_gb: 我的魂渴想神，就是活神。我几时才可以来朝见神呢？
refs.text_big5: 我的魂渴想神，就是活神。我幾時纔可以來朝見神呢？
refs.text_en: My soul thirsts for God, / For the living God. / When will I come and appear / Before God?

refs.text_gb: 愿耶和华使祂的面光照你，赐恩给你；
refs.text_big5: 願耶和華使祂的面光照你，賜恩給你；
refs.text_en: Jehovah make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you;

refs.text_gb: 愿耶和华向你仰脸，赐你平安。
refs.text_big5: 願耶和華向你仰臉，賜你平安。
refs.text_en: Jehovah lift up His countenance upon you and give you peace.

refs.text_gb: 至于我，我必在义中见你的面；我醒了的时候，必因见你的形像而心满意足。
refs.text_big5: 至於我，我必在義中見你的面；我醒了的時候，必因見你的形像而心滿意足。
refs.text_en: As for me, in righteousness I will behold Your face; / When I awake, I will be satisfied with Your likeness.

refs.text_gb: 我的魂哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神；因祂的脸是我的救恩，我还要赞美祂。
refs.text_big5: 我的魂哪，你為何憂悶？為何在我裏面煩躁？應當仰望神；因祂的臉是我的救恩，我還要讚美祂。
refs.text_en: Why are you cast down, O my soul? / And why are you disquieted within me? / Hope in God, for I will yet praise Him / For the salvation of His countenance.

refs.text_gb: 因为他们不是靠自己的刀剑得地土，也不是靠自己的膀臂得拯救；乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂、和你脸上的亮光，因为你喜悦他们。
refs.text_big5: 因為他們不是靠自己的刀劍得地土，也不是靠自己的膀臂得拯救；乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂、和你臉上的亮光，因為你喜悅他們。
refs.text_en: For they did not possess the land by their sword, / Nor did their arm save them; / Rather it was Your right hand and Your arm, / And the light of Your countenance; / For You delighted in them.

refs.text_gb: 得胜的，我要叫他在我神殿中作柱子，他也绝不再从那里出去；我又要将我神的名，和我神城的名，（这城就是由天上从我神那里降下来的新耶路撒冷，）并我的新名，都写在他上面。
refs.text_big5: 得勝的，我要叫他在我神殿中作柱子，他也絕不再從那裏出去；我又要將我神的名，和我神城的名，（這城就是由天上從我神那裏降下來的新耶路撒冷，）並我的新名，都寫在他上面。
refs.text_en: He who overcomes, him I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he shall by no means go out anymore, and I will write upon him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God, the New Jerusalem, which descends out of heaven from My God, and My new name.

refs.text_gb: 我又观看，看哪，羔羊站在锡安山上，同祂还有十四万四千人，额上都写着祂的名，和祂父的名。
refs.text_big5: 我又觀看，看哪，羔羊站在錫安山上，同祂還有十四萬四千人，額上都寫著祂的名，和祂父的名。
refs.text_en: And I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him a hundred and forty-four thousand, having His name and the name of His Father written on their foreheads.

verses.text_gb: 不再有黑[Fn1][Cra]夜，他们也不[Crb]需要灯[Fn2]光日光，因为主[Fn3]神要光照他们；他们要作[Fn4][Crc]王，直到永永远远。
verses.text_big5: 不再有黑[Fn1][Cra]夜，他們也不[Crb]需要燈[Fn2]光日光，因為主[Fn3]神要光照他們；他們要作[Fn4][Crc]王，直到永永遠遠。
verses.text_en: And night will be no more; and they have no need of the light of a lamp and of the light of the sun, for the Lord God will shine upon them; and they will reign forever and ever.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不再有黑夜，他们也不需要灯光日光，因为主神要光照他们；他们要作王，直到永永远远。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不再有黑夜，他們也不需要燈光日光，因為主神要光照他們；他們要作王，直到永永遠遠。

footnotes.zh: 见二一25注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見二一25註2。
footnotes.en: 22:5 1 night See note Rev. 21:25 2 .

footnotes.zh: 灯光是人造的，日光是神创造的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 燈光是人造的，日光是神創造的。
footnotes.en: 22:5 2 light The light of a lamp is made by man, and the light of the sun is created by God.

footnotes.zh: 主神要光照他们，是神所救赎的人在永世里的另一福分。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主神要光照他們，是神所救贖的人在永世裏的另一福分。
footnotes.en: 22:5 3 Lord To be shined upon by the Lord God will be another blessing to God's redeemed in eternity.

footnotes.zh: 作王直到永远，是神所救赎的人在永世里最终的福分。
footnotes.zh_big5: 作王直到永遠，是神所救贖的人在永世裏最終的福分。
footnotes.en: 22:5 4 reign To reign forever will be the final blessing to God's redeemed in eternity.

refs.text_gb: 城门白昼总不关闭，在那里原没有黑夜。
refs.text_big5: 城門白晝總不關閉，在那裏原沒有黑夜。
refs.text_en: And its gates shall by no means be shut by day, for there will be no night there.

refs.text_gb: 那城内不需要日月光照，因有神的荣耀光照，又有羔羊为城的灯。
refs.text_big5: 那城內不需要日月光照，因有神的榮耀光照，又有羔羊為城的燈。
refs.text_en: And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon that they should shine in it, for the glory of God illumined it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 又叫他们成为国度，作祭司，归与我们的神；他们要在地上执掌王权。
refs.text_big5: 又叫他們成為國度，作祭司，歸與我們的神；他們要在地上執掌王權。
refs.text_en: And have made them a kingdom and priests to our God; and they will reign on the earth.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见几个宝座和坐在上面的，有审判的权柄赐给他们。我又看见那些为耶稣的见证、并为神的话被斩者，以及那些没有拜过兽与兽像，额上和手上也没有受过它印记之人的魂，他们都活了，与基督一同作王一千年。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見幾個寶座和坐在上面的，有審判的權柄賜給他們。我又看見那些為耶穌的見證、並為神的話被斬者，以及那些沒有拜過獸與獸像，額上和手上也沒有受過牠印記之人的魂，他們都活了，與基督一同作王一千年。
refs.text_en: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and of those who had not worshipped the beast nor his image, and had not received the mark on their forehead and on their hand; and they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

verses.text_gb: 天[Fn1]使又对我说，这些话是可[Cra]信真实的；主[Fn2]，就是众[Crb]申言者之灵[Fn3][Crc]的神[Crd]，差遣祂的使者，将那必要快发生的事指[Cre]示祂的奴仆。
verses.text_big5: 天[Fn1]使又對我說，這些話是可[Cra]信真實的；主[Fn2]，就是眾[Crb]申言者之靈[Fn3][Crc]的神[Crd]，差遣祂的使者，將那必要快發生的事指[Cre]示祂的奴僕。
verses.text_en: And he said to me, These words are faithful and true; and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show to His slaves the things which must quickly take place.
verses.text_gb_plain: 天使又对我说，这些话是可信真实的；主，就是众申言者之灵的神，差遣祂的使者，将那必要快发生的事指示祂的奴仆。
verses.text_big5_plain: 天使又對我說，這些話是可信真實的；主，就是眾申言者之靈的神，差遣祂的使者，將那必要快發生的事指示祂的奴僕。

footnotes.zh: 指二一9的天使。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指二一9的天使。
footnotes.en: 22:6 1 he He refers to the angel in Rev. 21:9.

footnotes.zh: 那差遣使者将这书中的事指示人的“主……神，”就是主耶稣(一1，二二16)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 那差遣使者將這書中的事指示人的“主…神，”就是主耶穌。（一1，二二16。）
footnotes.en: 22:6 2 Lord "The Lord, the God," who sent His angel to show the things in this book is the Lord Jesus (Rev. 1:1; 22:16).

footnotes.zh: 在本书，主神乃是众申言者之灵的神，这指明本书一切的预言都是那位在新旧约中感动众申言者之灵的神所默示的；这也指明本书的预言与新旧约里的预言有关，都是申言者在他们被神感动的灵里所说的。因此，我们要明白这些预言，也需要在我们灵里接受神的膏抹。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在本書，主神乃是眾申言者之靈的神，這指明本書一切的豫言都是那位在新舊約中感動眾申言者之靈的神所默示的；這也指明本書的豫言與新舊約裏的豫言有關，都是申言者在他們被神感動的靈裏所說的。因此，我們要明白這些豫言，也需要在我們靈裏接受神的膏抹。
footnotes.en: 22:6 3 spirits In this book the Lord God is the God of the spirits of the prophets. This indicates that all the prophecies in this book are inspired by the very God who inspired the spirits of the prophets in both the Old Testament and the New Testament. It also indicates that these prophecies are related to those in the Old Testament and the New Testament, all of which were spoken by the prophets in their spirit, which was under the inspiration of God. Hence, to comprehend these prophecies, we too need to be in our spirit under God's anointing.

refs.text_gb: 坐宝座的说，看哪，我将一切都更新了。又说，你要写上，因这些话是可信的，是真实的。
refs.text_big5: 坐寶座的說，看哪，我將一切都更新了。又說，你要寫上，因這些話是可信的，是真實的。
refs.text_en: And He who sits on the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And He said, Write, for these words are faithful and true.

refs.text_gb: 他对我说，千万不可。我与你、和你的弟兄众申言者、并那些守这书上之话的人，同是作奴仆的，你要敬拜神。
refs.text_big5: 他對我說，千萬不可。我與你、和你的弟兄眾申言者、並那些守這書上之話的人，同是作奴僕的，你要敬拜神。
refs.text_en: And he said to me, Do not do that! I am your fellow slave and a fellow slave of your brothers the prophets and of those who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God.

refs.text_gb: 但在第七位天使发声的日子，要吹号的时候，神的奥秘就完成了，正如神所传给祂的奴仆众申言者的福音。
refs.text_big5: 但在第七位天使發聲的日子，要吹號的時候，神的奧祕就完成了，正如神所傳給祂的奴僕眾申言者的福音。
refs.text_en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel when he is about to trumpet, then the mystery of God is finished, as He has announced the good news to His own slaves the prophets.

refs.text_gb: 外邦发怒，你的忿怒也临到了，审判死人，和赏赐你的奴仆众申言者、和众圣徒、并敬畏你名的人，大的小的，以及败坏那些败坏地者的时候也到了。
refs.text_big5: 外邦發怒，你的忿怒也臨到了，審判死人，和賞賜你的奴僕眾申言者、和眾聖徒、並敬畏你名的人，大的小的，以及敗壞那些敗壞地者的時候也到了。
refs.text_en: And the nations became angry, and Your wrath came, and the time came for the dead to be judged, and the time to give the reward to Your slaves the prophets and to the saints and to those who fear Your name, to the small and to the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.

refs.text_gb: 因为他们曾流圣徒与申言者的血，你也给了他们血喝，这是他们所该受的。
refs.text_big5: 因為他們曾流聖徒與申言者的血，你也給了他們血喝，這是他們所該受的。
refs.text_en: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink; they are worthy of it.

refs.text_gb: 天哪，众圣徒、众使徒、众申言者啊，你们都要因她欢喜，因为神已经审判她，为你们伸了冤。
refs.text_big5: 天哪，眾聖徒、眾使徒、眾申言者阿，你們都要因她歡喜，因為神已經審判她，為你們伸了冤。
refs.text_en: Be glad over her, O heaven and saints and apostles and prophets, because God has judged judgment for you upon her.

footnotes.zh: 在本书的世代，人是义的或是不义的，是污秽的或是圣别的，是一件严肃的事。是义的，乃是在外面照神公义的法则行动；是圣别的，乃是在里面照神圣别的性情生活。在本书的世代，我们必须这样生活行动，使我们得赏赐；否则在主回来时，我们就要被定罪为不义和污秽的，并且要受刑罚(12)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在本書的世代，人是義的或是不義的，是污穢的或是聖別的，是一件嚴肅的事。是義的，乃是在外面照神公義的法則行動；是聖別的，乃是在裏面照神聖別的性情生活。在本書的世代，我們必須這樣生活行動，使我們得賞賜；否則在主回來時，我們就要被定罪為不義和污穢的，並且要受刑罰。（12。）
footnotes.en: 22:11 1 Let In the age of this book, whatever one is, whether unrighteous or righteous, whether filthy or holy, is a serious matter. To be righteous is to walk outwardly according to the righteous ways of God, whereas to be holy is to live inwardly according to the holy nature of God. In the age of this book we must walk and live in this way that we may receive the reward; otherwise, we will be condemned as unrighteous and filthy and will receive punishment at the Lord's coming back (v. 12).

footnotes.en: 22:13 1 I This is the Lord's declaration at the close of this book; it corresponds with what God declared in the opening of this book (Rev. 1:8). This indicates that the Lord Jesus is the very God.

footnotes.zh: 主耶稣不仅是首先的，也是初；不仅是末后的，也是终。首先的，指明没有人在祂以先；末后的，指明没有人在祂之后。初，意即祂是万有的起源；终，意即祂是万有的终结。这不仅指明，没有人在主耶稣之先，也没有人在主耶稣之后，也指明没有祂，就没有起源，也没有终结。
footnotes.zh_big5: 主耶穌不僅是首先的，也是初；不僅是末後的，也是終。首先的，指明沒有人在祂以先；末後的，指明沒有人在祂之後。初，意即祂是萬有的起源；終，意即祂是萬有的終結。這不僅指明，沒有人在主耶穌之先，也沒有人在主耶穌之後，也指明沒有祂，就沒有起源，也沒有終結。
footnotes.en: 22:13 2 First The Lord Jesus is not only the First but also the Beginning, and not only the Last but also the End. The First indicates that none is before Him, and the Last that none is after Him; whereas the Beginning indicates that He is the origination of all things, and the End that He is the consummation of all things. Hence, the indication here is not only that there is nothing before or after the Lord Jesus but also that there is no origination or consummation without Him.

footnotes.zh: 本节可视为一个应许，为着给人享受生命树，就是基督连同一切生命的丰富；17节后半可视为一个呼召，要人取用生命水，就是赐生命的灵。所以，本书结束于一个应许和一个呼召，都是要人吃喝包罗万有的基督这赐生命的灵。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本節可視為一個應許，為著給人享受生命樹，就是基督連同一切生命的豐富；17節後半可視為一個呼召，要人取用生命水，就是賜生命的靈。所以，本書結束於一個應許和一個呼召，都是要人喫喝包羅萬有的基督這賜生命的靈。
footnotes.en: 22:14 1 Blessed This verse can be considered a promise of the enjoyment of the tree of life, which is Christ with all the riches of life; and the second half of v. 17 can be considered a call to take the water of life, which is the life- giving Spirit. Thus this book ends in a promise and a call, both of which are for eating and drinking the all-inclusive Christ as the life-giving Spirit.

footnotes.zh: 这里的袍子象征信徒的行为。洗净自己的袍子，就是借着羔羊之血的洗涤，保守自己的行为洁净(七14，约壹一7)。这使信徒有权柄享受生命树，并且得以进城。在永世里，生命树和城都是他们的享受。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的袍子象徵信徒的行為。洗淨自己的袍子，就是藉著羔羊之血的洗滌，保守自己的行為潔淨。（七14，約壹一7。）這使信徒有權柄享受生命樹，並且得以進城。在永世裏，生命樹和城都是他們的享受。
footnotes.en: 22:14 2 wash The robes here symbolize the conduct of the believers. To wash their robes is to keep their conduct clean through the washing of the blood of the Lamb (Rev. 7:14; 1 John 1:7). This gives them the right to participate in the tree of life and to enter into the city. Both the tree of life and the city will be an enjoyment to them in eternity.

footnotes.zh: 直译，他们将对生命树有权柄。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，他們將對生命樹有權柄。
footnotes.en: 22:14 3 they Lit., their authority will be over the tree of life and they may enter...

footnotes.zh: 神造人之后，将人摆在生命树前(创二8～9)，这指明人有特权享用这树；但因人堕落了，神就用祂的荣耀、圣别和公义，封锁了人通往生命树的路(创三24)。借着基督那满足神一切荣耀、圣别、公义之要求的救赎，通往生命树的路就重新向信徒开启(来十19～20)。因此凡用基督救赎的血洗净自己袍子的人，在永世里都有权利在圣城，就是在神的乐园中，享受生命树作他们永远的分(二7)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神造人之後，將人擺在生命樹前，（創二8～9，）這指明人有特權享用這樹；但因人墮落了，神就用祂的榮耀、聖別和公義，封鎖了人通往生命樹的路。（創三24。）藉著基督那滿足神一切榮耀、聖別、公義之要求的救贖，通往生命樹的路就重新向信徒開啟。（來十19～20。）因此凡用基督救贖的血洗淨自己袍子的人，在永世裏都有權利在聖城，就是在神的樂園中，享受生命樹作他們永遠的分。（二7。）
footnotes.en: 22:14 4 right After being created, man was put before the tree of life (Gen. 2:8-9), indicating that he was privileged to partake of it. But because of the fall of man, the way to the tree of life was closed to man by God's glory, holiness, and righteousness (Gen. 3:24). Through Christ's redemption, which fulfilled all the requirements of God's glory, holiness, and righteousness, the way to the tree of life was opened again to believers (Heb. 10:19-20). Hence, those who wash their robes in the redeeming blood of Christ have the right to enjoy the tree of life as their eternal portion in the holy city, the Paradise of God, in eternity (Rev. 2:7).

footnotes.zh: 从门进城，就是借着胜过死亡并分赐生命的基督得重生，以进入新耶路撒冷，就是神永远福分的范围里(见二一21注2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 從門進城，就是藉著勝過死亡並分賜生命的基督得重生，以進入新耶路撒冷，就是神永遠福分的範圍裏。（見二一21註2。）
footnotes.en: 22:14 5 by To enter by the gates into the city is to enter the New Jerusalem, as a realm of God's eternal blessing, by regeneration through the death-overcoming and life-imparting Christ. (See note Rev. 21:21 2 .)

Hence, He is the Lord as the Root of David, and He is also the son, the shoot, of David as the Offspring of David (Matt. 22:42-45; Rom. 1:3; Jer. 23:5).

footnotes.zh: 基督再来时，对祂的百姓，是升起的日头(玛四2)，这是一般的；但对儆醒爱祂的人，乃是晨星，这是特别的，作得胜者的赏赐(二28)。基督是大卫的根，也是大卫的后裔，与以色列人和国度有关；祂是明亮的晨星，与召会和被提有关。晨星是在黎明前最黑暗的时刻前出现。大灾难就是这最黑暗的时候，随后，国度的白昼就要破晓。在国度里，基督要像日头，公开向祂的百姓显现；但在大灾难之前，祂要像晨星，暗中向祂的得胜者显现。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督再來時，對祂的百姓，是升起的日頭，（瑪四2，）這是一般的；但對儆醒愛祂的人，乃是晨星，這是特別的，作得勝者的賞賜。（二28。）基督是大衛的根，也是大衛的後裔，與以色列人和國度有關；祂是明亮的晨星，與召會和被提有關。晨星是在黎明前最黑暗的時刻前出現。大災難就是這最黑暗的時候，隨後，國度的白晝就要破曉。在國度裏，基督要像日頭，公開向祂的百姓顯現；但在大災難之前，祂要像晨星，暗中向祂的得勝者顯現。
footnotes.en: 22:16 4 morning At His coming back Christ will be the rising sun to His people generally (Mal. 4:2) but the morning star to His watching lovers particularly. The latter will be a reward to the overcomers (Rev. 2:28). Christ's being the Root and Offspring of David is related to Israel and the kingdom, whereas Christ's being the bright morning star is related to the church and the rapture. The morning star appears before the darkest hour, prior to the dawn. The great tribulation will be this darkest time, after which the day of the kingdom will dawn. In the kingdom the Lord will appear publicly to His people as the sun, but before the great tribulation He will appear privately to His overcomers as the morning star.
